jobs.occupation: Legal, Risk & Compliance Officer
jobs.description:
ZTL Payment Solution | Oslo, Norway

Help shape the future of B2B payments while building trust, sound governance and responsible growth.

About ZTL Payment Solution
ZTL is a pioneering Fintech company revolutionizing B2B payments by leveraging the Open Banking initiative and PSD2 regulations. Our innovative platform integrates seamlessly with ERP Accounting Systems, enabling SMEs to execute domestic and international invoice payments efficiently while accessing real-time balances and transaction data. With PSD2 licenses for Payment Initiation and Account Information, plus a money-transfer license from the Norwegian Financial Supervisory Authority, we are poised to become the leading B2B payment platform in the Nordics and beyond. Join us to shape the future of payments with a dynamic, entrepreneurial team.

The opportunity
We are looking for a pragmatic and commercially minded Legal, Risk & Compliance Officer to help ZTL scale responsibly across the Nordics and Europe. You will be a trusted adviser to colleagues across the business, translate complex regulatory requirements into practical solutions, and strengthen our risk and compliance framework without slowing innovation. This is a broad, hands-on role with visibility across management, product, technology, operations and external partners.

What you will do
• 
Provide clear, solution-oriented legal advice on payment services, commercial agreements, partnerships, products and regulatory matters; coordinate external counsel where appropriate.

• 
Monitor and interpret relevant Norwegian and EU requirements, including PSD2/payment services regulation, AML/CTF, sanctions, data protection and DORA; assess impacts and coordinate implementation.

• 
Maintain and improve ZTL’s compliance programme, policies, procedures, controls and regulatory obligations register, applying a proportionate, risk-based approach.

• 
Coordinate enterprise and operational risk assessments, risk appetite and control follow-up; maintain actionable risk and issue reporting for management and the Board.

• 
Plan and perform independent compliance monitoring, thematic reviews and control testing; document findings, agree remediation actions and track them to closure.

• 
Support regulatory reporting, supervisory dialogue, inspections and responses to Finanstilsynet, in collaboration with relevant accountable functions.

• 
Partner with technology, security and operations on ICT third-party risk, incident management, business continuity, operational resilience and changes to products and processes.

• 
Advise on customer and partner due diligence, financial crime controls and safeguarding-related governance, working closely with the designated AML and operational owners.

• 
Draft and negotiate contracts, assess new markets and partnerships, and help embed compliance-by-design into product development.

• 
Build awareness through concise training, practical guidance and constructive challenge; foster a culture of integrity, ownership and sound decision-making.

What you bring
• 
A degree in law (Master of Laws / cand.jur. or equivalent) is preferred; a relevant higher degree combined with strong legal and regulatory experience may also be considered.

• 
Relevant experience in legal, risk or compliance roles within regulated financial services, payments, banking or Fintech.

• 
Working knowledge of Norwegian and EU financial-services regulation, with the ability to navigate complex requirements and explain them simply.

• 
Experience with risk assessments, compliance monitoring, policy frameworks, governance and/or commercial contract work.

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in a Scandinavian language and English; strong judgement, integrity and attention to detail.

• 
A collaborative, self-directed approach: comfortable prioritising, challenging constructively and turning advice into workable action.

Why join ZTL?
• 
Meaningful influence on how a regulated Fintech scale-up builds its next phase of products and partnerships.

• 
Close collaboration with decision-makers and a talented, entrepreneurial team.

• 
A varied role combining strategic judgement with practical execution, professional development and real ownership.

• 
Competitive compensation and benefits, and an open, inclusive working environment.

Interested?
We value diverse backgrounds and perspectives. If you meet many, but not all, of the criteria and are excited about our mission, we encourage you to apply. Learn more at www.ztlpay.io. Any background or suitability checks will be proportionate to the role and carried out in accordance with applicable requirements.

Om arbeidsgiveren:
ZTL is a challenger to the banks' "Transactional Services".

We're a cloud-native SaaS hybrid B2B payment company in the early expansion phase. 

We integrate our Open Banking APIs into various ERPs and API platforms to build new business models within payment services. 

Drop us an email if you want to explore opportunities.

jobs.occupation: Stipendiat i engelsk anvendt lingvistikk
jobs.description:
Om stillingen
Universitetet i Stavanger har ledig stilling som stipendiat i engelsk anvendt lingvistikk ved Fakultet for utdanningsvitskap og humaniora, Institutt for grunnskolelærerutdanning, idrett og spesialpedagogikk. Stillingen er ledig fra 01.04.2027.

Stipendiatstillingen leder fram til doktorgrad og gir deg mulighet til å utvikle forskningskompetanse i et aktivt og stimulerende fagmiljø. Gjennom doktorgradsutdanningen opparbeider du kunnskap, ferdigheter og erfaring som kvalifiserer for videre karriere innenfor forskning, høyere utdanning og andre kunnskapsintensive sektorer.

Den som ansettes tas opp på doktorgradsprogrammet i utdanningsvitenskap og humaniora. Programmet omfatter blant annet selvstendig forskningsarbeid, deltakelse i nasjonale og internasjonale forskermiljø, samt forskningsformidling. Les mer om forskerutdanningen ved UiS på våre nettsider.
 
Stillingen er for tre år med ren forskerutdanning eller fire år med forskerutdanning kombinert med annet karrierefremmende arbeid. Dette avklares i rekrutteringsprosessen.

Som stipendiat ved UiS får du støtte til faglig og karrieremessig utvikling gjennom veiledning, kompetanseutvikling og karriereplanlegging.
Forskningstema
Forskningstemaet for stillingen er «Flerspråklige klasseromsmiljøer som arenaer for å endre engelsk språklæring i grunnskolen og ungdomsskolen».

De europeiske dokumentene (for eksempel Felles europeisk rammeverk for språk) og den norske læreplanen (LK20) anerkjenner flerspråklighet som en viktig ressurs for elever. Likevel har tilnærmingene for å bruke flerspråklighet i engelsk undervisning i stor grad vært ustrukturerte. Denne doktorgradsstillingen fokuserer på et dokumentert lokalt behov for kompetansebygging og ytterligere støtte for engelsklærere som jobber med flerspråklige elever. Stillingen er i tråd med nasjonale politiske retningslinjer som vektlegger universitets-skole-partnerskapene (foreslått av den nye Rammeplanen § 3 Partnerskap i lærerutdanning) og oppfordrer til sterkere koblinger mellom forskning og praksis (Meld. St. 19 – 2023-2024). Forskningen bør generere ny kunnskap om flerspråklighet som en verdifull ressurs for språklæring og -undervisning.

Den som ansettes vil ha betydelig frihet til å definere sitt eget fokus innenfor dette forskningstemaet. 

Prosjektet kan avgrenses til følgende temaområder: elevgenererte materialer, CLIL (content and language integrated learning), undervisningsmetoder basert på estetiske læringsprosesser, deltakende undervisningsmetoder, dialogisk undervisning, samarbeidende undervisning og/eller metaspråklig utforskning, med sikte på å gjøre engelskundervisning relevant på tvers av ulike språkbakgrunner og ferdighetsnivåer ved å ta i bruk elevenes flerspråklige ressurser. Prosjektet kan fokusere på elever, lærere og/eller lærerstudenter, kan ta utgangspunkt i grunnskolen, ungdomsskolen eller lærerutdanningen, og kan benytte en rekke forskningsmetoder. Kandidatene kan samle inn data fra nordiske eller internasjonale kontekster, eller ha en tverrfaglig tilnærming.

Forskningsprosjektet vil bli utført ved Universitetet i Stavanger. Det forutsettes at den tilsatte vil jobbe fulltid med prosjektet og vil delta i det akademiske miljøet ved fakultetet og universitetet. Vi oppfordrer også tilsatte til å inkludere et internasjonalt forskningsopphold i løpet av ansettelsesperioden, ved en anerkjent og relevant forskningsinstitusjon.
Prosjektskisse
Som søker skal du utarbeide en foreløpig prosjektskisse for et doktorgradsprosjekt innenfor det beskrevne forskningstemaet.

Prosjektskissen skal redegjøre for prosjektets problemstilling, relevans, samt teoretisk og metodisk tilnærming. Skissen skal skrives på engelsk og vil inngå i kompetansevurderingen. 

Det forventes at prosjektskissen er et selvstendig og originalt faglig arbeid som reflekterer søkerens egne vurderinger og idéer. Dersom kunstig intelligens (KI) er benyttet i arbeidet med prosjektskissen, skal dette opplyses om og bruken beskrives kort.

Dersom du blir ansatt, vil prosjektskissen og prosjektets framdriftsplan videreutvikles i samarbeid med veilederne i løpet av de tre første månedene av ansettelsesperioden og danne grunnlag for den endelige planen for doktorgradsprosjektet. Mal for prosjektskisse finner du her.
Kvalifikasjoner
Du må ha en sterk faglig bakgrunn med femårig mastergrad (3+2 eller 4+1) innenfor engelsk språkdidaktikk, literacy studies, engelsk språk, litteratur og/eller kultur, lærerutdanning eller tilsvarende utdanning som gir grunnlag for å gjennomføre en forskerutdanning, fortrinnsvis av nyere dato.

Karakter på masteroppgaven og veid gjennomsnittskarakter for masterstudiet må begge tilsvare B eller bedre. 

Dersom du har utdanning fra en institusjon med annen karakterskala enn A-F, ber vi deg legge ved dokumentasjon som viser hvordan karakterene kan sammenliknes med den norske karakterskalaen. Du kan bruke disse konverteringsskalaene til å beregne poengene dine for opptak.
 
Vi legger også vekt på at du:

• har høy faglig integritet og fokus på kvalitet i arbeidet
• er nysgjerrig og motivert for å gjennomføre forskningsprosjektet og bidra til faglige fellesskap og samarbeid på tvers av fagområder
• har potensial for forskning innenfor fagfeltet og personlige forutsetninger for å fullføre doktorgradsutdanningen innen ansettelsesperioden
• kan arbeide godt både selvstendig og i samarbeid med andre forskere
• har evne til kritisk refleksjon, nytenkning og selvstendig problemløsning, og arbeider strukturert og målrettet
• har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner og bidrar til et konstruktivt arbeidsmiljø.Krav til engelskkunnskaper
Gode ferdigheter i engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig, er en forutsetning for opptak til doktorgradsprogrammet. 

Dersom du er internasjonal søker og ikke omfattes av fritaksordningene nedenfor, må du dokumentere engelskkunnskapene dine med et gyldig resultat fra én av følgende språktester:

• TOEFL – Test of English as a Foreign Language, Internet-Based Test (IBT). Minimum resultat: 90/4.5
• IELTS – International English Language Testing Service. Minimum resultat: 6.5
• Certificate in Advanced English (CAE) eller Certificate of Proficiency in English (CPE) fra Universitetet i Cambridge
• PTE Academic – Pearson Test of English Academic. Minimum resultat: 62
Du er fritatt fra kravet dersom du:

• har fullført minst ett års universitetsstudier i Australia, Canada, Irland, New Zealand, Storbritannia eller USA
• har fullført en mastergrad med engelsk som undervisningsspråk i et EU-/EØS-land eller i India
• er fritatt i henhold til HK-dirs GSU liste
• ikke inngår i de ovennevnte unntakskategoriene, men har bodd i Norge de siste fem åreneSom stipendiat ved UiS får du
• forskerutdanning ved et universitet med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag
• et ambisiøst og inkluderende forskningsmiljø
• veiledning og støtte til faglig og karrieremessig utvikling
• gratis norskkurs dersom du ikke behersker norsk, svensk eller dansk på minimum A2-nivå ved ansettelse
• tilgang til Lifekeys, en digital tjeneste for mental helse og livskvalitet
• lønn som stipendiat etter Statens lønnsregulativ i stillingskode 1017, kr 580.000 brutto pr år, med lønnsutvikling etter ansiennitet i stillingen. 
• medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse med gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
Les mer om ansattgoder og fordeler på uis.no.
Mangfold og inkludering
Mangfold er en styrke ved universitetet. Ulike erfaringer, perspektiver og bakgrunner bidrar til bedre løsninger og et godt arbeids- og læringsmiljø. Vi ønsker søkere med ulike kvalifikasjoner, livserfaringer og perspektiver, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonsevne, kulturell bakgrunn eller om du har hatt opphold i arbeidslivet. UiS legger til rette for ansatte i ulike livsfaser og for medarbeidere med behov for individuell tilrettelegging. 
 
I tråd med gjeldende regelverk vil minst én kvalifisert søker med funksjonsnedsettelse, hull i CV-en eller innvandrerbakgrunn bli invitert til intervju. Dersom dette gjelder deg, kan du oppgi det i jobbsøkerportalen. Les mer om ordningen her.  

Universitetet ønsker bedre kjønnsbalanse i stipendiatstillinger innenfor fagområdet og oppfordrer derfor særlig menn til å søke. Ved tilnærmet like kvalifikasjoner kan menn bli prioritert i samsvar med gjeldende regelverk.
Har du spørsmål?

Har du spørsmål om ansettelsesprosessen, kan du kontakte:

Søk stillingen ved å klikke på "Søk stillingen" på denne siden. 

I Jobbnorge registrerer du søknad, relevant utdanning og arbeidserfaring samt språkferdigheter. I søknaden ber vi deg beskrive dine forskningsinteresser, din motivasjon for stillingen og hvordan din bakgrunn er relevant for forskningsprosjektet.

Følgende dokumentasjon skal lastes opp som vedlegg til søknaden:

• prosjektskisse, se mal tilgjengelig på våre nettsider
• CV med fullstendig oversikt over utdanning, erfaring og eventuell vitenskapelig virksomhet
• vitnemål med karakterutskrift som dokumenterer fullført mastergrad. Dersom du ikke har fullført mastergraden, skal du legge ved oppdatert karakterutskrift.
• Diploma Supplement eller tilsvarende dokumentasjon, samt konverteringsskala dersom dette er påkrevd
• dokumentasjon på engelskspråklig kompetanse dersom dette er påkrevd
• publikasjoner eller annet relevant forskningsarbeid
• attester og annen dokumentasjon som vurderes relevant for søknaden 
Dokumentasjonen må foreligge på et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk. 

Søknaden vurderes på grunnlag av informasjonen som er registrert i Jobbnorge ved søknadsfristen utløp. Sørg derfor for at søknaden tydelig viser hvordan din kompetanse og erfaring oppfyller kompetansekravene i utlysningen, og at nødvendig dokumentasjon er lastet opp. Dersom vedleggene samlet overskrider 100 MB, må filene komprimeres før opplasting.

UiS behandler bare søknader og vedlegg registrert i Jobbnorge.

Opplysninger om søkere kan bli offentliggjort selv om det er bedt om unntak fra offentlig søkerliste, jf. offentlighetsloven § 25. Dersom anmodningen ikke tas til følge, vil du bli varslet.
Ansettelsesvilkår og videre prosess
UiS er underlagt sikkerhetsloven, og det forventes at ansatte utviser sikkerhetsbevisst atferd, og følger gjeldende sikkerhets- og eksportkontrollrutiner. Ved ansettelse vil egenskaper som pålitelighet, dømmekraft og lojalitet bli vektlagt.

Ansettelse som stipendiat er regulert i universitets- og høgskoleforskriften kapittel IV. Opptak til doktorgradsutdanningen er regulert i forskrift for graden philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) ved Universitetet i Stavanger.

Dine kvalifikasjoner for stillingen vil bli vurdert av en intern komité på grunnlag av dokumentasjonen registrert i Jobbnorge ved søknadsfristens utløp. På bakgrunn av komiteens vurdering vil aktuelle søkere bli invitert til intervju. Det vil også bli innhentet referanser for aktuelle kandidater. Les mer om ansettelsesprosessen på våre nettsider.
 
Doktorgradsarbeidet skal i hovedsak gjennomføres ved Universitetet i Stavanger. Det er en forutsetning at den som ansettes bosetter seg slik at vedkommende kan være til stede og tilgjengelig for fagmiljøet i ordinær arbeidstid.

Stillingen er kunngjort på både norsk og engelsk. Ved eventuelle motstridende opplysninger mellom tekstene er det den norske teksten som legges til grunn.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Universitetet i Stavanger (UiS) har omlag 12.000 studenter og 2.200 ansatte. Universitetet har store ambisjoner. Vi skal ha en innovativ og internasjonal profil og være en drivkraft i kunnskapsutviklingen og endringsprosesser i samfunnet. Vår felles retning skal drives frem av omtanke for bærekraftig omstilling og rettferdig samfunnsutvikling, gjennom nye måter å forvalte naturressursene på og legge til rette for bedre byer og lokalsamfunn. Energi, helse og velferd, læring for livet er våre satsingsområder.I samspill og dialog med våre omgivelser regionalt, nasjonalt og internasjonalt har vi et åpent og innovativt klima for utdanning, forskning, kunstnerisk utviklingsarbeid, nyskapning, formidling og museumsvirksomhet. Den faglige virksomheten ved universitetet er organisert i seks fakultet med 13 institutt og to nasjonale forsknings- og kompetansesenter i tillegg til Arkeologisk museum. Vi er medlem i det europeiske nettverket for innovative universitet - European Consortium of Innovative Universities. Universitetet ligger i den mest attraktive regionen i landet med 300.000 innbyggere.  Stavangerregionen har et dynamisk arbeidsmarked og tilbyr en rekke spennende kultur- og fritidsaktiviteter.Sammen med våre ansatte og studenter vil vi løfte blikket, og våge å tenke stort og nytt – vi vil utfordre det velkjente og utforske det ukjentee.Fakultet for utdanningsvitenskap og humaniora er regionens viktigste institusjon for utdanning av lærere til barnehage, grunnskole, videregående skole, høyskole og universitet. Fakultetet tilbyr også grunnutdanning innenfor idrett, språk, religion, historie, samt åtte masterprogrammer og en doktorgradsutdanning. Fakultetet har tre nasjonale sentre: Nasjonalt lesesenter, Nasjonalt senter for læringsmiljø og atferdsforskning (Læringsmiljøsenteret) og Kunnskapssenter for utdanning (KSU), samt forskningssentrene Filiorum - Senter for barnehageforskning og Greenhouse – Centre for environmental humanities. I tillegg er fakultetet en av fem universitetspartnere i Senter for spesialpedagogisk forskning og inkludering (SpedAims). Fakultetet samarbeider med Utdanningsdirektoratet, kommuner og fylkeskommuner om etter- og videreutdanning av ansatte i barnehage, skole og PPT. Fakultetet har ca. 3.300 studenter, og ca. 400 ansatte fordelt på fakultetsadministrasjonen, Institutt for barnehagelærerutdanning, Institutt for grunnskolelærerutdanning, idrett og spesialpedagogikk, Institutt for kultur- og språkvitenskap, Nasjonalt lesesenter, Læringsmiljøsenteret og Kunnskapssenter for utdanning.

Institutt for grunnskolelærerutdanning, idrett og spesialpedagogikk har ansvar for grunnskolelærerutdanning for 1 – 7. trinn og 5 – 10. trinn master i spesialpedagogikk, master i idrettsvitenskap, bachelor i idrettsvitenskap, samt årsstudium i kunst og håndverk, drama, idrett, friluftsliv og læring og psykologi. Fra høst 2026 skal vi også tilby årsstudium i spesialpedagogikk. I tillegg har instituttet ansvar for videreutdanninger i kunst og håndverk, mat og helse, veiledning for praksislærere og veiledning av nyutdannede lærere og en rekke varierte enkeltemner. Instituttet har et aktivt forskningsmiljø og mange av våre ansatte er også involvert i kollektiv kompetanseutvikling i nært samarbeid med skoler og skoleeiere. Vi har også et nært samarbeid med over seksti skoler i regionen som gir veiledet praksis til grunnskolelærerstudentene. Det er i dag ca 90 ansatte, ca 14 stipendiater og nærmere 1000 studenter tilknyttet instituttet.

jobs.occupation: Stipendiat i kunst og kultur i skolen, med fokus på drama og teater
jobs.description:
Om stillingen
Universitetet i Stavanger har ledig stilling som stipendiat i kunst og kultur i skolen, med fokus på drama og teater, ved Fakultet for utdanningsvitskap og humaniora, Institutt for grunnskolelærerutdanning, idrett og spesialpedagogikk. Stillingen er ledig fra 1. mars 2027.

Stipendiatstillingen leder fram til doktorgrad og gir deg mulighet til å utvikle forskningskompetanse i et aktivt og stimulerende fagmiljø. Gjennom doktorgradsutdanningen opparbeider du kunnskap, ferdigheter og erfaring som kvalifiserer for videre karriere innenfor forskning, høyere utdanning og andre kunnskapsintensive sektorer.
 
Den som ansettes tas opp på doktorgradsprogrammet i utdanningsvitenskap og humaniora. Programmet omfatter blant annet selvstendig forskningsarbeid, deltakelse i nasjonale og internasjonale forskermiljø, samt forskningsformidling. Les mer om forskerutdanningen ved UiS på våre nettsider.

Stillingen er for tre år med ren forskerutdanning eller fire år med forskerutdanning kombinert med annet karrierefremmende arbeid. Dette avklares i rekrutteringsprosessen.

Som stipendiat ved UiS får du støtte til faglig og karrieremessig utvikling gjennom veiledning, kompetanseutvikling og karriereplanlegging.
Forskningstema
Fagområdet og forskningstema for stillingen vil være innen 1) Kunst og kultur i skolen 2) Kunstbaserte lærings- og undervisningsformer 3) Drama og teater.

Universitetet søker en stipendiat som i sitt forskningsarbeid vil undersøke kunst- og kulturfeltets, og spesielt drama og teaters, rolle i den nye fellesskolen. Forskningsprosjektet skal utforske og gi ny empirisk kunnskap om hvordan kunst- og kulturbaserte arbeidsformer kan bidra i utviklingen av en mer praktisk, relevant og inkluderende skole, og hvilken betydning kunstfagene og de estetiske læringsprosessenes egenart og verdi kan ha i utviklingen av fremtidens fellesskole (NOU 26: 10). Fokus i forskningsprosjektet er kunst og kultur i skolen, men forskningsprosjektet kan også inkludere lærerutdanningen. Prosjektet bør være forankret i læreplanverket LK20, opplæringens verdigrunnlag Skaperglede, engasjement og utforskertrang, samt nasjonale og/eller internasjonale satsinger på kunstbaserte lærings- og undervisningsformer (f.eks. Skaperglede, engasjement og utforskertrang; UNESCO Framework for Culture and Arts Education). 

Stipendiatstillingen vil være tilknyttet det tverrfaglige DEMCI/CREATE forskningsmiljøet ved Universitetet i Stavanger og vil kunne dra nytte av forskningsmiljøets kontakter i Dembra lærerutdanningsnettverket, ved Nasjonalt senter for kunst og kultur i opplæringen (KKS), samt miljøet innen kunstfagdidaktikk ved Fakultetet for utøvende kunstfag i Bjergsted.  
Prosjektskisse
Som søker skal du utarbeide en foreløpig prosjektskisse for et doktorgradsprosjekt innenfor det beskrevne forskningstemaet.

Prosjektskissen skal redegjøre for prosjektets problemstilling, relevans, samt teoretisk og metodisk tilnærming. Skissen (ca. 3000 ord), vil inngå i kompetansevurderingen.

Dersom du blir ansatt, vil prosjektskissen og prosjektets framdriftsplan videreutvikles i samarbeid med veilederne i løpet av de tre første månedene av ansettelsesperioden og danne grunnlag for den endelige planen for doktorgradsprosjektet. Mal for prosjektskisse finner du her.
Kvalifikasjoner
Du må ha en sterk faglig bakgrunn med femårig mastergrad innenfor kunstfag, kunstfagdidaktikk, lærerutdanning eller tilsvarende utdanning som gir grunnlag for å gjennomføre en forskerutdanning, fortrinnsvis av nyere dato.

Karakter på masteroppgaven og veid gjennomsnittskarakter for masterstudiet må begge tilsvare B eller bedre. 

Dersom du har utdanning fra en institusjon med annen karakterskala enn A-F, ber vi deg legge ved dokumentasjon som viser hvordan karakterene kan sammenliknes med den norske karakterskalaen. Du kan bruke disse konverteringsskalaene til å beregne poengene dine for opptak.
 
Vi legger også vekt på at du:

• har interesse i koblingen mellom kunst & kultur og skole, læring og utdanning
• har høy faglig integritet og fokus på kvalitet i arbeidet
• er nysgjerrig og motivert for å gjennomføre forskningsprosjektet og bidra til faglige fellesskap og samarbeid på tvers av fagområder
• har potensial for forskning innenfor fagfeltet og personlige forutsetninger for å fullføre doktorgradsutdanningen innen ansettelsesperioden
• kan arbeide godt både selvstendig og i samarbeid med andre forskere
• har evne til kritisk refleksjon, nytenkning og selvstendig problemløsning, og arbeider strukturert og målrettet
• har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner og bidrar til et konstruktivt arbeidsmiljø.
• har gode ferdigheter i engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig
• kan utføre forskningsarbeid innen norsk skolekontekstKrav til engelskkunnskaper
Gode ferdigheter i engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig, er en forutsetning for opptak til doktorgradsprogrammet. 

Dersom du er internasjonal søker og ikke omfattes av fritaksordningene nedenfor, må du dokumentere engelskkunnskapene dine med et gyldig resultat fra én av følgende språktester:

• TOEFL – Test of English as a Foreign Language, Internet-Based Test (IBT). Minimum resultat: 90/4.5
• IELTS – International English Language Testing Service. Minimum resultat: 6.5
• Certificate in Advanced English (CAE) eller Certificate of Proficiency in English (CPE) fra Universitetet i Cambridge
• PTE Academic – Pearson Test of English Academic. Minimum resultat: 62
Du er fritatt fra kravet dersom du:

• har fullført minst ett års universitetsstudier i Australia, Canada, Irland, New Zealand, Storbritannia eller USA
• har fullført en mastergrad med engelsk som undervisningsspråk i et EU-/EØS-land eller i India
• er fritatt i henhold til HK-dirs GSU liste
• ikke inngår i de ovennevnte unntakskategoriene, men har bodd i Norge de siste fem åreneSom stipendiat ved UiS får du
• forskerutdanning ved et universitet med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag
• et ambisiøst og inkluderende forskningsmiljø
• veiledning og støtte til faglig og karrieremessig utvikling
• gratis norskkurs dersom du ikke behersker norsk, svensk eller dansk på minimum A2-nivå ved ansettelse
• tilgang til Lifekeys, en digital tjeneste for mental helse og livskvalitet
• lønn som stipendiat etter Statens lønnsregulativ i stillingskode 1017, kr 580.000 brutto pr år, med lønnsutvikling etter ansiennitet i stillingen. 
• medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse med gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
Les mer om ansattgoder og fordeler på uis.no.
Mangfold og inkludering
Mangfold er en styrke ved universitetet. Ulike erfaringer, perspektiver og bakgrunner bidrar til bedre løsninger og et godt arbeids- og læringsmiljø. Vi ønsker søkere med ulike kvalifikasjoner, livserfaringer og perspektiver, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonsevne, kulturell bakgrunn eller om du har hatt opphold i arbeidslivet. UiS legger til rette for ansatte i ulike livsfaser og for medarbeidere med behov for individuell tilrettelegging. 
 
I tråd med gjeldende regelverk vil minst én kvalifisert søker med funksjonsnedsettelse, hull i CV-en eller innvandrerbakgrunn bli invitert til intervju. Dersom dette gjelder deg, kan du oppgi det i jobbsøkerportalen. Les mer om ordningen her.  

Universitetet ønsker bedre kjønnsbalanse i stipendiatstillinger innenfor fagområdet og oppfordrer derfor særlig menn til å søke. Ved tilnærmet like kvalifikasjoner kan menn bli prioritert i samsvar med gjeldende regelverk.
Har du spørsmål?
Ta gjerne kontakt dersom du ønsker å vite mer om om stillingen og prosjektbeskrivelse:

• Instituttleder Lars Rune Waage, tlf. +4751833474, e-post:  lars.r.waage@uis.no
• Førsteamanuensis Berit Aarrestad, tlf: e-post:  berit.aarrestad@uis.no
• Førsteamanuensis Silje Normand, e-post:  silje.h.normand@uis.no
Har du spørsmål om ansettelsesprosessen, kan du kontakte: 

• HR-rådgiver Camelia Danaei, e-post: camelia.danaei@uis.noSlik søker du
Søk stillingen ved å klikke på "Søk stillingen" på denne siden.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Research Fellow in Economics
jobs.description:
Job description
The Department of Economics invites applicants for a position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (SKO1352) in one of the following fields: Macroeconomics, Household Finance, or Family and Demographic Economics.

This is a full-time, four-year position, with 25% of working time devoted to teaching. The anticipated start date is between August 1 and October 1, 2027.
About the position 
The Department of Economics seeks a new colleague with the potential for outstanding research and high-quality teaching.

Candidates must provide evidence of excellence in research of the highest international caliber in macroeconomics, household finance, or family and demographic economics. This can be demonstrated by an innovative job market paper with a significant contribution to the literature, high-quality working papers, (forthcoming) publications in top-ranked and field-relevant journals, strong recommendations by referees who themselves have a record of excellence in research of the highest international caliber, the submitted research statement, presentations at significant conferences, and awards and accolades.

It is expected that the successful candidate contributes to a high standard of collegiality and the department’s working environment.
 
A postdoctoral position is intended for the employee to develop a research profile and competence that qualifies them to apply for an Associate Professor position. The position may also provide other competencies relevant to the postdoctoral fellow's future career.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.
About the project
The postdoctoral position is financed by the research project HOWFER (Housing, Wealth, and Fertility in High-income Societies), led by Associate Professor Martin Blomhoff Holm. The project combines macroeconomics, household finance, and family economics to analyze how rising house prices and wealth concentration have contributed to falling fertility in high-income countries. Using Norwegian administrative data linking wealth, housing, and family formation for the entire population, the work will estimate the causal effect of house prices on fertility and build structural models to evaluate which policies most effectively affect fertility. The postdoctoral researcher will contribute both to the empirical and theoretical parts of the project, in collaboration with the core research team.

Candidates should articulate how they can contribute to and strengthen the project.
Requirements
• A PhD degree in Economics by the time of appointment, or shortly thereafter, and no later than September 30, 2027.
• A strong research profile in Macroeconomics, Household Finance, or Family and Demographic Economics that complements that of the department and the research project.
• Qualifications that are compatible with the department’s teaching obligations and study programmes.
• Candidates must have fluent written and oral communication skills in English.
• Residence in or close to Oslo is required, and presence on campus is expected.We offer 
• Salary NOK 750 000 - 800 000 per annum, depending on qualifications, in position as Postdoctoral Research Fellow (position code 1352).  From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund.
• A stimulating and international research environment with multiple research groups and seminar series.
• A friendly and inclusive workplace allowing for a good work-life balance.

jobs.description:
About the positions
The Department of Economics invites applications for PhD Research Fellow positions, with a deadline of 15 January 2027. PhD Research Fellows will automatically be admitted to the Faculty of Social Sciences' PhD programme in economics and benefit from organized research training.

Our PhD programme trains economists for the international academic job market and for research positions in policy institutions, central banks, and research organisations. Our candidates also work in government, finance and the consulting sector. 

Our fellows receive thorough training in high-quality scientific research, working with state-of-the-art empirical and theoretical methods, and pursue their own research from the outset.
 
The Department of Economics offers an international and research-active environment with 55 faculty members and about 25 PhD students in various fields. The Department has in recent years attracted a number of prestigious ERC grants, and it hosts a centre for public economics, Norwegian Fiscal Studies (NFS) and a centre for international economics, Norwegian Centre for International Economics (NORCIE).

The Department encourages interaction between PhD students and faculty through social gatherings and a wide variety of seminars and workshops in which PhD students are fully involved. In addition to the training described above, PhD students are integrated into the Department’s international research network.
Job description
3 – 5 PhD Research Fellow positions (SKO 1017) for the PhD programme are available. The appointments are for a period of 4 years with 25% teaching and administrative duties. 

One position is funded by the Norwegian Centre for International Economics and requires that the candidate’s research interests and project proposal is related to international economics and/or development economics.

The remaining positions are not linked to specific topics or research projects. Applications from candidates in all fields of economics are encouraged, in particular in fields where the Department has a strong research base and supervision capacity.
Qualification requirements
Proven academic record: 

Candidates must hold a 2-year Master's degree (including master’s dissertation) or an equivalent qualification in economics. 

Candidates completing their Master's degrees (or equivalent) in the spring semester 2027 before 1 August, 2027, may apply.

Please note that:

• Accounting, auditing, business, marketing or management do not count as economics.
• Candidates who have completed a PhD programme in Economics will not be accepted. 
• Candidates who have already been accepted to a PhD programme in Economics must inform about this.
• Candidates from institutions that do not use ECTS grades must include an official conversion of their grades to ECTS grades.
Candidates who have already completed economics courses at the postgraduate level in econometrics, microeconomics and/or macroeconomics will have a distinct advantage in the ranking of candidates, but strong candidates who lack this background may also be accepted and will be required to take such courses as part of the PhD programme. Candidates with a degree from another institution than the University of Oslo will need to document qualifications based on detailed course descriptions and syllabuses.

GRE test

For candidates with education from an institution outside the European Economic Area/the European Union, the UK, or Switzerland a score from the general GRE test that is no more than five years old at the application deadline is required as part of the documentation of qualifications. 

• The required scores are 152 points on the Quantitative reasoning section and 153 points on the Verbal reasoning section.
• Please add UiO as a recipient of your GRE test using our institutional code 0756. 
You must scan and upload a copy of your test result to the application portal. 

• The Department of Economics does not accept GMAT scores as a substitute for the GRE.

A good command of English is required of all applicants. Applicants must document their proficiency in English by taking either a TOEFL or an IELTS test. 

For information about score requirements, see Requirements for admission to the PhD programme in Economics. 

Applicants are exempt from TOEFL/IELTS if they are native English speakers, have a qualifying Master’s degree from a Nordic school or have a qualifying Master’s degree where the language of tuition was English.

Working environment

It is expected that the candidate will contribute to a high standard of collegiality and the Department’s working environment. Residence in or close to Oslo is expected.

For further information, please visit the Faculty of Social Sciences’ homepage for the PhD programme: Applying for a PhD fellowship at the Faculty of Social Sciences

jobs.occupation: Sales Director
jobs.description:
Join us in shaping the future of maritime electrification.

ZEM is a Norwegian technology company developing and delivering advanced electric and hybrid propulsion solutions for the maritime industry. Combining deep expertise in battery technology and system integration with the industrial strength of Volvo Penta as majority owner, we are helping accelerate the transition towards more sustainable maritime operations.  As we enter our next phase of growth, we are looking for a commercially driven and strategically minded Sales Director to strengthen our market position, expand our customer base, and identify new business opportunities across the maritime sector and related industries.  This is a unique opportunity to join the executive management team and play a key role in shaping the commercial future of a company with proven technology, strong owners, and ambitious growth plans.

Key Responsibilities
Market Development and Relationship Building

• Build and develop relationships with shipowners, shipyards, ship designers, OEMs and other key industry stakeholders.
• Open new customer accounts and expand ZEM's presence in existing and emerging market segments.
• Represent ZEM at customer locations, industry events, conferences and trade fairs.
• Strengthen and expand the company's network across priority markets and geographies.
• Further develop existing customer relationships together with technical and service teams, including upselling, aftermarket opportunities and new projects.
• Own and develop the commercial relationship with Volvo Penta and support joint market development initiatives.
Business Opportunity Development 

• Identify future projects, investment plans and market opportunities at an early stage.
• Understand customer needs, decision-making processes and commercial drivers.
• Qualify opportunities and build a strong pipeline of future business.
• Lead tender and contract processes for own customers and opportunities transferred from business development activities.
• Ensure effective handover and collaboration across internal stakeholders.
• Commercial Strategy and Market Positioning
• Contribute to the development of ZEMs commercial strategy, value proposition and market positioning.
• Provide market intelligence and customer insight to support strategic decision-making.
• Monitor market developments, regulatory changes and competitive activity.
• Act as a trusted market voice within the executive management team.
Leadership 

• Lead and develop the Business and Sales Development Engineer.
• Contribute actively as a member of the management team.
• Help shape market priorities, commercial processes and growth initiatives.Required Qualifications
• Extensive experience from commercial leadership, sales or business development roles within the maritime sector, offshore industry or related heavy industry.
• A strong and relevant network among Norwegian shipowners, shipyards, OEMs or other key maritime stakeholders.
• Proven track record of opening new customer relationships and securing business in complex B2B environments.
• Experience managing long sales cycles and cultivating strategic customer relationships over time.
• Ability to engage credibly in discussions related to electrification, propulsion systems, battery technology or maritime operations.
• Excellent communication skills in both Norwegian and English.
• Willingness and ability to travel frequently, approximately 40–60% of working time.
Preferred Qualifications 

• Degree in engineering, maritime studies, business or a related discipline.
• Experience with maritime electrification, hybrid propulsion, energy storage or maritime system integration.
• International business development and sales experience.
• An established network beyond Norway within the maritime and offshore industries.
• Experience influencing technology selection, specifications and project requirements during the early phases of customer projects.Who we believe you are
• You are commercially driven, curious and highly relationship-oriented. 
• You thrive in customer-facing environments and are comfortable navigating between boardrooms, shipyards, project teams and industry events.
• You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and are motivated by creating opportunities where none previously existed. You are patient enough to build trust over time, yet proactive enough to create momentum and drive measurable progress.

• A key leadership position in a company at the forefront of maritime electrification.
• Membership of the executive management team with direct influence on strategy, market priorities and business growth.
• The opportunity to help shape new markets and create long-term commercial value.
• Proven technology, strong technical expertise and industrial backing from Volvo Penta.
• Close collaboration with experienced leaders, engineers and industry specialists.
• A high degree of autonomy and ownership.
• The opportunity to contribute directly to reducing emissions and accelerating the green transition in the maritime sector.
• Competitive compensation and benefits package.
If you are excited by the opportunity to build markets, develop strategic customer relationships and help shape the future of sustainable maritime technology, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: SURF Umbilical Specialist
jobs.description:
Erithy, previously known as Be Better Contractors, specializes in the design and construction of sustainable subsea infrastructure globally.

We deliver consultancy services within the oil and gas industry, high voltage cables, biogas and hydrogen, as well as civil engineering services and project administration.

Created in 2017, Erithy has grown into a consultancy team made up of various profiles from Europe, South America and the Middle East, working on projects across Norway.

We are always on the lookout for new talented individuals to join our team, and we hope that you will be our new member!

We are now looking for a SURF Umbilical Specialist for one of our customers based in Oslo.

Duration: 1 year, with option for extension

Responsibilities:

• 
Provide high standard services with regards to H3SE&Q, so to implement and to control H3SE rules and requirements within his area of responsibility. Ensure all flowlines technical documentation and SURF Contractor activities comply with H3SE&Q requirements and highlight any potential deviations. Ensure safe working practices are implemented along all phases of project

• 
Provide high level support services to ensure compliance with the Company Ethics and “Code of Conduct” policy, promote and enforce the Anti-Corruption Program within the Project

• 
Be responsible for all FEED umbilicals engineering activities and manage all FEED contractor technical activities related to his/her discipline

• 
Be responsible for preparation and timely delivery of the umbilical sub-system (2-off Dynamic Umbilicals and, 27-off static umbilicals) Call For Tender technical package of the SURF EPCI Contract, considering the impact of other SURF/FPSO/SPS sub-systems (Steel Lazy Wave Risers, FPSO mooring lines, future risers/umbilicals development) 

• 
Be responsible to review, fitness for purpose and compliance to Project and Company requirements of SURF Tenderers Technical offers. Lead the technical clarifications with Tenderers and ensure timely closing of Technical qualifications. Carry out Tenders technical evaluation and support for preparation of RTA technical part

• 
Define, develop, issue and maintain all necessary technical documentation related to the umbilicals design and installation activities. Support and participate to the development and maintenance of Project Management main documents (SOR, FDP, PEP, PQP, Risks, etc.)

• 
Ensure follow-up / review / validation of progress performed by SURF Contractor and its Suppliers with regards to his/her disciplines and analyze/report drifts that could occur and propose remedial solutions 

• 
The Service Holder shall proactively provide alternative designs or technical solutions whenever required, accounting for the various constraints of project packages, such as reducing as much as possible the hookup and in-place loads to minimize dynamic umbilicals fatigue, mitigate potential clashes with other SURF items (SLWR and mooring lines), assist the Installation Lead to optimize the SLWR/Umbilicals wet parking configurations and sub-sequent transfer activities to FPSO, assist SLWR Engineers in Orcaflex studies, etc… 

• 
Supervise and control the detailed engineering by timely reviewing the disciplines-related documentation issued by SURF Contractor (technical documentation / queries / derogation requests...), in order to ensure compliance with Project Specifications and Procedures (when applicable), international norms and standards with the objective to ensure respect of the schedule and to optimize costs without impacting required level of Quality and Safety 

• 
Raise consequently necessary comments and highlight unsafe design, deviations, unacceptable / unjustified design choices, constructability issues 

• 
Act, as technical referent vis-à-vis Contractor(s) for umbilicals matters, and follow-up the Suppliers providing equipment for the umbilicals, e.g.: bend stiffeners, bend stiffener latching mechanism, bend restrictors, buoyancy, VIV strakes… 

• 
Ensure technical compliance throughout the Project life of the engineered, procured, fabricated, tested and installed umbilicals. Ensure all technical, QA/QC and H3SE project policies and requirements are duly implemented and ensure Contractors’ compliance with contractual requirements in all areas. Anticipate and ensure adequate and timely reporting to the Technical Manager of any concern, issue or potential deviation. Propose timely and adequate solutions and optimizations

• 
Ensure that his/her work is in line with umbilicals specialists of Company Headquarters

• 
Liaise with other package teams (SPS, FPSO) for interface matters with the support of Interface Managers and leads

• 
Organize and participate to Project Reviews

• 
Assist and support the Technical Manager and the Subsea Manager on all aspects of the umbilicals activities related Call For Tender, Clarification & evaluation process, project execution and contracts management, and with the relations with Partners 

• 
Coordinate with other Team Members including the SURF contract engineer for the follow-up of correspondence and contract activities throughout the full CFT process and during Project Execution 

• 
Participate to the Installation Phase, tests, commissioning and handover, assisting when necessary, the Installation Leader during all the offshore work campaigns. 

• 
Gather ‘lessons learnt’ and provide feedback to Company entities as required. Assist in the formalization of the close-out report

Requirements:

• 
Master’s degree in engineering field

• 
Languages: English 

• 
At least 10 years in large offshore oil & gas SURF deep water projects

• 
Experience in umbilical design on EPCI projects. 

• 
Good knowledge of relevant codes (DNV) and Company General Specifications, procedures and policies is preferred

• 
Preferably, previous experience with Major SURF Contractors during project execution for deep water project and follow-up of the engineering and procurement of umbilicals

• 
Preferably, previous experience with Umbilical Manufacturing Supplier

• 
Positive, constructive, proactive and pragmatic mindset

• 
Ability to work within large teams with other parties (Contractors, suppliers, HQ technical teams, etc)

• 
Previous experience within a complex and multicultural working environment

To work with Erithy means:

• 
Working on exciting Norwegian energy projects.

• 
Fast-track your career as a consultant for one of our customers.

• 
We offer opportunities for permanent employment, where stability and personal development are the main focus.

• 
Access our network of consultants and customers, and expand your opportunities.

• 
In Erithy, we care and know our consultants on a personal level, and follow-up their progression.

Join Erithy now!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We are a company that specialize in consultancy services, bringing expertise in engineering, management, operations, and design.

In our operating model, the asset team is end-to-end accountable for technical and operational integrity, including barrier management, across all time horizons and in compliance with regulations and our management system. The discipline engineers in the team are multi-skilled, have close-to-full-time allocation to the asset, and are supported by the Portfolio Engineering team and subject matter experts for specialist and complex tasks. This is a senior role: the consultant will be expected to take full ownership of technical safety on the asset from day one, with minimal onboarding.

As Senior Technical Safety Asset Discipline Engineer you will be the asset's day-to-day point of contact for technical safety. You are responsible for the technical safety equipment on the asset and the associated performance standards, and for ensuring that barriers are maintained, monitored and followed up in line with the risk picture. You will be followed up by the Technical Safety & Barrier Management department, which provides peer support and quality assurance.

• 
Provide day-to-day technical safety support to the asset team and the offshore organisation.

• 
Own and follow up technical safety equipment and associated performance standards (e.g. fire and gas detection, emergency shutdown, firewater and deluge, passive fire protection, ignition source control, escape, evacuation and lifesaving equipment).

• 
Monitor barrier status, follow up degraded barriers and define robust compensating measures to maintain the safety level.

• 
Assess risk related to deviations, dispensations, temporary changes and reduced functionality of equipment, and handle cases in the relevant tools (e.g. Synergi).

• 
Follow up test and maintenance results for safety-critical equipment, including offshore participation in firewater and deluge tests, and contribute to performance standard compliance verification.

• 
Provide technical safety input to management of change, modifications and work orders, and participate in or facilitate HAZID, HAZOP and design reviews.

• 
Contribute to updates of risk analyses (TRA/QRA) and emergency preparedness analyses, and follow up resulting actions and assumptions in operation.

• 
Interface with Portfolio Engineering, technical safety SMEs, barrier management advisors and other disciplines, and support audits and supervisory activities from the authorities.

Requirements:

• 
MSc or BSc in engineering (e.g. safety, process, mechanical or similar).

• 
Minimum 10 years of experience within technical safety, of which at least 5 years from technical safety in operations of offshore installations, preferably on the Norwegian continental shelf.

• 
Good knowledge of the Norwegian regulations (Havtil) and relevant standards, e.g. NORSOK S-001, ISO 13702, IEC 61508/61511 and Offshore Norge Guideline 070.

• 
Proven experience with barrier management in operation, including ownership of performance standards, follow-up of degraded barriers and definition of compensating measures.

• 
Fluent in Norwegian and English, written and spoken.

• 
Documented ability to work independently and take full ownership of technical safety for an operating asset from day one, without an extended onboarding period.

Valid offshore safety course and health certificate, or willingness to obtain them, and willingness to travel offshore.

•

• 
Experience from FPSO or production installations on the Norwegian continental shelf.

• 
Experience as discipline engineer or technical safety responsible in an operator's asset or operations organisation.

Personal qualities:

Experienced and confident, with the credibility to make and justify technical safety decisions independently in a busy operational environment.

• 
Communicates clearly with offshore personnel, discipline engineers and management alike.

• 
Proactive and collaborative, with a genuine interest in safety and continuous improvement

jobs.occupation: PhD on modelling thermal cracking of oxides to reuse aluminium powder in 3D printing
jobs.description:
This is NTNU
NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   
Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position
Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia.

A PhD position within the frame of the European project AlproCam (with NTNU, Brunel University, Technische Universitat Clausthal, Phoenix Scientific Industries, Acondicionamiento Tarrasense Associacion) is offered at the Department of Materials Science and Engineering. The funding is 3 years.

Your immediate Line Manager will be the Head of Department.
About the project
Currently, when aluminum powder is used in 3D printing, it degrades and develops a crusty outer layer, making it difficult to reuse. Instead of throwing it away or using harsh chemicals and extreme energy to clean it, the European AlproCam project uses a physical approach that allows to restoring old, used aluminum powder back to perfect, brand-new quality. The goal is to eliminate the need for toxic chemicals, save energy, and open the door to fully recycling aluminum and other metals in modern manufacturing. The ALPROCAM project aims at making additive manufacturing products more sustainable, cheaper and environmentally friendly. 

The PhD position will focus on modelling the thermal expansion and cracking of powder used for the 3D printing. Crystal plasticity and continuum plasticity models in finite element software will be adapted and used. 

The work will include collaboration with European partners and a researcher at NTNU who will perform material characterization and testing. 
Duties of the position
• Complete doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
• Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
• Academic publications and popular science dissemination
• Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutionsRequired selection criteria
• Strong background with experience with numerical/mathematical modelling and simulations of continuum and preferable also crystal plasticity using finite element software.
• You must have a Master's degree in Materials Science and Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics or equivalent. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, where 120 credits have been obtained at master's level. Master's students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
• You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker grade background, you may be considered if you can document that you are particularly suitable for a PhD education.
• You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme (https://www.ntnu.edu/nv/phd), see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
• Experience with model implementation/programming in Fortran, C/C++, Python or similar computer languages.
• Good written and oral English language and communication skills. 
The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.
Preferred selection criteria
• An educational background which also includes hands-on experience with crystal and/or continuum plasticity models and finite element method simulations.
• Competence related to fracture and damage modelling.Personal characteristics
• Creativity, with a strong ability to work goal-oriented and independently.
• Good skills to deliver oral and written presentations of research results.
• He/she should also enjoy interdisciplinary research and take keen interest in working in project teams.
Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.
We offer
Evaluate and remove/add what is relevant for the position.

• An exciting job with an important mission in society
• Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
• Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
• Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
• Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
• training during working hours and company sports at NTNU
• As a public employee, you have favourable benefits as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)  
• Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)
As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.
Diversity
Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.
Salary and conditions
In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Materials Science and Engineering (https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/phmt) within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.
About the application
The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in English. 

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

• Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
• CV and certificates
• Copy of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
• A cover letter describing your motivation for the position, a summary of scientific experience and how the applicant sees their background as suitable (1-2 pages max).
• Applicants from non-English-speaking countries outside Europe must document English skills by an approved test. Approved tests are TOEFL, IELTS and Cambridge Certificate in Advanced English (CAE) or Cambridge Certificate of Proficiency in English (CPE)
• A copy of the master's thesis. If you recently have submitted your master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
• Name and contact information of three referees
• If you have publications or other relevant research work
If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).
General information
A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Professor Bjørn Holmedal +47 90084946, email bjorn.holmedal@ntnu.no, or Assoc. Professor Tomas Manik, e-mail tomas.manik@ntnu.no.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR consultant Marie Kristiansen, email: mare.kristiansen@ntnu.no. 

Application deadline: 13.12.2026

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. Will You Help Us Bring the Future to the Table?
We think you might.

If you’re hungry to make an impact- to move quickly, build smart, and help shape the future of an entire industry- you might be exactly who we’re looking for.

At Munu, we’re on a mission to transform how restaurants and bars run, grow, and thrive. We blend a deep love for food and tech with bold ambition — creating tools that simplify operations, elevate guest experiences, and empower hospitality teams to perform at their best.

We move fast- and we mean it. We’d rather try something, learn from it, and improve, than sit on the fence for too long. You’ll feel that from day one.

We challenge ideas, not people. We share wins. And because we work directly with restaurants every day, you’ll see the real-world impact of what you build.

If you like what you read, pull up a chair.
About the Role
When a venue’s tills stop, the evening doesn’t wait. As a Helpdesk Agent at Munu, you’re the first voice restaurants and bars hear when something isn’t working, and your job is to get them back to trading, fast.

You’ll handle first-line calls, tickets and chats from venues across Norway, Sweden, Denmark and Finland. You’ll solve what can be solved at first contact, escalate cleanly what can’t, and help reduce how many problems reach us in the first place.

You’ll work closely with our Product Support & Quality Specialists, who pick up your escalations; our Account Managers, whose customers you’re helping; and our Hardware & Logistics Specialist, on hardware faults and replacements.
Your Mission, Should You Choose to Accept It
• 
Answer and resolve first-line calls, tickets and chats from venues across our Nordic markets, getting it right at first contact wherever you can.

• 
Get to the real problem: establish what’s happening, how urgent it is for the customer’s service, and whether first line can fix it.

• 
Escalate a diagnosed problem, along with what you’ve already tried, rather than a forwarded message, and raise potential major incidents to the Helpdesk Manager without delay.

• 
Keep customers informed while an issue is being resolved by someone else.

• 
Help reduce what arrives: guide customers to our self-service and help content, and flag recurring questions and missing or incorrect help content, with evidence, to our specialists and Product Managers.

Keep accurate ticket records in Zendesk and make handovers easy for colleagues to pick up.

• 
Work to a rota that follows the hours venues trade, which may include shifts outside normal office hours, plus occasional travel for team gatherings, training and venue visits.
You’ll Thrive in This Role If You…
• 
Stay calm and friendly with a customer whose venue can’t trade.

• 
Ask the right questions to find the real problem before acting.

• 
Own a case until it’s resolved or cleanly handed over.

Write clear, accurate notes that a colleague can pick up without asking.

Have experience in customer support or customer service (for example first-line support, retail or hospitality), including troubleshooting technical or operational problems for customers under time pressure.

Have completed upper secondary education or a trade certificate, or at least 2 years of experience in customer service, customer support or hospitality.

Have experience with at least one of: supporting customers by phone, ticket or chat; POS or other systems used in restaurants and bars; hardware such as payment terminals, printers, kitchen displays or in-venue networks; or onboarding and training customers on new systems.

Communicate professionally in English, spoken and written. You’ll work across every function and with customers in several countries.

Use approved AI tools in your daily work, check what they produce, and protect customer data.

Have worked in hospitality operations, such as a restaurant, bar or hotel.

• 
Have experience with POS or payment systems.

Speak Norwegian and more than one Scandinavian language, since contacts come from venues across the Nordics.

Have used Zendesk or a similar ticketing system.

• 
Have spotted recurring issues or gaps in help content and done something about it.

• 
Have built an AI-supported routine or tool that colleagues use.
What Success Looks Like

Most of your contacts are resolved at first line, and they stay resolved.

• 
Customers get answers quickly, and they rate your service well. Speed only counts when customers are served well.

Your escalations are accepted by second line first time, with nothing missing.

• 
Recurring questions get fewer, because customers know where to find help and gaps in help content get fixed.
What Makes This Opportunity Different
• 
You’ll grow with us. This role has real room to develop- into product support, implementation, or hardware and logistics, or towards handling our most complex contacts and helping train colleagues. You don’t need to have it all figured out from day one; we’ll help you get there.

You’ll be part of a company with deep industry knowledge and a mission that matters- empowering hospitality teams with better tools.

You’ll shape how a core business function is built- not just follow a playbook. We’re at a stage where your input genuinely changes how things work.

You’ll work with smart, kind, ambitious people across the Nordics- the kind who disagree openly, share the credit, and don’t take themselves too seriously.

You’ll have the freedom to test, fail, learn, and try again- with the support and tools to do your best work.

jobs.occupation: PhD Candidate in Intelligent Navigation and Risk Based Route Planning
jobs.description:
This is NTNU
NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   
Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position
The PhD position is part of the Norwegian Maritime AI Centre, led by NTNU. The centre brings together researchers, industry and public partners to develop AI applications for the maritime sector. 

The PhD project will develop AI methods for navigational situational awareness and risk-based route planning, with applications in safe navigation and wind-assisted propulsion. A key question is how maritime data can be used to assess navigational risk and inform route and speed choices, accounting for vessel capabilities and uncertainty in the available information. 

The work will draw on two of the center's use cases: AI-driven S-100 electronic navigational chart products (UC3) and wind-assisted propulsion (UC5).

UC3 concerns the use of electronic navigational chart data to assess hazards along a vessel’s path. The use case will investigate how these assessments can account for the vessel’s position and motion, together with characteristics such as draught, stopping distance and maneuvering capabilities. Historical AIS tracks combined with chart data offer a basis for constructing and studying navigational situations. It is also a goal of the use case that these assessments should be explainable. That is, it should be possible to trace a warning or recommendation to the data and criteria that produced it.

In UC5, the focus is on route and speed planning for vessels with wind-assisted propulsion. Taking advantage of wind conditions can reduce fuel consumption, but the benefits depend on the vessel’s performance and the route it can safely follow. The use case will investigate both how forecasts of wind and other environmental conditions can be used in voyage planning, accounting for navigational and operational constraint, and how adaptations can be made underway, accounting for actual conditions. 

The two use cases link the assessment of individual navigational situations to planning over a longer voyage. The project will examine how uncertainty in data and forecasts affects these decisions, and how plans can be revised as conditions change. Method development will build on machine learning in combination with established models of vessel behavior and navigation. The choice of methods will be developed as part of the doctoral work.

The candidate will work closely with industry and public partners in the centre.

The PhD candidate will be supervised by Associate Professor Børge Rokseth.
About the project
DThe Norwegian Maritime AI Centre shall position the maritime sector for accelerated and successful use of AI. The demand for safe and sustainable maritime activities, as well as the shortage of crew and engineers, are key drivers for change in the maritime sector. At the same time, there is a pull for growth, increased efficiency and profitability, while managing volatility in the markets. Moreover, the sector is critically important for global supply chains and security in a tense geopolitical situation. To demonstrate and prototype maritime AI solutions, the center will address a diverse and impactful set of use cases: Logistics, shipping and business transactions; Ship design and construction; Voyage planning and optimization; Condition monitoring and maintenance; Crew training; Maritime traffic and ship surveillance; Decarbonization and energy management; Autonomous ships and remote control. 

The research partners are the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU), University of Oslo, Oslo School of Architecture and Design, Royal Norwegian Naval Academy, Norwegian Mapping Authority, MET and SINTEF Nordvest. There are about 30 user partners from the maritime sector, in addition to hundreds of members of the Maritime Forum, Blue Maritime, Ocean Autonomy, and Maritime CleanTech clusters. The center will be a hub, orchestrating the interfaces with research partners and user partners to facilitate collaboration, knowledge creation, dissemination, innovation, and sharing of knowledge. The Norwegian Maritime AI Center is funded by the Research Council of Norway and the partners for the period 2026-2030. There will be approximately 25 doctoral scholarships and some postdoc positions. More information can be found here: https://www.ntnu.edu/mai 
Duties of the position
• Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
• Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
• Academic publications and popular science dissemination
• Participate in the Norwegian Maritime AI Centre activities 
• Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions
• Other career-promoting work can be discussed and agreed
Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.
Required selection criteria
• You must have a strong foundation in engineering cybernetics, including mathematical modelling, dynamical systems and control theory, together with competence in machine learning. This background must be documented through relevant coursework and project or thesis work.
• You must have good programming skills and experience implementing and evaluating mathematical models or computational methods in Python, MATLAB, C++ or a comparable programming language.
• You must have a Master's degree in engineering cybernetics, robotics, control engineering, applied mathematics, or another closely related discipline. Applicants with degrees in other engineering disciplines or informatics must document an equivalent background in the subjects specified above. Your course of study must correspond to a five-year Norwegian course, including 120 credits at master's level. Master's students may apply, but the degree must be completed and documented before starting the position.
• You must have a strong academic background from your previous studies and an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If your previous studies were not assessed using letter grades, you must demonstrate an equally strong academic foundation. Applicants with a weaker grade background may be considered if they can document that they are particularly suitable for PhD education.
• You must meet the requirements for admission to the PhD program in Engineering Cybernetics.
• You must have good written and oral English language skills. If your native language is not English or a Scandinavian language, you must document your English proficiency, for example through TOEFL. 
The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.
Preferred selection criteria
• Knowledge of maritime navigation, vessel dynamics or maritime risk assessment.
• Experience with simulation-based evaluation, uncertainty modelling or risk-based decision-making.Personal characteristics
To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

• Work in interdisciplinary teams with researchers, industry and government.

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 
Salary and conditions

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work. 

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD program in Engineering Cybernetics within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral program through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.
