jobs.description:
Om stillingen
Ved Universitetet i Agder, Fakultet for helse- og idrettsvitenskap er det ledig en 100% stilling som postdoktor i idrettsvitenskap, tilknyttet Institutt for idrettsvitenskap og kroppsøving, for en periode på tre, eventuelt fire år. Arbeidssted er for tiden Campus Kristiansand. Tiltredelse etter avtale med fakultetet.

Fakultetet har fem institutter: Institutt for ernæring og folkehelse, Institutt for helse- og sykepleievitenskap, Institutt for idrettsvitenskap og kroppsøving, Institutt for psykologi og Institutt for psykososial helse. Postdoktorstillingen vil være tilknyttet forskningsgruppen PAHLS (Physical Activity and Health across the LifeSpan). I tillegg har instituttet forskningsgruppene SPADE (Sport Performance and Development Environments) og ROPE (Research in Outdoor Education and Physical Education).
Arbeidsoppgaver
I samarbeid med nasjonale og internasjonale forskningsinstitusjoner, kreftforeningen, rehabiliteringsinstitusjon og flere kommuner på Agder, og basert på erfaringer gjort i LETSGO-forskningsprosjekt (Lifestyle and Empowerment Techniques in Survivorship of Gynecologic Oncology - Universitetet i Agder), skal det utvikles en digital smarttelefonapplikasjon (app) med tilhørende opplæringsmodul. Denne skal utvikles sammen med brukere (individer berørt av kreft, helsearbeidere) og inneholde ulike fysisk aktivitets- og treningskomponenter. Videre skal denne implementeres i flere frisklivssentraler i kommuner på Agder. Vi skal evaluere implementeringen av denne. Deretter skal det lages en plan for hvordan app og opplæringsmodul kan rulles ut til alle landets kommuner. 

Den som ansettes vil sammen med prosjektleder ha ansvar for å utvikle studieprotokoll, kvalitetssikring av datainnsamling, harmonisering av data og koordinering av prosjektsamarbeidet mellom de involverte aktører involvert i prosjekter. Vedkommende skal også ha et spesielt ansvar for utviklingen av applikasjonen (sammen med andre forskere ved UiA samt UiAs IT-avdeling) samt implementeringsdelen i prosjektet. I tillegg skal det skrives forskningsartikler på allerede innsamlede og kommende data innenfor fagfeltet fysisk aktivitet/trening ved kreftsykdom. Det forventes at den aktuelle postdoktoren skal drive selvstendig forskning innen rammene for det nevnte prosjektet. Dersom det er aktuelt med undervisning/veiledning legges det også til rette for at kandidaten kan følge kurs i universitetspedagogikk (UniPed). Det er også ønskelig at kandidaten følger karriereutviklingsprogram alla postdoktorprogram. Den som tilsettes i stillingen vil få én faglig veileder.

Doktorgrad i idrettsvitenskap eller fagområde med relevans for utlysningen. Aktuelle søkere må ha fått godkjent avhandlingen innen søknadsfristen

Arbeidsspråket ved Universitetet i Agder er norsk. Den som ansettes må beherske norsk eller et annet skandinavisk språk, skriftlig og muntlig. Det kreves gode kunnskaper i engelsk, skriftlig og muntlig.

• Erfaring med bruk av bevegelsesmålere-/sensorer (aktivitetsmålere, pulsklokker m.m.) i prosjekter
• God teknologisk innsikt; blant annet bruk av smarttelefonapplikasjoner i forskning

• Medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse
Mer om UiA som arbeidsplass.

Stillingen lønnes etter Statens lønnsregulativ lønnsplan 17.510, kode 1352 postdoktor, kr. 690 000 – 750 000 brutto pr år. For spesielt godt kvalifiserte søkere kan høyere lønn vurderes. Fra lønnen går det lovfestet innskudd til Statens pensjonskasse. 
Generell informasjon
UiA er et åpent og inkluderende universitet. Vi har tro på at mangfold beriker arbeidsplassen og gjør oss bedre. Vi oppfordrer derfor kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke uavhengig av kjønn, alder, kulturell bakgrunn, nedsatt funksjonsevne eller “hull i CV-en". 

Kvinner oppfordres spesielt til å søke stillingen. 

Den som ansettes, har rettigheter og plikter etter de retningslinjer som til enhver tid gjelder for stillingen. Ansettelse foretas av Ansettelsesutvalget for undervisnings- og forskerstillinger ved Universitetet i Agder. 

Aktuelle kandidater vil bli innkalt til intervju. Det vil også bli innhentet referanser etter nærmere avtale med søkeren. Det kan bli foretatt bakgrunnssjekk for å verifisere opplysninger som kommer frem av tilgjengelige dokumenter. Bakgrunnssjekk skjer alltid med søkerens samtykke, og ansettelse i stillingen forutsetter godkjent bakgrunnssjekk. Aktuelle søkere vil motta nærmere informasjon om dette. Mer om ansettelsesprosessen.  

I henhold til offentlighetsloven § 25, 2.ledd kan søker be om ikke å bli oppført på den offentlige søkerlista. Universitetet kan likevel beslutte at navnet på søkeren skal offentliggjøres. Søker vil bli varslet i forkant ved eventuell offentliggjøring. 
Søknad
Søknaden og nødvendige opplysninger om utdanning og erfaring (inkludert vitnemål og attester) sendes elektronisk, benytt linken "Søk stillingen".

Følgende må lastes opp elektronisk:

• Vitnemål med karakterer
• Liste over publikasjoner
• Doktorgradsavhandlingen
• Eventuelt maksimalt 10 vitenskapelige arbeider og FoU-virksomhet som vedkommende vil ha tillagt særlig vekt ved bedømmelsen
Søkeren har selv ansvar for å levere fullstendig dokumentasjon digitalt innen søknadsfristen. All dokumentasjon må foreligge på et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk.

Søknadsfrist: 2. desember 2026.
Kontaktinformasjon

For spørsmål om søknadsprosessen:

Universitetet i Agder har over 1500 ansatte og nesten 14 000 studenter. Det gjør oss til en av Sørlandets største arbeidsplasser. Våre ansatte forsker, underviser og formidler kunnskap fra alle sine fagområder.Universitetet holder til på to moderne campuser i Kristiansand og Grimstad.

jobs.occupation: Associate Professor in Population Genetics and Plant Breeding
jobs.employer_name: NORGES MILJØ- OG BIOVITENSKAPELIGE UNIVERSITET (NMBU) CAMPUS ÅS
jobs.description:
About the position
Be part of the future with NMBU!

The Department of Plant Sciences (IPV), Faculty of Biosciences, at the Norwegian University of Life Sciences (NMBU) has a vacancy for a permanent 100% position as Associate Professor in Population Genetics and Plant Breeding.

We are looking for an ambitious researcher and dedicated educator to strengthen NMBU's internationally recognized research and education in plant genetics, population genetics, and plant breeding with a focus on forage crops. This position represents a strategic investment in one of the department's core academic disciplines and will play a key role in educating the next generation of plant breeders and geneticists while advancing research that contributes to sustainable agriculture and future food security.

The successful candidate is expected to establish an internationally competitive research group within population genetics and plant breeding, with particular emphasis on quantitative genetics, breeding methodologies, genomics, genetic diversity, and the breeding of outcrossing crops. As part of our academic team, you will teach and supervise Bachelor, Master, and PhD students, contribute to attracting competitive national and international research funding, and strengthen collaborations with breeding companies, research institutes, and universities in Norway and abroad. 
 
You will play a leading role in further developing our educational portfolio within genetics and plant breeding and contribute to innovative teaching methods and student-active learning.

The successful candidate will become part of a highly interdisciplinary research environment with close collaboration across the Department of Plant Sciences, the Faculty of Biosciences, and other faculties at NMBU. The position also offers opportunities to contribute to interdisciplinary initiatives in population genetics, genomics, breeding methodologies, and climate-resilient agriculture, supporting both plant and animal science communities.

We are proud to educate highly skilled graduates and to conduct research with a strong societal impact. We are looking for candidates who combine scientific excellence with a passion for teaching, collaboration, and innovation. We look forward to welcoming a new colleague who will help shape the future of genetics and plant breeding at NMBU.
Main tasks
The successful candidate is expected to

• Conduct research of the highest international standard and strengthen research in population genetics, genomics, genomic selection, breeding methodologies, and climate-resilient crop development.
• Publish regularly in peer-reviewed international journals.
• Contribute to both basic and applied research.
• Secure external funding from national and international funding agencies, including Horizon Europe and the Research Council of Norway.
• Supervise PhD, MSc and BSc students.
• Contribute to innovation and collaboration with industry and breeding organization. 
• Network and collaborate within and outside NMBU and actively participate in interdisciplinary research initiatives across NMBU.
• Contribute to the strategic development of plant genetics and breeding activities at the department.
• Develop and deliver high-quality teaching in population genetics, plant breeding, quantitative genetics, genomics, and bioinformatics for plant breeding across Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD programmes.
• Contribute to educational excellence through student supervision, curriculum development, pedagogical innovation, and the implementation of research-based teaching and modern digital learning approaches.
• Conduct administrative tasks and other joint tasks at the faculty in collaboration with colleagues and students.Competence
All qualifications below are required for the position, unless it is specified that they are considered an advantage. 

Academic qualifications:

• A PhD in Plant Breeding, Population Genetics, Plant Science, or other fields related to the described position.
• Ability to develop and lead internationally recognized research within the subject area.
• Competence and experience with genetic research on forage crops.
• Experience in planning and conducting field experiments.
• Documented research output / publication record such as international peer-reviewed publications in relevant scientific journals, books, and research reports within population genetics and plant breeding.
• Experience with research relevant to Nordic agricultural conditions is considered an advantage
• Experience with research leadership is considered as an advantage
Educational qualifications (documented):

• Pedagogical education completed separate program at minimum 200 hours*.
• Teaching experience from higher education.
• Supervision experience.
• Basic teaching skills in planning, implementing, evaluating and development of own teaching and supervision.
• Experience with educational leadership is considered an advantage.*Those who do not meet the educational qualification at the time of employment shall be required to meet them within two years of employment.
Applied knowledge, among others

• Experience with dissemination is considered an advantage.
• Experience with industry collaboration is considered as an advantage.
Management, committees and boards and administration, among others

• Experience with management, committees and boards and administration is considered an advantage.
Special qualifications, among others

• Good written and oral communication skills in a Norwegian (or another Scandinavian language) and English is a prerequisite for performing the duties of the position.
Personal qualities, among others

• Outstanding collaborative and communicative skills both to the scientific community and to a broader community.
• Strong, professional commitment to excellence in teaching.
• Ability to realize scientific synergies between individual researchers and research groups.
• Strong potential for independent thinking displaying initiative and careful creative thought.
• Experience with building and maintaining a productive and energized research group.Remuneration and further information
The position is placed in position code 1011 Associate Professor (NOK 720 000 – 1 100 000) depending on qualifications. For particularly well-qualified applicants, a higher salary may be considered. Seniority promotion in the position. 
 
Interested in learning more about the position? We are happy to tell you more about life on campus. Contact Section leader and researcher Sahameh Shafiee, tel:  +4767232769, (e-mail: sahameh.shafiee@nmbu.no). 

General information for applicants
Application
Send application electronically via the link "Apply for this job" at the top of this page. 

Application Deadline: : November 20th, 2026

Your CV must be entered in Jobbnorge's CV form and not just included as an attachment. This is in order to be able to comply with the regulations in the Public Administration Act §15.

The following must be included in the application:

• Short application text about your motivation
• Reflective statement (3–6 pages) addressing your reflections on the requirements of the position (see the job advertisement).
• Academic CV, diplomas and certificates
• Completed template for documentation of competence, link to template here.
• List of publications. Attach up to 15 scientific works that, according to assessment, are central to the production. If it is difficult to identify personal efforts in joint work, a brief account of your part of the work must be attached. 
NMBU has developed a matrix for assessing qualifications, which provides examples of results/competence, documentation, and reflection for all areas of the competence profile. We encourage you to familiarize yourself with the matrix and use it when applying for the position. See this page for more information on how to document your qualifications and write a reflection note.

Documents that cannot be sent electronically are sent in triplicate by ordinary mail marked still.nr. 26/09329 to NMBU, Faculty of Biosciences, P.O. Box 5003, NO-1432 Ås, within 20.11.2026.

Please note that the report from the expert committee will be sent to all applicants.
About The Faculty of Biosciences
The Faculty of Biosciences (BIOVIT) aims to shape the future of food and bioproduction through teaching and research in biology and sustainable production and use of plants, livestock and fish. The faculty has a large project portfolio and an annual turnover of approximately NOK 250 million. 

BIOVIT is organized into seven research groups: Genome Biology, Breeding, Genetics and Food Production Systems, Ruminant Nutrition and Physiology, Ethology and Animal Welfare, Nutrition and Physiology for Monogastric Animals, Plant Biology, Sustainable Food Systems and Integrated Plant Protection, and Genetics, Evolution and Sustainable Plant Production. Additionally, the faculty has seven research support and laboratory units.

BIOVIT is responsible for bachelor’s and master’s programs in aquaculture, biology, animal science, and plant science, as well as English-language master’s programs in Agroecology, Plant Sciences, Feed Manufacturing Technology, and Genome Sciences. BIOVIT also offers Ph.D. programs in animal science and plant science. Currently, the faculty has about 550 bachelor’s and master’s students and 90 Ph.D. students. BIOVIT employs approximately 230 staff members and has its own faculty administration.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NMBU will contribute to securing the future of life through outstanding research, education, communication and innovation. We have the country's most satisfied university students, who receive research-based education in a unique student environment. Our graduates gain a high level of competence in interdisciplinary collaboration and are popular in the labor market.

NMBU has internationally leading research environments in several subjects. Together with our partners in society and business, we contribute to solving some of the biggest societal challenges of our time. We focus on innovation, communication and entrepreneurship because we believe these challenges are best solved with joint efforts. We believe that a good working environment is characterized by diversity.If necessary, workplace adaptations will be made for persons with disabilities. More information about NMBU is available at www.nmbu.no/en

jobs.occupation: Stipendiater i samfunnssikkerhet, undergrunn anvendelser og romlig analyse
jobs.description:
Om stillingen
Universitetet i Stavanger har ledig to stillinger som stipendiat i samfunnssikkerhet, undergrunns anvendelser og romlig analyse ved Det teknisk- naturvitenskapelige fakultet, Institutt for sikkerhet, økonomi og planlegging.

Stipendiatstillingen leder fram til doktorgrad og gir mulighet til å utvikle forskningskompetanse i et aktivt og stimulerende fagmiljø. Gjennom doktorgradsutdanningen opparbeider du kunnskap, ferdigheter og erfaring som kvalifiserer for videre karriere innenfor forskning, høyere utdanning og andre kunnskapsintensive sektorer.

Den som ansettes tas opp på doktorgradsprogrammet i teknologi og naturvitenskap. Programmet omfatter en opplæringsdel, arbeid med en vitenskapelig avhandling basert på selvstendig forskning, deltakelse i nasjonale og internasjonale forskermiljø, forskningsformidling, prøveforelesning og disputas. Les mer om forskerutdanningen ved UiS på våre nettsider.
 
Stillingen er for tre år med ren forskerutdanning.

Som stipendiat ved UiS får du støtte til faglig og karrieremessig utvikling gjennom veiledning, kompetanseutvikling og karriereplanlegging.

Stillingen er finansiert av Norges forskningsråd.
Forskningstema
Stipendiatene vil være tilknyttet Research Centre for Innovative and Sustainable Underground Use (CISU), et Senter for forskningsdrevet innovasjon (SFI) finansiert av Norges forskningsråd. CISU er et trippel helix-samarbeid mellom ledende forskningsinstitusjoner, industripartnere og offentlige virksomheter, og adresserer presserende samfunnsutfordringer: fortetting av byer, klimaendringer, geopolitisk ustabilitet og behovet for mer robuste byer.

Kjerneoppgaven i denne stillingen er kartlegging og analyse av undergrunnen i én av pilotbyene — Stavanger og Trondheim, samt Tromsø — med geografisk informasjonsvitenskap som primært metodisk grunnlag. Prosjektene er lokalisert i Trondheim eller Stavanger (en i hver by), og har ansvaret for kartleggingen av hver sine byer, samt prosjektene samarbeider om kartleggingen av Tromsø. På denne måten etableres eksempelstudier som både vil gi anledning for komparative analyser og mer enhetlige analyser av pilotbyene ut fra byenes datamateriale knyttet til samfunnskritiske funksjoner. Studentene vil jobbe tett sammen med byene. Eksisterende datamateriale, så som GIS-kart og databaser, geologiske data (jord, bergarter og grunnvann), eksisterende infrastrukturer og kritiske samfunnsfunksjoner, relevante hendelser, med mer, vil bli systematisk analysert, utvidet, videreutviklet, integrert og vurdert opp mot byenes planleggingsverdier og muligheter for å flytte funksjoner under bakken. Arbeidet kan også benytte komplementære romlige teknologier som digitale tvillinger, fotogrammetri og romlig modellering.

Med utgangspunkt i dette GIS-grunnlaget vil kandidatene kontinuerlig delta på samskapningsarenaer med brukerpartnerne i CISU for å utvikle forskningsretninger innenfor CISU-konteksten. 

Kandidatenes parallelle prosjekter muliggjør direkte sammenligning og kunnskapsoverføring på tvers av urbane kontekster. Begge kandidatene vil inngå i SFI-CISU, som i løpet av senterperioden vil ha minst 13 PhD-stipendiater som arbeider med innovasjonsprosjekter på tvers av de tre pilotbyene, med støtte fra et dedikert PHD-forum i SFI-CISU og et tverrfaglig veiledningsteam fra akademia og industri. Det er muligheter for internasjonale forskningsopphold og samarbeid som del av phd-studiet (noen alternative steder er Singapore, Helsinki og Sveits).

Stipendiaten vil bidra til å besvare følgende preliminære forskningsspørsmål i senteret:

• RQ1: I hvilken grad er de nøyaktige plasseringene og den tekniske tilstanden til eksisterende underjordisk infrastruktur kjent?
• RQ2: I hvilken grad kan transformasjon av eksisterende infrastruktur støtte kritiske samfunnsfunksjoner i fremtiden?
• RQ3: I hvilken grad kan systematisk bruk av undergrunnen støtte bærekraftig byutvikling i nullutslippssamfunnet?
• RQ4: Hvordan kan underjordisk romlig planlegging integreres i byutvikling og infrastrukturstrategier?Prosjektskisse
Som søker skal du utarbeide en prosjektskisse for et doktorgradsprosjekt innenfor det beskrevne forskningstemaet

Prosjektskissen, som ikke bør være på mer enn to sider, skal redegjøre for prosjektets problemstilling, relevans, samt teoretisk og metodisk tilnærming. Skissen vil inngå i kompetansevurderingen.
Kvalifikasjoner
Du må ha en sterk faglig bakgrunn med femårig mastergrad innen geografisk informasjon, ingeniørgeologi, teknisk sikkerhet, risikostyring, samfunnssikkerhet, byplanlegging eller annet nærliggende fagområde, eller tilsvarende utdanning som gir grunnlag for å gjennomføre en forskerutdanning. Utdanningen bør fortrinnsvis være av nyere dato. Dersom du fullfører mastergraden våren 2027 er du også velkommen til å søke.

Karakter på masteroppgaven og veid gjennomsnittskarakter for masterstudiet må begge tilsvare B eller bedre. Dersom du har utdanning fra en institusjon med annen karakterskala enn A-F, ber vi deg legge ved dokumentasjon som viser hvordan karakterene kan sammenliknes med den norske karakterskalaen. Du kan bruke disse konverteringsskalaene til å beregne poengene dine for opptak.

Det er en fordel om du :

• har teoretisk og anvendt kunnskap om geografisk informasjonsvitenskap og romlig analyse
• har erfaring eller faglig kunnskap om norske planleggingssystemer (bykommuner)
• har erfaring med GIS-verktøy og programvare, og med digitale romlige teknologier 
Vi legger også vekt på at du:

• har høy faglig integritet og fokus på kvalitet i arbeidet
• er nysgjerrig og motivert for å gjennomføre forskningsprosjektet og bidra til faglige fellesskap og samarbeid på tvers av fagområder
• har potensial for forskning innenfor fagfeltet, samt personlige forutsetninger for å fullføre doktorgradsutdanningen innen ansettelsesperioden
• kan arbeide godt både selvstendig og i samarbeid med andre forskere
• har evne til kritisk refleksjon, nytenkning og selvstendig problemløsning, arbeider strukturert og målrettet
• har gode samarbeids- og kommunikasjonsevner og bidrar til et konstruktivt arbeidsmiljø.
• har gode ferdigheter i engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig.
Arbeidet ved SFI-CISU vil kunne omfatte håndtering av skjermingsverdig informasjon. For å være aktuell for stillingen må du derfor kunne autoriseres for BEGRENSET, jf. sikkerhetsloven § 8-9. Autorisasjon forutsetter at du oppfyller vilkårene for å få tilgang til skjermingsverdig informasjon på dette nivået. Nærmere retningslinjer vil bli gitt etter hvert som senteret etableres og aktivitetene konkretiseres.
Krav til engelskkunnskaper
Gode ferdigheter i engelsk, både skriftlig og muntlig, er en forutsetning for opptak til doktorgradsprogrammet. 

Dersom du er internasjonal søker og ikke omfattes av fritaksordningene nedenfor, må du dokumentere engelskkunnskapene dine med et gyldig resultat fra én av følgende språktester:

• TOEFL – Test of English as a Foreign Language, Internet-Based Test (IBT). Minimum resultat: 90/4.5
• IELTS – International English Language Testing Service. Minimum resultat: 6.5
• Certificate in Advanced English (CAE) eller Certificate of Proficiency in English (CPE) fra Universitetet i Cambridge
• PTE Academic – Pearson Test of English Academic. Minimum resultat: 62
Du er fritatt fra kravet dersom du:

• har fullført minst ett års universitetsstudier i Australia, Canada, Irland, New Zealand, Storbritannia, USA
• har fullført en mastergrad med engelsk som undervisningsspråk i et EU-/EØS-land eller i India
• er fritatt i henhold til HK-dirs GSU liste
• ikke inngår i de ovennevnte unntakskategoriene, men har bodd i Norge de siste fem åreneSom stipendiat ved UiS får du
• forskerutdanning ved et universitet med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag
• et ambisiøst og inkluderende forskningsmiljø
• veiledning og støtte til faglig og karrieremessig utvikling
• gratis norskkurs dersom du ikke behersker norsk, svensk eller dansk på minimum A2-nivå ved ansettelse
• tilgang til Lifekeys, en digital tjeneste for mental helse og livskvalitet
• lønn som stipendiat etter Statens lønnsregulativ i stillingskode 1017, kr 580.000 brutto pr år, med lønnsutvikling etter ansiennitet i stillingen. 
• medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse med gode pensjons- og forsikringsordninger
Les mer om ansattgoder og fordeler på uis.no.
Mangfold og inkludering
Mangfold er en styrke ved universitetet. Ulike erfaringer, perspektiver og bakgrunner bidrar til bedre løsninger og et godt arbeids- og læringsmiljø. Vi ønsker søkere med ulike kvalifikasjoner, livserfaringer og perspektiver, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke, uavhengig av kjønn, alder, funksjonsevne, kulturell bakgrunn eller om du har hatt opphold i arbeidslivet. UiS legger til rette for ansatte i ulike livsfaser og for medarbeidere med behov for individuell tilrettelegging. 
 
I tråd med gjeldende regelverk vil minst én kvalifisert søker med funksjonsnedsettelse, hull i CV-en eller innvandrerbakgrunn bli invitert til intervju. Dersom dette gjelder deg, kan du oppgi det i jobbsøkerportalen. Les mer om ordningen her.  

Universitetet ønsker bedre kjønnsbalanse i stipendiatstillinger innenfor fagområdet og oppfordrer derfor særlig kvinner til å søke. Ved tilnærmet like kvalifikasjoner kan kvinner bli prioritert i samsvar med gjeldende regelverk.
Slik søker du
Søk stillingen via "Søk stillingen" på denne siden. 

I Jobbnorge registrerer du søknad, relevant utdanning og arbeidserfaring samt språkferdigheter. I søknaden ber vi deg beskrive dine forskningsinteresser, din motivasjon for stillingen og hvordan din bakgrunn er relevant for forskningsprosjektet.

Følgende dokumentasjon skal lastes opp som vedlegg til søknaden:

• prosjektskisse
• CV med fullstendig oversikt over utdanning, erfaring og eventuell vitenskapelig virksomhet
• vitnemål med karakterutskrift som dokumenterer fullført mastergrad. Dersom du ikke har fullført mastergraden, skal du legge ved oppdatert karakterutskrift.
• Diploma Supplement eller tilsvarende dokumentasjon, samt konverteringsskala dersom dette er påkrevd
• dokumentasjon på engelskspråklig kompetanse dersom dette er påkrevd
• publikasjoner eller annet relevant forskningsarbeid
• attester og annen dokumentasjon som vurderes relevant for søknaden 
Dokumentasjonen må være på et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk. 

Søknader vurderes på grunnlag av informasjonen som er registrert i Jobbnorge ved søknadsfristens utløp. Sørg derfor for at søknaden tydelig viser hvordan din kompetanse og erfaring oppfyller kvalifikasjonskravene som er beskrevet i utlysningen, og at nødvendig dokumentasjon er lastet opp. Dersom vedleggene overskrider 100 MB til sammen må disse komprimeres før opplasting.

UiS behandler kun søknader og vedlegg registrert i Jobbnorge.

Opplysninger om søkere kan bli offentliggjort selv om det er bedt om unntak fra offentlig søkerliste, jf. offentlighetsloven § 25. Dersom anmodningen ikke tas til følge, vil du bli varslet.
Ansettelsesvilkår og -prosess
UiS er underlagt sikkerhetsloven, og det forventes at ansatte utviser sikkerhetsbevisst atferd, og følger gjeldende sikkerhets- og eksportkontrollrutiner. Ved ansettelse vil egenskaper som pålitelighet, dømmekraft og lojalitet bli vektlagt.

Ansettelse som stipendiat er regulert i universitets- og høgskoleforskriften kapittel IV. Opptak til doktorgradsutdanningen er regulert i forskrift for graden philosophiae doctor (ph.d.) ved Universitetet i Stavanger.
 
Dine kvalifikasjoner for stillingen vil bli vurdert av en intern komité på grunnlag av dokumentasjonen registrert i Jobbnorge ved søknadsfristens utløp. På bakgrunn av komiteens vurdering vil aktuelle søkere bli invitert til intervju. Det vil også bli innhentet referanser for aktuelle kandidater. Les mer om ansettelsesprosessen på våre nettsider.

Doktorgradsarbeidet skal i hovedsak gjennomføres ved Universitetet i Stavanger. Det er en forutsetning at den som ansettes bosetter seg slik at vedkommende kan være til stede og tilgjengelig for fagmiljøet i ordinær arbeidstid.

Stillingen er kunngjort på både norsk og engelsk. Ved eventuelle motstridende opplysninger mellom tekstene er det den engelske teksten som legges til grunn.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Den faglige virksomheten ved universitetet er organisert i seks fakultet med 13 institutt og to nasjonale forsknings- og kompetansesenter i tillegg til Arkeologisk museum. Vi er medlem i det europeiske nettverket for innovative universitet - European Consortium of Innovative Universities. Universitetet ligger i den mest attraktive regionen i landet med 300.000 innbyggere.  Stavangerregionen har et dynamisk arbeidsmarked og tilbyr en rekke spennende kultur- og fritidsaktiviteter.Sammen med våre ansatte og studenter vil vi løfte blikket, og våge å tenke stort og nytt – vi vil utfordre det velkjente og utforske det ukjente.

Nesten 40 % av budsjettet er eksternt finansiert. Studentene våre har tett kontakt med næringslivet, og mange master- og doktorgradsoppgaver blir skrevet i samarbeid med industrien. Miljøet er internasjonalt anerkjent med mange eksternt finansierte prosjekter og store nettverk. Våre ansatte har bakgrunn fra blant annet ingeniørfag, økonomi, realfag, sosiologi og samfunnsvitenskap, og instituttet kjennetegnes av utstrakt tverrfaglig samarbeid. Instituttet tilbyr studieprogrammer på bachelor-, master- og ph.d.-nivå innen fagområdene samfunnssikkerhet, industriell økonomi, byplanlegging, risikoanalyse, samt innen toll, vareførsel og grensekontroll.

jobs.occupation: IT lead
jobs.description:
About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centres. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data centre operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As IT Lead, you will establish and run Nordscale Operations’ internal IT function in Narvik. As our first internal IT appointment, you will initially focus on hands-on operations and employee support, working closely with our external IT provider. You will also collaborate across functions within the organisation, beyond day-to-day user support.

 

The scope covers internal corporate IT and access to partner systems. As the organisation grows, your responsibility will expand towards IT strategy.

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)

• Run day-to-day IT operations: configure PCs and software, support users, and manage onboarding, accounts, access, and single sign-on across internal and partner systems.
• Establish IT policies and procedures for cybersecurity, data protection, and business continuity; implement Nscale’s configuration and security requirements with site leadership and external specialists.
• Manage equipment and software procurement, licences, asset lifecycles, and relationships with IT vendors and service providers.
• Deliver upgrades, migrations, and technical refreshes; monitor performance, uptime, and user experience; and develop compatible, scalable infrastructure and support services.
 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

You may be an experienced IT consultant, systems administrator, or operational IT professional ready to build a function. Experience in or supporting larger organisations with several partners is valuable; previous senior IT leadership experience is not required.

 

You enjoy practical work, connect technical decisions with longer-term business needs, and keep up to date with technology trends.

 

Key Characteristics

• Self-driven and structured, taking ownership of decisions, priorities, and outcomes.
• A service-oriented problem-solver who identifies risks and preventive measures.
• Collaborative across teams and partners, with the ability to explain technical matters clearly to non-technical colleagues.
 

Skills & Qualifications

• Solid hands-on experience across networks, infrastructure, cloud services, software administration, user support, and account and access management.
• Good working knowledge of cybersecurity, data protection, and compliance, including implementing policies and procedures.
• Experience with IT assets, procurement, licences, and vendors, plus upgrades, migrations, and scalable service improvements.
• Fluent Norwegian and English, written and spoken. Relevant IT management, systems administration, or cybersecurity certification is desirable, not required.
 

What We Can Offer You

• Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.
• The opportunity to build an internal IT function, combining practical technical work with a path towards broader strategic responsibility.
• Relocation support assessed individually, if required.
 

Equal Opportunities Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Research Fellowship in Precision Medicine and Statistical Data Science
jobs.description:
About the position
At the Centre for Precision Psychiatry, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo, a full-time 3-year Postdoctoral Research Fellowship is available within the Research Council of Norway-funded ResiliDem project. The position offers an exciting opportunity for a highly motivated researcher to work at the interface of statistical data analysis, population-based research, and precision medicine in neurodegenerative disorders. The ResiliDem project aims to identify resilience and risk factors for Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias by integrating large-scale human genetic data with phenotypic, environmental, lifestyle, and registry-based information. The postdoctoral fellow will contribute to data-driven and statistically rigorous analyses of complex, longitudinal human datasets, with a particular focus on understanding disease mechanisms, heterogeneity, and trajectories across the life course.

The Centre for Precision Psychiatry has access to a rich and unique data infrastructure, including large databases of biomarkers, clinical and cognitive variables, genotyping and sequencing data, and MRI brain imaging data from patients with neuropsychiatric and severe mental disorders. In addition, the Centre actively collaborates with major international consortia, including the Psychiatric Genomics Consortium (PGC), the ENIGMA consortium, and the European Alzheimer’s Disease DNA BioBank (EADB). The research environment further benefits from access to data from a broad range of national and international studies, including Norwegian population cohorts (e.g., DemGene), the UK Biobank, and the ABCD and ADNI studies 
 
The position is primarily focused on advanced statistical analysis and data integration. While machine learning and computational approaches may be applied where appropriate, the core emphasis of the role is on population-level data analysis, interpretation, and scientific insight generation using large-scale real-world data.

The successful candidate will work closely with an interdisciplinary research environment including statisticians, geneticists, clinicians, and data scientists, and will conduct research using state-of-the-art secure infrastructure, including the TSD platform at the University of Oslo.This postdoctoral fellowship is intended to strengthen the candidate’s scientific independence and publication record, and to provide strong qualifications for future academic or research leadership positions within precision medicine, population health, and data-driven neuroscience
Main responsibilities
• Perform advanced statistical analyses of large-scale human genetic, phenotypic, environmental, and registry-based data to investigate resilience and risk factors for Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias.
• Develop, adapt, and implement statistical and analytical methods tailored to complex population-based and longitudinal data, including method development driven by specific scientific questions within the ResiliDem project.
• Conduct data preparation, quality assessment, and harmonization of complex datasets from population cohorts, biobanks, and health registries, including national and Nordic resources (e.g., HUNT, HUSK, DemGene) as well as international datasets.
• Integrate genetic data with phenotypic, lifestyle, environmental, and longitudinal registry information to characterize disease heterogeneity, trajectories, and modifiers across the life course.
• Design and apply robust analytical strategies for population-based and longitudinal studies, including model development, sensitivity analyses, and careful interpretation of results.
• Collaborate closely with clinicians, statisticians, geneticists, and other researchers to translate analytical findings into biological and clinical insight relevant for precision medicine.
• Contribute to the scientific development of the ResiliDem project, including study design, analytical strategy development, and dissemination of results through high-quality peer-reviewed publications.Qualifications
Required

• A PhD in statistics, mathematics, informatics, genetics, medicine, psychology, or an equivalent field.
• Strong programming skills in Python, R, or MATLAB, with emphasis on data analysis and method development.
• Solid experience in statistical analysis and data processing using relevant statistical software. 
• Experience with large-scale human datasets, including genomics, omics, and/or brain imaging data 
• Experience with tools and pipelines for image analysis (e.g., FreeSurfer, FSL) and genetic data analysis (e.g., PLINK) 
• Excellent proficiency in written and spoken English.  
Preferred

• Research experience related to Alzheimer’s disease, dementia, or other neurodegenerative disorders.
• Experience with machine learning for large datasets.
• Experience with computational methods and workflows for handling large-scale data. Personal skills
• Highly organized, self-driven, and goal-oriented, with strong productivity and attention to detail.
• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary research teams. 
Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.
We need different perspectives in our work 
UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues—could you be the next one?

Application

• 
Stakeholder engagement: Communicate decisions, trade-offs, and user insights with clarity. Ensure shared understanding and buy-in for your domain's direction. 
About youThe right candidate is preferred to have the following qualifications:
• 
Portfolio is needed to showcase your work

• 
You have 5+ years of experience as a product, UX or growth designer, ideally with e-commerce, subscription or self-serve purchase flows with a track record of successfully delivered projects

• 
Proficiency in AI, design and prototyping tools such as Figma is a must and you have strong interaction and UI skills and move easily from rough sketches to build-ready designs.

• 
Fluent English oral and written communication skills. Our working language is English.

• 
Relevant degree/diploma/certificate in Design, HCI, or equivalent.

We are looking for someone who is:
• 
You make design decisions with data and are comfortable with funnels, conversion metrics and experiment results.

You're commercially curious and understand how design affects conversion and acquisition cost.

• 
You work independently and own outcomes, not just deliverables.

• 
You're comfortable shipping a good first version and improving it over time.

• 
Exceptional design skills with a deep understanding of user-centred design principles and methodologies.

• 
You communicate clearly and can explain design trade-offs to developers, marketers and leadership alike.

• 
Excellent facilitation skills, with the ability to partake in workshops and design sprints that drive collaboration and innovation.

• 
Comfortable with working cross-functionally collaborating with different stakeholders to find solutions and drive decisions to impact design.

• 
You speak up early when a plan or deadline doesn't look realistic, and you share decisions openly with the team.

• 
You're friendly, curious and thrive in a fast-moving team where priorities shift.
About Us
As a company still scaling up, our way of working is continuously evolving, and you will have the opportunity to make an impact on how we do things. We are passionate about product development, animal welfare, farmer welfare and sustainable agriculture. We genuinely believe our grazing technology is the biggest technological change in agriculture since the tractor!

So far, our clients have used Nofence in a range of creative ways, including regenerative cattle farming, conservation grazing with goats, regenerative grazing with sheep, and even government work! Yet we have only just scratched the surface, and already have 250 million hours of operation on animals with recorded behaviour data to explore.

Still curious? Visit our website.

The Product team is currently a team of 15 employees working with Product development, UX Design and Global Customer Support. We're excited to add a Growth Designer to our team who's not only skilled in interaction design but also embodies the collaborative and friendly spirit of Nofence. We believe in cooperation, adaptiveness, and a fun and relaxed working environment!

At Nofence, we are not your typical 9-to-5 gig. We are a dynamic scale-up, creating a work atmosphere that's anything but ordinary. It's a place where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth.

If you're the right fit, you will be part of a tight-knit team, supporting each other to make a real impact on the agricultural industry. With offices in Oslo for the city strollers and our Molde office surrounded by nature for the outdoor enthusiasts, we've got the best of both worlds.

Join us, where ambition meets reality, and let's keep pushing the boundaries in the world of agri-tech!We will evaluate candidates continuously.

jobs.occupation: Electronics Engineer
jobs.description:
Nofence is a Norwegian scale-up that has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionise livestock management, we will need top-notch competence in our Engineering team, and we are now looking for an Electronics Engineer.

The product is small, solar-assisted and combines GNSS, LTE, Bluetooth, and many other technologies, so every design decision is a system integration problem. Join the NPD team that takes it from concept to pilot production.

What you’ll do

• 
Design schematics and PCB layouts, and review designs with the team

• 
Bring up new boards, subcircuits and reusable modules

• 
Test and validate hardware from first prototype to pilot production

• 
Build lab setups and find root causes when things break

• 
Work with the embedded team on low power consumption. On a solar-powered device, every microamp counts

What we’re looking for

• 
Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering or similar

• 
Boards you have taken from schematic to working hardware, and a story about what went wrong on the way

• 
Strong fundamentals: analogue, power and digital design, signal integrity, EMC basics, power optimisation

• 
Confidence with oscilloscope, spectrum analyser, DMM and PCBA debugging and testing

• 
Experience with a professional PCB CAD tool. We’re moving from Altium to KiCad.

• 
Fluent English

Nice to have

• 
RF and antenna design

• 
Experience with integrating GNSS, LTE or Bluetooth in a single device

• 
Complex electromechanical products in harsh environments

• 
CE, FCC and ISED certification

• 
Python for test scripting

What we offer

• 
Short path from idea to impact: you’ll see your work in the field

• 
Visits to customers and their animals, to see how the product lives in reality

• 
Room to grow towards senior or specialist roles

• 
Location: Trondheim or Molde

About the Application

We will evaluate candidates continuously. If you have any questions about Nofence or regarding the application, please reach out to our Engineering Manager, Kjetil Grimsæth.

About Nofence

Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilized.

Until now.

Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock.

What we bring to the table

At Nofence, we're not your typical 9-to-5 gig. We're a dynamic scale-up, creating a work atmosphere that's anything but ordinary. It's a place where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth.

We believe in seeing results fast. As an engineer with us, your work won't be lost in the bureaucratic shuffle. You'll witness the immediate impact of your contributions in real-time, influencing the evolution of our cutting-edge virtual fencing solution for livestock.

Join us, where ambition meets reality, and let's keep pushing the boundaries in the world of agri-tech!

jobs.occupation: PhD Candidate in AI for Accelerated Concept and Tender-Phase Ship Design
jobs.description:
This is NTNU
NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   
Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position
AI is disrupting how we approach design and engineering. This PhD position is about developing AI methods for reducing the time required for concept evaluation and tender preparation in marine engineering and ship design through rapid estimation, automated data transformation, knowledge graphs and AI-assisted design-space exploration.

We are looking for a PhD candidate who wants to explore and develop AI-based methods for early-stage concept exploration in marine and ship design. The position will develop methods that make concept design faster and better informed: methods that generate and explore design concepts, estimate their performance quickly, and learn from full-scale data. The focus is on early-stage concept exploration and on methods that apply across marine vessels, from ships to uncrewed surface vessels (USVs). A case study will be linked to Fjordlab, part of the Norwegian Ocean Technology Center.

Possible research directions include:

• AI-based design tools for generating and exploring marine design concepts.
• How to structure data for effective use in AI design tools.
• Study how designers and engineers use such tools, and how they affect companies.
• How full-scale data can drive new concept development.
Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. You will be part of a research environment with several related PhD positions in the Norwegian Maritime AI Centre at NTNU.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.
About the project
The PhD project will be part of the Norwegian Maritime AI Center that aims to accelerate operationalization of AI in the maritime value chains. The center shall position the maritime sector for accelerated and successful use of AI. The demand for safe and sustainable maritime activities, as well as the shortage of crew and engineers, are key drivers for change in the maritime sector. At the same time, there is a pull for growth, increased efficiency and profitability, while managing volatility in the markets. Moreover, the sector is critically important for global supply chains and security in a tense geopolitical situation. To demonstrate and prototype maritime AI solutions, the center will address a diverse and impactful set of use cases: Logistics, shipping and business transactions; Ship design and construction; Voyage planning and optimization; Condition monitoring and maintenance; Crew training; Maritime traffic and ship surveillance; Decarbonization and energy management; Autonomous ships and remote control.

The research partners are the Norwegian University of Science and Technology, (NTNU), University of Oslo, Oslo School of Architecture and Design, Royal Norwegian Naval Academy, Norwegian Mapping Authority, MET and SINTEF Nordvest. There are about 30 user partners from the maritime sector, in addition to hundreds of members of the Maritime Forum, Blue Maritime, Ocean Autonomy, and Maritime CleanTech clusters. The center will be a hub, orchestrating the interfaces with research partners and user partners to facilitate collaboration, knowledge creation, dissemination, innovation, and sharing of knowledge. The Norwegian Maritime AI Center is funded by the Research Council of Norway and the partners for the period 2026-2030. There will be approximately 25 doctoral scholarships and some postdoc positions. More information can be found here: https://www.ntnu.edu/mai

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.
Duties of the position
• Take part in the mandatory PhD research education program obtaining a doctorate
• Develop research and AI applied to the Maritime Domain, with strong cooperation with the industrial partners
• Collaborate effectively within the research team, remaining open to constructive feedback throughout the research process
• Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
• Participate actively in discussion with the industrial partners
• Participate in activities in the Maritime AI center
• Participate in relevant dissemination activities for the academia and industry
• Conduct independent research and publish the result in recognized scientific journals and present them at international conferences
Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.
Required selection criteria
• You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
• You must have a relevant Master's degree in mechanical engineering, product design, marine engineering, naval architecture or a closely related field or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis. Degrees from other engineering disciplines such as computer science or mechatronics are also welcome to apply.
• Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
• You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
• Affinity with programming, AI-related tools and a desire to work with the development of applied computational tools
• Excellent oral and written presentation skills in English
The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.
Preferred selection criteria
• Experience applying machine learning or generative AI to engineering design problems.
• Experience with CAD and parametric modelling.
• Experience with simulation, sensors, data acquisition or field testing.
• Experience with marine vessels, USVs or other marine engineering systems.
• Interest in design methodology and how engineers reason and make decisions.Personal characteristics
To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

• Work independently
• Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them, also when the path is unclear
• Show curiosity and enjoy combining building things with writing code.
• Present and discuss your research with other engineers, researchers and industry partners
• Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
• Enjoy working both in the lab and in the field, including tests at sea.
• Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
• Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.
We offer
• An exciting job with an important mission in society
• Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
• Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
• Working capital that can be used to implement the project
• Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
• Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
• Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)
As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.
Diversity
Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)
Salary and conditions
In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.
About the application
The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

• Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
• CV 
• Copy or short summary of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
• Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
• Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
• Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
• Possibly certificates
• Names and contact information of three relevant referees
The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).
General information
A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Øystein Bjelland, email: oystein.bjelland@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact PhD Coordinator Lara Bromann, email: lara.bromann@ntnu.no

jobs.occupation: Doctoral Research Fellowship in Multi-Omics at Centre for Precision Psychiatry
jobs.description:
About the position
We have an available position as a doctoral research fellow (SKO 1017) at the University of Oslo, 3-years engagement, affiliated with the Centre for Precision Psychiatry, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo and the Department of Medical Genetics, Oslo University Hospital.
 
The Centre runs a series of multidisciplinary studies involving hospital departments and several research groups at the University of Oslo, building on advanced statistical methods for analysis of large-scale human genetic, proteomic, metabolomic, and neuroimaging data. The Centre has access to large databases of biomarkers, clinical and cognitive variables, genotyping and sequencing data, and MRI brain imaging data. In addition, we actively collaborate with large international consortia, particularly the Psychiatric Genomics Consortium (PGC), ENIGMA, and the European Alzheimer’s Disease DNA BioBank (EADB) and have access to data from Norwegian population cohorts (e.g., DemGene, HUNT, HUSK, the Tromsø Study, MoBa), as well as the UK Biobank, Estonian Biobank and ADNI. 

For more information, please visit: https://www.ous-research.no/djurovic/
Project description
The available position is part of the Back2Future project, entitled Multimodal metabolic markers for mechanisms and predictive trajectories of Alzheimer’s disease, funded by the Research Council of Norway's TOPPFORSK programme and led by Professor Srdjan Djurovic. The project aims to identify heritable, early metabolic and protein biomarkers in blood that can predict the risk of Alzheimer's disease decades before symptoms appear, by combining metabolomics and proteomics with genetics, brain MRI, cognition and health registry data from large Norwegian and Nordic cohorts.

To achieve this goal, the researcher hired for this doctoral research fellowship position will work with the project's datasets, analytical methodology, and computational tools, including state-of-the-art data storage and research infrastructure hosted at the Services for Sensitive Data (TSD).

The PhD fellow will work with large-scale analytical tools to integrate multi-omics with brain imaging data to identify early biomarkers of Alzheimer's disease risk and contribute to development of a personalized prediction algorithm.

The duration of appointment is 3 years and is available from January 2027, with possibility of a flexible start date.
Main responsibilities
• Develop a research plan within the scope of this project for a PhD research program
• Participate in literature searching, data analysis and interpretation 
• Write research articles to be published in peer-reviewed academic journals 
The candidate will work both independently and as part of a team, under supervision of the group leader, and will be encouraged to take an active part in the Centre’s daily activities, depending on needs, interests, and qualifications.

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. The research fellow must fulfill the requirements of and take part in the approved PhD program at the Faculty of Medicine at the University of Oslo and is expected to complete the project within the set fellowship period.

The applicant must, in collaboration with her/his supervisor, within three months after employment, work out a complete project description to be attached to the application for admission to the doctoral program. For more information: Doctoral degree: PhD in medicine and health sciences - Faculty of Medicine 
Qualifications
Required skills

• A master’s degree in a relevant discipline (e.g., molecular biology, genetics, biostatistics, medicine, psychology, or an equivalent field)
• Strong English and academic writing skills
• Familiarity with programming/scripting languages (e.g., R, Python, and/or Matlab) and big data analysis
• Demonstrated ability to work independently and in a structured manner, and capable of effective collaboration with others 
Preferred skills

• Experience with machine learning, AI tools and AI-supported codingPersonal skills

jobs.description:
This is NTNU
NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

   
Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position
Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia.

A PhD in Microbiology is available at the Department of Biotechnology and Food Science (https://www.ntnu.edu/ibt) in the Microbial Biotechnology research division (https://www.ntnu.edu/ibt/research/microbial#/view/about)

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.
About the project
A PhD position is available at the Bruheim research group (https://www.ntnu.edu/employees/per.bruheim) which focuses on Deep Phenotyping of prokaryotic and eukaryotic model systems using Advanced Cultivation Technology and Mass Spectrometry (MS) based Metabolomics, Fluxomics and Lipidomics (https://www.ntnu.edu/ibt/research/micphys#/view/about).

This PhD project is one of four closely coordinated PhD projects about to be recruited to the NTNU funded research project “Preparedness and Response to AMR, the silent pandemic” lead by Professor Marit Otterlei, Department of Clinical and Molecular medicine (IKOM) https://www.jobbnorge.no/en/available-jobs/job/309380

This particular PhD project (numbered 2 of the 4 - see the link) will focus on emerging technologies for characterization of mode of operation and activity of synthetic and natural peptides already developed characterized with potent antibacterial activity against important pathogenic bacteria by the Otterlei lab. Central technology will be mass spectrometric based analysis at metabolite and protein levels as well as metabolic flux characterizations as well as traditional microbial cultivation and bioanalytical assays.  There will be close collaboration with the Otterlei lab and PhD project 1.
Duties of the position
• Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
• Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
• Academic publications and popular science dissemination
Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.
Required selection criteria
• You must meet the requirements for admission to the Departments's Doctoral Programme (https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/phbiot), see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
• You must have a relevant Master's degree in Microbiology, Biochemistry, Biotechnology or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis
• Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position and no later than 1st. December, 2026.
• You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
• Good oral and written presentation skills in English
The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.
Preferred selection criteria
• Strong background in biochemistry, microbiology, biotechnology
• Some background in analytical biochemistry
• Experience in LC-MS 
• Skills to work with large data setsPersonal characteristics
To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

• Work independently and in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them
• Present and discuss your research with other professionals
• Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback 
• Present and discuss your research with collaborators on the project as well as other professionals 
• Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed
Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities. This PhD project requires strong collaborative, communication, and interpersonal skills. as there will be close collaboration with PhD project 1 and development of joint publications.

Evaluate and remove/add what is relevant for the position.

• Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
• Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
• Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues

• Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
• Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.
Diversity
Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.
Salary and conditions
In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 4 years (3 years the doctoral work in addition to 1 year of career promotion work). 

The candidate is ideally expected to start in the position in winter/early Spring 2027.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Biotechnology, (https://www.ntnu.edu/studies/phbiot) within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.
About the application

Bli en del av vårt team på H.A. Hanssen som kjøttskjærer/Meat Cutter

Vi søker deg som ønsker å jobbe med skjæring i næringsmiddelindustrien

FOR ENGLISH SEE BELOW

Vi ser etter deg som ønsker å være en viktig del av team H.A. Hanssen på nedskjæring. På skjæreavdelingen vil du delta i nedskjæring av slaktene og klargjøre stykninger og sorteringer til videreforedling i bedriften. Du må trives i en hektisk arbeidshverdag og like å jobbe med mat.

Arbeidsoppgaver

• 

Skjæring av kjøtt: Skjære kjøtt i ulike deler, filetering, trimming, og klargjøring av kjøttet for videre foredling internt i bedriften eller for salg.

• 

Sortering av kjøtt: Kategorisere kjøtt etter kvalitet, størrelse, og type (f.eks. storfe, svin, lam, etc.).

• 

Bruk av verktøy og maskiner: Betjene kniver, båndsag, håndsag, svoremaskin og andre skjæreverktøy.

• 

Pakking og merking: Klargjøre kjøttprodukter for emballasje og påføre riktig merking og informasjon om produktene.

• 

Vedlikehold av utstyr: Holde verktøy og maskiner skarpe, rene, og i god stand.

• 

Hygiene og renhold: Følge hygienekrav for håndtering av rått kjøtt, samt holde arbeidsplassen ren og sikker.

Krav til ferdigheter

• 

Nøyaktighet og presisjon: Kunne skjære kjøtt nøyaktig etter våre kravspesifikasjoner, slik at det ikke blir feilskjært eller unødig svinn.

• 

Fysisk styrke og utholdenhet: Jobben kan være fysisk krevende, og krever at man kan måtte stå lenge, løfte tunge gjenstander og jobbe i kaldt miljø.

• 

Kunnskap om kjøttkvaliteter: Ønskelig med god forståelse for ulike typer kjøtt, og høy evne til å sette seg inn i våre krav til kvalitet.

• 

Erfaring eller formell kompetanse vektlegges.

Sikkerhet

• Bruk av verneutstyr: Obligatorisk bruk av verneutstyr som skjærehansker, brynje, og hørselvern.

Personlige egenskaper

• 

Arbeids- og lærevillig

• 

Effektiv og pålitelig: Arbeid utføres ofte under tidspress, og det kreves at oppgaver fullføres raskt og nøyaktig.

• 

Lagspiller: Jobben krever godt samarbeid med andre i bedriften

• 

Fleksibel: Arbeidet kan innebære skiftarbeid eller overtid, spesielt i perioder med høy produksjon

Opplæring og utvikling

• 

Intern opplæring: Bedriften legger til rette opplæring av nye ansatte for å lære bedriftens standarder for skjæring og hygiene.

• 

Videreutvikling: Muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling.

Vi tilbyr deg

• 

Konkurransedyktige lønnsbetingelser

• 

Ett godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kollegaer

• 

En spennende og variert arbeidshverdag

• 

Grundig opplæring i bedriften

ENGLISH

We are looking for a dedicated individual to join our team at H.A. Hanssen In the meat cutting department, you will participate in cutting down the carcasses and preparing them for further processing in the company. You must thrive in a hectic working day and enjoy working with food.

Work assignments

• 

Cutting meat: Cutting meat into different parts, filleting, trimming, and preparing the meat for further processing within the company or for sale.

• 

Sorting meat: Categorize meat according to quality, size and type (eg beef, pork, lamb, etc.).

• 

Use of tools and machines: Operate knives, band saws, hand saws, deburrs and other cutting tools.

• 

Packaging and labeling: Prepare meat products for packaging and apply the correct labeling and information about the products.

• 

Maintenance of equipment: Keep tools and machines sharp, clean and in good condition.

• 

Hygiene and cleanliness: Follow hygiene requirements for handling raw meat, and keep the workplace clean and safe.

Requirements for skills

• 

Accuracy and precision: Be able to cut meat exactly according to our requirement specifications, so that there are no mistakes in cuts or unnecessary wastage.

• 

Physical strength and endurance: The job can be physically demanding, and requires you to stand for a long time, lift heavy objects and work in a cold environment.

• 

Knowledge of meat qualities: Desirable with a good understanding of different types of meat, and a high ability to understand our requirements for quality.

• 

Vocational certificate or relevant education: It is desirable to have a vocational certificate as a meat cutter, but relevant work experience can replace a vocational certificate.

Security

• 

Use of protective equipment: Mandatory use of protective equipment such as cutting gloves, breastplate and hearing protection.

Personal characteristics

• 

Willing to work and learn

• 

Efficient and reliable: Work is often performed under time pressure, and tasks are required to be completed quickly and accurately.

• 

Team player: The job requires good cooperation with others in the company

• 

Independent: Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

• 

Flexible: The work may involve shift work or overtime, especially during periods of high production

Training and development

• 

Internal training: The company arranges training for new employees to learn the company's standards for cutting and hygiene.

• 

Further development: Opportunities for professional and personal development.

What we offer

• 

Competitive salary conditions

• 

A good working environment with committed colleagues

• 

An exciting and varied working day

• 

Thorough training in the company

Bedriften har lang og bred erfaring siden starten i 1908 og kombinert med gamle og ærverdige tradisjoner har vi et glimrende utgangspunkt for å skape gode matopplevelser. Vi vektlegger smak og nytelse under vårt motto MAT Å BLI GLA I.
