jobs.occupation: Postdoktor i språkvitenskap med vekt på nasjonale minoriteter og mangfold
jobs.employer_name: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
Om stillingen
Ved UiT Norges arktiske universitet, Fakultet for humaniora, samfunnsvitenskap og lærerutdanning, Institutt for språk og kultur (ISK), utlyses det én midlertidig 100 % stilling som postdoktor innenfor fagområdet språkvitenskap med vekt på nasjonale minoriteter og mangfold knyttet til prosjektet Sustaining National Minorities in Education: Kven/Norwegian Finnish and Forest Finnish Experiencesand Needs in Mainstream Schools (NAMED). Prosjektet er finansiert av Norges Forskningsråd.

Stillingen forutsetter aktiv deltakelse i et forskningsmiljø. Postdoktoren vil knyttes til forskningsgruppen Multilingual North: Diversity, Education and Revitalisation (MultiNor) ved lærested Tromsø som er en tverrfaglig gruppe språk- og utdanningsforskere som arbeider med å utforske flerspråklig praksis og språklig revitalisering i Baretsregionen og har særlig oppmerksomhet rettet mot utdanningskontekster i Nord-NorgePostdoktorstillingen er en åremålsstilling med ansettelsesperiode på 3 år. Det forutsettes at søkeren vil kunne gjennomføre prosjektet i løpet av ansettelsesperioden. Ingen kan ansettes i mer enn én åremålsperiode som postdoktor ved samme institusjon.

Arbeidssted er UiT i Tromsø. Stillingen er ledig fra 01.01.2027.   

Som postdoktor får du mulighet til å videreutvikle din forskerkarriere og kvalifisere deg for videre arbeid innen akademia. Dersom du ikke allerede har utdanningsfaglig kompetanse som innfrir kravene til en stilling som førsteamanuensis i Norge, vil UiT tilrettelegge for at du kan opparbeide deg kompetansen i løpet av ansettelsesperioden.
Om prosjektet
Sustaining National Minorities in Education: Kven/Norwegian Finnish and Forest Finnish Experiences and Needs in Mainstream Schools (NAMED) er et tverrfaglig forskningsprosjekt som skal bidra til forsoning i tråd med Sannhets- og forsoningskommisjonens sluttrapport gjennom å styrke den kvenske/norskfinske og skogfinske elevers opplæring i tråd meg de nasjonale minoritetenes kultur. Med utgangspunkt i teori om språklig og kulturell responsiv pedagogikk (linguistically and culturally responsive education) skal prosjektet utvikle innovative måter å undervise om og for de nasjonale minoritetene i grunnskolen. 

Postdoktorprosjektet knytter seg spesifikt til arbeidspakke 2 i NAMED-prosjektet, som undersøker kvenske/norskfinske elever og foresattes erfaringer og behov i skolen. Postdokprosjektet skal gjennom intervjuer med kvenske/norskfinske elever og foresatte (her er ulike intervjuformer aktuelle, eventuelt i kombinasjon med andre datakilder) utforske ett eller flere temaer med relevans for NAMED-prosjektet. 

Dette kan for eksempel være:

• Hvilke opplevelser deltakerne har med diskriminering, usynliggjøring og anerkjennelse i skolen.
• Hvordan deltakerne mener at skolen kan bidra til å forbygge fordommer og diskriminering av skogfinner.
• Hvordan deltakerne mener at skolen kan bidra til å styrke denkvenske/norskfinske nasjonale minoriteten innenfor rammen av detflerkulturelle og flerspråklige samfunnet.
• Hvordan deltakerne mener at skolen kan bidra til forsoning mellom kvener/norskfinner og majoritetssamfunnet. 
• Hvordan skolen kan utvikle en helhetlig pedagogisk tilnærming til kvener/norskfinner spesielt og nasjonale minoriteter generelt innenfor rammen av det flerkulturelle og flerspråklige samfunnet
Du må levere en prosjektbeskrivelse på maksimalt fem sider, eksludert referanser. Utformingen er valgfri. Prosjektbeskrivelsen skal beskrive ditt bidrag til prosjektet og grunnlaget for arbeidet, og inneholde bakgrunn, teoretisk rammeverk og metodologi, inkludert forskningsspørsmål, datainnsamling og dataanalyse. Den skal også inneholde en fremdriftsplan. Ta gjerne kontakt med prosjektlederen, Leena Maria Heikkola, for å diskutere planen (leena.m.heikkola@uit.no).

 
Kvalifikasjoner
Krav til utdanning, forskererfaring og språkferdiggheter 

Nødvendige kvalifikasjoner 

• Denne stillingen krever en norsk Doktorgrad/PhD i relevant fagfelt, eller en tilsvarende utenlands doktorgrad. Avhandlingen må være levert innen søknadsfristen. 
• God fremstillingsevne på norsk, dansk eller svensk samt gode engelskkunnskaper. 
Søkere som har fullført videregående opplæring i Norge, Sverige eller Danmark, kan dokumentere språkferdighetene sine ved å legge ved vitnemål.

Ønskelige kvalifikasjoner: 

• Det er ønskelig at kandidaten har forskningerfaring knyttet til kvensk/norskfinsk tematikk.
• Kvensk/norskfinsk bakgrunn eller tidligere kjennskap til kvensk/norskfinsk språk, kultur eller historieer en fordel.
I vurderingen av søkerne vil vi vektlegge søkers motivasjon, potensiale for forskning og personlig egnethet for stillingen. Vi søker kandidater som blant annet har:

• Gode samarbeidsevner
• Evner til god kommunikasjon og samhandling med kollegaer og studenter
• Evner og ønsker om å bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø
Ved UiT legges det vekt på forskningsarbeidenes kvalitet, relevans og betydning og ikke på hvor arbeidene er publisert, i henhold til prinsippene i The San Fransisco Declaration on Research Assessment (DORA). 

Vurderingen av hvilken kandidat som er best kvalifisert, vil være en helhetlig vurdering av utdanning, erfaring og personlig egnethet, samt motivasjon og øvrige krav slik de er formulert i denne utlysningen. I tillegg vil følgende bli vektlagt: kvalitet på prosjektbeskrivelsen, dokumenterte selvstendige forsknings- og utviklingsarbeider eller praksis relevant for prosjektet. 

Stillingen med tilhørende arbeidsoppgaver skal ivaretas i samsvar med gjeldende lov og regelverk for statsansatte, herunder også Lov om kontroll med eksport av strategiske varer, tjenester og teknologi m.v. Kandidater som etter vurdering av søknad og vedlegg kommer i konflikt med kriteriene i sistnevnte lov, vil ikke kunne tiltre stillingen ved UiT Norges arktiske universitet. Nødvendige godkjenninger må opprettholdes gjennom hele ansettelsesforholdet. 
Inkluderende arbeidsliv og mangfold
UiT Norges arktiske universitet har et personalpolitisk mål om å være en arbeidsgiver som gjenspeiler mangfoldet i samfunnet og som tar i bruk potensialet i befolkningens samlede kompetanse.  Vi mener at inkludering og mangfold er en styrke og ønsker oss medarbeidere med ulik kompetanse, fagkombinasjoner, livserfaring og perspektiver.
 
Har du funksjonsnedsettelse, hull i CV-en eller innvandrerbakgrunn, oppfordrer vi deg som søker til å krysse av for dette i jobbsøkerportalen. Er det kvalifiserte søkere, kaller vi inn minst én i hver gruppe til intervju, og får du jobben, legger vi til rette for deg om du trenger det. Utenom å velge ut riktige kandidater bruker vi ikke avkrysningene til noe annet enn anonymisert statistikk. Les mer i Arbeidsgiverportalen https://arbeidsgiver.difi.no/positivsaerbehandling
Vi kan tilby
• Du blir en del av et spennende forskningsprosjekt
• Gode karrieremuligheter
• Et godt arbeidsmiljø med dedikerte kolleger
• Gode velferdsordninger
• Gode pensjons-, forsikrings-, og låneordninger i Statens pensjonskasseSøknaden
Vær oppmerksom på at søknaden kun vurderes basert på informasjonen som er sendt inn innen søknadsfristen via Jobbnorge. Det er derfor viktig at du legger ved alle nødvendige dokumenter som viser dine kvalifikasjoner for stillingen.

Søknaden din må inneholde:

• Søknadsbrev
• CV
• Vitnemål og karakterutskrift for alle grader
• Kontaktinformasjon til 2-3 referanser
• Dokumentasjon av engelskkunnskaper 
• Dokumentasjon av norskkunnskaper eller annet skandinavisk språk
• Dokumentasjon på utdanningsfaglig kompetanse, hvis tilgengelig
• Prosjektbeskrivelse (maks 5 sider. eksludert referanser). Utformingen er valgfri. Prosjektbeskrivelsen skal beskrive ditt bidrag til prosjektet og grunnlaget for arbeidet, og inneholde bakgrunn, teoretisk rammeverk og metodologi, inkludert forskningsspørsmål, datainnsamling og dataanalyse. Den skal også inneholde en fremdriftsplan.
Søkere som har fullført videregående opplæring i Norge, Sverige eller Danmark, kan dokumentere språkferdighetene sine ved å legge ved vitnemål.

Hvis du er i sluttfasen av din doktorgrad, kan du fortsatt søke hvis du har levert doktorgradsavhandlingen for doktorgradsevaluering innen søknadsfristen. Du må levere oppgaven sammen med søknaden din. Dokumentert fullført doktorgrad er en betingelse for å tiltre i stilling som postdoktor. 

All dokumentasjon som skal vurderes må være på et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk. Hvis dokumentasjon på engelskkunnskaper mangler på søknadstidspunktet, må det dokumenteres før tiltredelse. 
Sakkyndig vurdering
Søkerne vil bli vurdert av en sakkyndig komité. Komiteens mandat er å foreta en vurdering av søkernes kvalifikasjoner på grunnlag av søknadsdokumentene og kunngjøringsteksten. Alle søkere vil motta en kopi av vurderingen til den sakkyndige komitéen. 

Søkere som vurderes å være best kvalifisert vil bli innkalt til intervju. Intervjuet skal blant annet avklare personlig egnethet og motivasjon for stillingen. Det kan også bli avholdt prøveforelesning. 
Generelt
Ansettelsen skjer i henhold til regler og vilkår som til enhver tid gjelder for statsansatte, og retningslinjer ved UiT. På våre nettsider finner du mer informasjon til søkere på stillinger ved UiT. 

Postdoktor lønnes etter statens regulativ kode 1352 med en brutto årslønn i 100% stilling  kr 665 100,-. (I særskilte tilfeller kan høyere lønn vurderes.) Fra bruttolønn trekkes det 2 % pliktig innskudd til Statens pensjonskasse. Du vil bli medlem i Statens pensjonskasse, som gir deg mange goder i tillegg til livsvarig alderspensjon og AFP. Les mer om ansattgodene dine på: spk.no.Du må være villig til å engasjere deg i utviklingsarbeid innen eget fag, og for universitetet som helhet.
 
Personopplysninger som oppgis behandles i henhold til lov om behandling av personopplysninger. Søkere kan be om ikke å bli oppført på den offentlige søkerlista, men universitetet kan likevel beslutte at navnet på søkeren skal offentliggjøres. Søkeren vil da bli varslet i forkant av offentliggjøring. 

Velkommen som søker!

Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT Norges arktiske universitet er et internasjonalt ledende breddeuniversitet. Vår visjon er å være en drivkraft i nord. Det nordsamiske begrepet eallju, som betyr arbeidsiver, setter tonen for drivkraften i UiT. Sammen med studenter, ansatte og samfunnet for øvrig skal vi utnytte vår beliggenhet i Nord-Norge og Sápmi, vår faglige bredde og tverrfaglige fortrinn til å forme framtiden. 

UiT har om lag 18 000 studenter, mer enn 4000 ansatte, og er etablert på fire hovedcampuser og sju øvrige studiesteder i Nord-Norge og på Svalbard. Våre største campuser er Tromsø, Alta, Narvik og Harstad. UiT har sju fakulteter, 40 institutter og sentre, og ledende forskningsmiljøer innenfor ulike fag. Universitetet har 269 studieprogrammer og har fokus på utdanningskvalitet. 

Akademisk frihet, vitenskapelige og forskningsetiske prinsipper ligger til grunn for hele UiT sin virksomhet. Medvirkning, medbestemmelse, åpenhet og gode prosesser skal gi det beslutningsgrunnlaget vi trenger for å gjøre kloke og framsynte prioriteringer.  Våre studenter og ansatte skal ha mulighet til å utvikle sine evner og potensial. Tuftet på vitenskapelig integritet skal vi være modige, engasjerte og rause - tett på fag, folk og samtidsutviklingen.

John Rasmus Swang | Farm Manager

holsfjordprodukterda@gmail.com

jobs.occupation: Stipendiatstilling om kjønn og teknologi
jobs.employer_name: UNIVERSITETET I TROMSØ - NORGES ARKTISKE UNIVERSITET UIT CAMPUS TROMSØ
jobs.description:
Om stillingen
En stipendiatstilling innen kjønnsstudier er ledig på Senter for kvinne- og kjønnsforskning (SKK) ved Institutt for filosofi og førstesemesterstudier (IFF), Fakultet for humaniora, samfunnsvitenskap og lærerutdanning (HSL), UiT Norges arktiske universitet. Stillingen er knyttet til forskningssatsingen Gender, A Iand Technological Engagements (GATE): Towards Informed Futures, ledetav Ania Malinowska. 

Den som ansettes, skal utvikle og gjennomføre et selvstendig doktorgradsprosjekt innenfor GATEs tematiske ramme, med sikte på å oppnå ph.d.-graden. Stipendiaten skal delta aktivt i forskningsmiljøet ved SKK og bidra til tverrfaglig kunnskapsutveksling om kjønn, kunstig intelligens, teknologisk utvikling og samfunnsliv.

Arbeidsstedet er campus Tromsø. Stillingen har en varighet på tre år, med mulighet for ett års forlengelse dersom doktorgradsavhandlingen leveres innen normert tid.

De høyest rangerte kandidatene kan forvente å bli innkalt til intervju innen april. Ønsket tiltredelse er i august 2027.

Stipendiatstillingen er en utdanningsstilling og har fullført forskerutdanning frem til doktorgrad som mål. Opptak til doktorgradsprogram er en forutsetning for ansettelse og studieperioden starter ved tiltredelse i stillingen.

Stillingen gjelder for en periode på 3 år og ph.d.-studier på fulltid med mulighet for forlengelse av et gjennomføringsstipend. Dersom doktoravhandlingen leveres på normert studietid innen 3 år eller innen 3,5 år, kvalifiserer stipendiaten seg for et gjennomføringsstipend på henholdsvis 12 eller 6 måneder. Gjennomføringsstipendet skal brukes til kvalifikasjonsfremmende tiltak inkl. universitetspedagogisk kurs, undervisning og andre arbeidsoppgaver ved fakultetet. Mer om ordningen med gjennomføringsstipend finner du her.

Veiledning og forskningsmiljø

Foreslått hovedveileder er førsteamanuensis Ania Malinowska, kulturteoretiker og forsker med kompetanse innen teknologi, affekt, kjønn og kultur. Forskningen hennes kombinerer kultur- og kjønnsteoretiske perspektiver med mediearkeologi, kvalitative metoder og kunstbasert eksperimentering. Hun er forfatter av Love in Contemporary Technoculture (Cambridge University Press) og Cutting Up Books:A Writing Method in Critical Thinking (Intellect), og medoppfinner av Hypnotic AI, et patentert KI-basert forsknings- og kunstsystem som undersøker affektive relasjoner mellom mennesker og teknologi. 

Formelle veiledningsavtaler vil bli fastsatt i tråd med UiTs regelverk for doktorgradsutdanning.
Om prosjektet / Stillingens forskningsområde
Gender, AI and Technological Engagements (GATE) bringer kjønnsforskning i dialog med teknologi- og vitenskapsstudier (STS), kritiske KI-studier, affektteori og digital humaniora. Prosjektet undersøker hvordan forståelser av kjønn påvirker utvikling, bruk og styring av intelligente systemer, og hvordan disse systemene i sin tur former identiteter, affekter, sosiale relasjoner, kunnskap, arbeid og deltakelse.

Prosjektet har en kritisk og konstruktiv tilnærming til kunstig intelligens (KI). Det undersøker hvordan KI og algoritmiske systemer kan reprodusere ulikhet, ekskludering og skjevheter, samt hvordan kjønnsforskning kan bidra til en mer inkluderende, rettferdig og sosialt ansvarlig teknologisk fremtid. Nordområdeneutgjør en viktig kontekst for å undersøke geografiske og språklige skjevheter i teknologiske systemer og for å utvikle tilnærminger som tar utgangspunkt i nordlige og arktiske erfaringer med og historier om teknologi. 

Søkere forventes å foreslå et avgrenset og gjennomførbart doktorgradsprosjekt som tar for seg én eller flere av følgende forskningsretninger:

• Kjønnede antakelser, representasjon og skjevheter i KI-systemer, datasett, plattformer og brukergrensesnitt.
• Kjønnsidentiteter og forventninger i samhandling med KI-agenter, roboter,avatarer og digitale assistenter.
• Affekt, tillit, intimitet, omsorg og relasjoner i møter mellom mennesker og maskiner.
• Algoritmiske tilbakekoblingssløyfer, dataekskludering og produksjon av kjønnet kunnskap.
• Kjønnede endringer i arbeidsliv, automatisering, ekspertise og sosial reproduksjon.
• Kjønnssensitive kvalitative, digitale, historiske, eksperimentelle eller kunstbaserte metoder for forskning på intelligente teknologier.
• Kjønnssensitiv teknologiutvikling, fremtidsstudier, styring og frigjørende muligheter.
• KI og teknologiske fremtider i nordområdene, inkludert minoritetsspråk, urfolkskontekster og geografiske ulikheter. 
Prosjektbeskrivelsen skal formulere en tydelig problemstilling, forankre denne i relevant kjønnsteoretisk forskning, identifisere egnede metoder og empirisk materiale, drøfte forskningsetiske spørsmål og presentere en realistisk plan for gjennomføring innenfor ansettelsesperioden. Prosjektet kan være teoretisk,empirisk eller praksisbasert, forutsatt at det viser et solid kjønnsteoretisk og/eller metodologisk bidrag.

Avhengig av doktorgradsprosjektets innretning kan forskningen omfatte kvalitativt feltarbeid, mediearkeologi, analyser av digitale systemer eller eksperimentelle møter med teknologiske objekter. Muligheter for praksisbasert eksperimentering kan inkludere arbeid med intelligente systemer og forskningsutstyr som Hypnotic AI, der dette er relevant og gjennomførbart. Tilgang til utstyr, laboratoriefasiliteter og bestemte systemer avhenger av nærmere avtale og tilgjengelighet.

Stipendiaten forventes å presentere forskningen sin på faglige arrangementer, delta aktivt i senterets forskningsaktiviteter og publisere eller på andre måter formidle forskningsresultater gjennom relevante vitenskapelige publiserings- og formidlingskanaler, inkludert åpen publisering der det er mulig.

Mal for prosjektskisse finnes her (bokmål)/her (nynorsk).
Kontakt
Flere opplysninger om stillingen kan du få av Førsteamanuensis Ania Malinowska:

• telefon: +47 77 64 67 07
• e-post: ania.malinowska@uit.no
eller Instituttleder Melina Duarte

• telefon: +47 77 64 4329
• e-post: melina.duarte@uit.noKvalifikasjoner
Nødvendige kvalifikasjoner 

• Relevant mastergrad eller tilsvarende kvalifikasjoner innen kjønnsstudier, humaniora, samfunnsvitenskap, studier i vitenskap, teknologi og samfunn, (STS), medie- og kulturstudier eller tilsvarende fagområder.
• Gode skriftlige og muntlige engelskkunnskaper 
Søkere skal ha dokumentert gode kunnskaper i engelsk, og kunne jobbe i et internasjonalt miljø. Nordiske søkere kan dokumentere dette med vitnemål fra videregående skole. 

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner: 

• Kunnskap om kjønnsstudier, feministisk teori, kritiske KI-studier, STS eller digitalhumaniora
• Erfaring med kvalitative, digitale, historiske, eksperimentelle eller kunstbaserteforskningsmetoder
• Interesse for tverrfaglig samarbeid og samfunnsansvarlig teknologiforskning. 
• Et gjennomførbart og godt forberedt forskningsprosjekt som viser gode metodiskeferdigheter
• Motivasjon, forskningspotensial og personlig egnethet
Søkerne må levere en prosjektbeskrivelse med det faglige grunnlaget for doktorgradsprosjektet. Prosjektbeskrivelsen skal være på 8-10 sider, inkludert litteraturreferanser. Den må inneholde en beskrivelse av temaet, forskningsspørsmål og en begrunnelse for valgene. Den endelige prosjektbeskrivelsen vil bli utviklet i samarbeid med veileder. Det er viktig at søkeren har passende bakgrunn og er motivert til å jobbe med prosjektet.

I vurderingen vil vi også vektlegge personlige egnethet og motivasjon for stillingen.

 Vi søker kandidater som blant annet har:

• Gode samarbeidsevner
• Evner til god kommunikasjon og samhandling med kollegaer og studenter
• Evner og ønsker om å bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø 
I bedømmelsen vektlegges søkerens potensial for å gjennomføre en forskerutdanning basert på masteroppgaven eller tilsvarende, og eventuelle andre vitenskapelige arbeider. Det vil også tas hensyn til prosjektbeskrivelsen. I tillegg vil det tas hensyn til yrkespraksis og annen erfaring av betydning for gjennomføring av doktorgradsstudiet.

Flest mulig bør få anledning til å gjennomgå en forskerutdanning. Om du allerede har oppnådd en doktorgrad eller har tilsvarende kompetanse, er du ikke aktuell for ansettelse i denne stillingen.
Opptak til ph.d.-program
For ansettelse som stipendiat er det en forutsetning at du blir tatt opp til ph.d.-programmet ved Fakultet for humaniora, samfunnsvitenskap og lærerutdanning og at du deltar i organiserte doktorgradsstudier i ansettelsesperioden.

Opptak krever normalt at søkeren har:

• Bachelorgrad på 180 studiepoeng og mastergrad på 120 studiepoeng, eller integrert mastergrad på 300 studiepoeng.
• Masteroppgave med et omfang tilsvarende 30 studiepoeng eller mer hvis søkeren har en mastergrad på 120 studiepoeng.
• Masteroppgave med et omfang tilsvarende 20 studiepoeng eller mer hvis søkeren har en integrert mastergrad på 300 studiepoeng.
 
 
For å bli tatt opp er det krav om et karaktersnitt tilsvarende B eller bedre på mastergraden. Karaktersnittet gjelder også for integrerte 5-årige mastergradsprogram der alle emnene inngår i beregningen. Nærmere beskrivelse av opptakskrav finner du her.

Hvis du oppfyller opptakskravene og blir ansatt i stillingen, vil du samtidig få midlertidig opptak til ph.d.-programmet. Søknad om endelig opptak må leveres senest to måneder etter tiltredelse i stillingen.

For søkere med utenlandsk utdanningsbakgrunn vil det vurderes om utdanningen likestilles med norsk høyere utdanning på mastergradsnivå. Vurderingen følger nasjonal godkjenningspraksis, se Direktoratet for høyere utdanning og kompetanse. Søkere med utdanning fra enkelte land må ha mer høyere utdanning for å fylle opptakskravene, for eksempel 4-årig bachelor og 2-årig master. UiT godkjenner normalt utenlandsk høyere utdanning fra land som har ratifisert Lisboakonvensjonen.
Inkluderende arbeidsliv og mangfold  
UiT Norges arktiske universitet har et personalpolitisk mål om å være en arbeidsgiver som gjenspeiler mangfoldet i samfunnet og som tar i bruk potensialet i befolkningens samlede kompetanse. Vi mener at inkludering og mangfold er en styrke og ønsker oss medarbeidere med ulik kompetanse, fagkombinasjoner, livserfaring og perspektiver.   

Har du funksjonsnedsettelse, hull i CV-en eller innvandrerbakgrunn, oppfordrer vi deg som søker til å krysse av for dette i jobbsøkerportalen. Er det kvalifiserte søkere, kaller vi inn minst én i hver gruppe til intervju, og får du jobben, legger vi til rette for deg om du trenger det. Utenom å velge ut riktige kandidater bruker vi ikke avkrysningene til noe annet enn anonymisert statistikk. Les mer i Arbeidsgiverportalen: arbeidsgiver.difi.no/positivsaerbehandling  
Vi tilbyr
• Du blir en del av et spennende forskningsmiljø
• Gode karrieremuligheter 
• Et godt arbeidsmiljø med dedikerte kolleger  
• Gode velferdsordninger  
• Gode pensjons-, forsikrings-, og låneordninger i Statens pensjonskasse
• Stipendiater får normalt 580 000,- i årslønn med 3% økning pr. år
• Mulighet for å søke om stipend for et lengre forskningsopphold i utlandet
• Mulighet til å bli en del av et aktivt og tverrfaglig forskningsmiljø ved Senter for kvinne- og kjønnsforskning (SKK)
• Gode muligheter for faglig samarbeid og kunnskapsutveksling på tvers av kjønnsforskning, kritiske teknologistudier og KI-forskning.
• Mulighet til å søke om finansiering av forskningsopphold i utlandet og bygge internasjonale forskningsnettverk. 
• Tett faglig oppfølging og veiledning gjennom doktorgradsløpet
• Et inkluderende og støttende arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kolleger
• Mulighet for fysisk aktivitet i arbeidstidenSøknaden
Vær oppmerksom på at søknaden kun vurderes basert på vedleggene som er sendt inn innen søknadsfristen via Jobbnorge. Det er derfor viktig at du legger ved alle nødvendige dokumenter som viser dine kvalifikasjoner for stillingen.

Søknaden din må inneholde:  

• Søknadsbrev med beskrivelse av dine forskningsinteresser og motivasjon for stillingen 
• CV 
• Offisielle vitnemål for bachelor- og mastergrad på originalspråk
• Offisielle karakterutskrifter for bachelor- og mastergrad på originalspråk
• Offisiell oversettelse av vitnemål og karakterutskrifter til engelsk eller et skandinavisk språk, hvis aktuelt
• Forklaring på karaktersystemet for utenlandsk utdanning (Diploma Supplement om tilgjengelig) 
• Dokumentasjon av engelskkunnskaper 
• 2-3 referanser med kontaktinformasjon 
• Masteroppgaven, og eventuelle andre vitenskapelige arbeider 
• Prosjektbeskrivelse (8-10 sider, inkludert referanse) 
Søkere skal ha dokumentert gode kunnskaper i engelsk, og kunne jobbe i et internasjonalt miljø. Nordiske søkere kan dokumentere dette med vitnemål fra videregående skole. 

Søkere må ha mastergrad før tiltredelse i stillingen. Kandidater som er i sluttfasen av mastergraden, oppfordres også til å søke. I slike tilfeller må søkerne legge ved et utkast til masteroppgaven, en oppdatert karakterutskrift og en bekreftelse fra veileder eller institusjon som angir forventet tidspunkt for fullføring av graden. Mastergraden må være fullført før den som får tilbud om stillingen, tiltrer.

All dokumentasjon som skal vurderes må være på et skandinavisk språk eller engelsk. Hvis dokumentasjon på engelskkunnskaper mangler på søknadstidspunktet, må det dokumenteres før tiltredelse. 
Bedømmelse
Søkerne vil bli vurdert av en sakkyndig komité. Komiteens mandat er å foreta en vurdering av søkernes kvalifikasjoner på grunnlag av søknadsdokumentene og kunngjøringsteksten. Alle søkere vil motta en kopi av vurderingen til den sakkyndige komitéen. 

Søkere som vurderes å være best kvalifisert vil bli innkalt til intervju. Intervjuet skal blant annet avklare personlig egnethet og motivasjon for stillingen. 
Generell informasjon 
Ansettelsen skjer i henhold til regler og vilkår som til enhver tid gjelder for statsansatte, og retningslinjer ved UiT. På våre nettsider finner du mer informasjon til søkere på stillinger ved UiT. 

Stilling som stipendiat lønnes etter statens regulativ kode 1017. Fra lønnen blir det trukket 2% innskudd til Statens pensjonskasse.Du vil bli medlem i Statens pensjonskasse, som gir deg mange goder i tillegg til livsvarig alderspensjon og AFP: Du kan ha rett til økonomisk støtte hvis du blir syk eller ufør, familien din kan ha rett til økonomisk støtte når du dør, du blir forsikret mot yrkesskade eller yrkessykdom, og du får gode betingelser på boliglån. Les mer om ansattgodene dine på: spk.no.
 
Kortere ansettelsesperiode kan gis dersom stipendiaten alt har gjennomført deler av sitt forskerutdanningsprogram, eller når ansettelsen bygger på tidligere ansettelse i utdanningsstilling, slik at total tid til forskerutdanning blir tre år. 

Personopplysninger som oppgis behandles i henhold til lov om behandling av personopplysninger. Søkere kan be om ikke å bli oppført på den offentlige søkerlista, men universitetet kan likevel beslutte at navnet på søkeren skal offentliggjøres. Søkeren vil da bli varslet i forkant av offentliggjøring.  

Om arbeidsgiveren:

UiT Norges arktiske universitet er et internasjonalt ledende breddeuniversitet. Vår visjon er å være en drivkraft i nord. Det nordsamiske begrepet eallju, som betyr arbeidsiver, setter tonen for drivkraften i UiT. Sammen med studenter, ansatte og samfunnet for øvrig skal vi utnytte vår beliggenhet i Nord-Norge og Sápmi, vår faglige bredde og tverrfaglige fortrinn til å forme framtiden. 

UiT har om lag 18 000 studenter, mer enn 4000 ansatte, og er etablert på fire hovedcampuser og sju øvrige studiesteder i Nord-Norge og på Svalbard. Våre største campuser er Tromsø, Alta, Narvik og Harstad. UiT har sju fakulteter, 40 institutter og sentre, og ledende forskningsmiljøer innenfor ulike fag. Universitetet har 269 studieprogrammer og har fokus på utdanningskvalitet. 

Akademisk frihet, vitenskapelige og forskningsetiske prinsipper ligger til grunn for hele UiT sin virksomhet. Medvirkning, medbestemmelse, åpenhet og gode prosesser skal gi det beslutningsgrunnlaget vi trenger for å gjøre kloke og framsynte prioriteringer.  Våre studenter og ansatte skal ha mulighet til å utvikle sine evner og potensial. Tuftet på vitenskapelig integritet skal vi være modige, engasjerte og rause - tett på fag, folk og samtidsutviklingen.

Les mer om UiTs strategi mot 2030

jobs.occupation: Upper School Counsellor - Starting Academic Year 2027
jobs.description:
The International School of Bergen is seeking an experienced, compassionate, and highly skilled School Counsellor to join our vibrant IB World School in Norway.

Hva vi ser etter

Application

We welcome applications from suitably qualified and experienced counsellors who are genuinely committed to relocating to Norway and becoming part of our school community.

Please submit the following documents by email with the subject line "US School Counsellor Application" to laura.mcguffie@isbergen.no:

• 

A current CV.

• 

A covering letter explaining your relevant counseling experience, qualifications, experience working with children and young people, and motivation for working at the International School of Bergen.

• 

Contact details for two professional referees, including your current or most recent employer.

Important - Relocation to Norway

Please only apply if you are seriously considering relocating to Bergen, Norway.

Candidates who are currently living outside Norway should be prepared to relocate and meet the relevant Norwegian immigration, visa and work permit requirements, where applicable.

As part of the application process, candidates may be asked to provide information regarding their nationality/passport country and current country of residence so that the school can establish the appropriate immigration and work permit requirements.

This is an on-site based position in Bergen, Norway.

Safeguarding

The International School of Bergen is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of children and young people.

All appointments must provide a police background check from your home country and any country you have resided in for 6+ months in the last 10 years. Police background checks must be no more than 3 months old and can be presented prior to appointment.

All staff are expected to uphold the school's safeguarding policies and Code of Conduct.

Previous applicants should reapply if you are still seriously interested in the position.

If you have any questions in regards to this position, please contact Peter Ledger, Director peter.ledger@isbergen.no or Laura McGuffie, HR and Finance Manager laura.mcguffie@isbergen.no

Applications will be reviewed as they are received. We reserve the right to close this vacancy early if a suitable candidate is identified, so early applications are encouraged.

Closing Date for applications is 27th November 2026

Arbeidsoppgaver

About the Role

The School Counsellor will provide proactive and responsive counselling services to students across the school while supporting the implementation of a whole-school wellbeing programme consistent with the philosophy of the International Baccalaureate.

The role includes:

• 

Providing confidential individual and small-group counselling.

• 

Supporting students with social, emotional, behavioural and mental health needs.

• 

Delivering preventative wellbeing programmes and age-appropriate classroom guidance.

• 

Promoting resilience, self-management, positive relationships and emotional wellbeing.

• 

Working collaboratively with teachers to identify and support students requiring additional care.

• 

Advising school leadership on student wellbeing, safeguarding and pastoral care.

• 

Liaising effectively with parents and guardians to support student success.

• 

Coordinating referrals to external professionals and Norwegian support services where appropriate.

• 

Supporting crisis response and student reintegration following significant life events.

• 

Maintaining accurate, confidential records in accordance with GDPR and Norwegian legislation.

• 

Contributing to safeguarding procedures and child protection practices.

• 

Supporting transitions between PYP and MYP where applicable), ensuring continuity of care.

• 

Promoting inclusion, diversity, intercultural understanding and student voice.

The Successful Candidate Will Have

Essential

• 

A recognised qualification in Counselling, School Psychology, Educational Psychology, Social Work or a related field.

• 

Professional registration or eligibility for registration where applicable.

• 

Experience working with children and adolescents in a school setting.

• 

Strong understanding of child and adolescent development.

• 

Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.

• 

Demonstrated ability to build trusting relationships with students, families and staff.

• 

Commitment to safeguarding and child protection.

• 

High levels of professionalism, integrity and confidentiality.

• 

Excellent spoken and written English.

• 

A genuine willingness and ability to relocate to Bergen, Norway.

Desirable

• 

Previous experience within an IB World School.

• 

Knowledge of the IB Learner Profile and IB Approaches to Learning (ATL).

• 

Experience supporting internationally mobile or multilingual students.

• 

Experience working within multicultural communities.

• 

Knowledge of trauma-informed and restorative practices.

Personal Attributes

We are looking for someone who is:

• 

Compassionate and approachable.

• 

Calm and solution-focused.

• 

Collaborative and reflective.

• 

Culturally responsive and internationally minded.

• 

An excellent listener with sound professional judgement.

• 

Passionate about student wellbeing and inclusion.

• 

Committed to continuous professional learning.

• 

Open to embracing life and work within an international school community in Norway.

Vi tilbyr

Why Join Us?

Our school offers:

• 

A welcoming and diverse international community.

• 

Students representing many nationalities and cultures.

• 

A collaborative and supportive staff culture.

• 

Commitment to ongoing professional development.

• 

Competitive salary and pension.

• 

The opportunity to live and work in one of the world's most beautiful and family-friendly countries.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

About Our School

ISB is a co-educational private day school which is authorised to deliver the International Baccalaureate PYP and MYP programmes. The school currently has approximately 250 students enrolled from more than 30 nations and is experiencing expanding enrolment. Classes are small with a maximum of 20 students in each instructional group.

Our school is committed to developing internationally minded young people who embody the attributes of the IB Learner Profile. We believe that student wellbeing is fundamental to learning, and we are looking for a counsellor who shares our commitment to nurturing the academic, social, emotional and personal development of every learner.

Working collaboratively with students, families, teachers and school leaders, the successful candidate will play a central role in promoting wellbeing, inclusion, safeguarding and positive mental health across the school community.

jobs.occupation: PhD Research Fellow in AI Native Networking for Healthcare
jobs.description:
We seek a PhD Research Fellow for a 3-year position in the SYNAPSE project. The successful candidate will have a solid background in computer networking and an interest in developing machine-learning methods for network control and network-aware distributed learning.

Section for Medical Information and Communication Technology (Medical ICT Research), The Intervention Centre (see: http://www.ivs.no), at Oslo University Hospital offers a full-time PhD Fellowship. The recruited PhD Fellow will be part of the Wireless Sensor Network Research Group of Professor Ilangko Balasingham and will be enrolled in the PhD program at the University of Oslo

We seek candidates with a solid background in computer networking who want to develop machine-learning methods for network control and network-aware distributed learning.

Oslo University Hospital is a workplace with great diversity. We believe this is crucial for solving our tasks in the best possible way. We want this diversity to be reflected among the applicants for our positions, and we encourage all qualified candidates, regardless of background, to apply!

Arbeidsoppgaver
About SYNAPSE

SYNAPSE, funded by the Research Council of Norway, develops networks that adapt their decisions to network conditions and the clinical urgency of the information they carry. Learning is integrated into network control to support decisions about scheduling, routing and resource allocation. For example, an urgent clinical alert should reach its destination promptly even when links are congested and patients are moving.

The project also develops distributed and federated learning methods that adapt to connectivity, available resources and clinical priorities. Network control and distributed learning are designed together, so that the network supports learning and learning remains effective when communication is constrained. The methods are evaluated in remote patient monitoring and hospital-at-home scenarios.  

This position focuses on network protocols and their control at the MAC, network, transport and cross-layer levels, combined with machine learning. It does not cover hardware, antennas, circuits or physical-layer signal processing, and is not a general data-science position. Applicants must document relevant computer-networking knowledge and experience.

Research areas

• Learning-based network control, including scheduling, link selection, routing and resource allocation in wireless and edge networks.
• Reinforcement learning and multi-agent reinforcement learning for distributed network decision-making.
• Graph and hypergraph representation learning of network state, including temporal graph neural networks.
• Network- and urgency-aware distributed and federated learning, adapting the exchange of data and model updates to network conditions and clinical priorities.
• Evaluation through network simulation and emulation, and with real remote patient monitoring data.
Responsibilities

• Develop and evaluate learning-based methods for urgency-aware network control and network-aware distributed learning.
• Implement and test the methods using network simulation or emulation and real monitoring data.
• Publish in leading networking and machine-learning venues and complete a PhD at the University of Oslo, Faculty of Medicine.                Kvalifikasjoner (overskrift)
Required qualifications

• A master’s degree (120 ECTS), including a thesis, in computer science, network or communication engineering, electrical engineering or equivalent.
• A relevant bachelor’s degree (180 ECTS), with a total of five years of higher education.
• A solid foundation in computer networking, demonstrated through relevant coursework and a substantial project, thesis or research experience involving network protocols, wireless or mobile networks, routing or network performance.
• Coursework or project experience in machine learning, and good programming skills in Python.
• A weighted average grade of B or better on the master’s degree, as required by the University of Oslo.
• A master’s thesis graded B or better (Norwegian grading scale or equivalent).          
Preferred qualifications

• Experience with reinforcement learning or graph neural networks.
• Experience with network simulation or emulation tools, such as ns-3, OMNeT++ or Mininet.
• Publications or a master’s thesis combining networking and machine learning.
Language Requirements Applicants who are not proficient in a Scandinavian language must document English proficiency through one of the following: TOEFL: at least 600 (paper-based) or 92 (internet-based); IELTS Academic: at least 6.5, with no section below 5.5; Cambridge CAE/CPE: grade A or B.  

Personal Qualities

• Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
• A structured, precise and adaptable working style.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills.
• A positive attitude and ability to manage a dynamic work environment.
• A high level of professionalism and work ethic.
We offer

• A fully funded, full-time three-year PhD position. Salary according to the Norwegian state salary scale (approximately NOK 550,800–587,000 per year).
• Supervision by Dr Roufaida Laidi (PI), Prof. Ilangko Balasingham and Dr Hemin Ali Qadir, in collaboration with Prof. Tarik Taleb (Ruhr University Bochum).
• A clinical research environment at The Intervention Centre, Oslo University Hospital.
• Access to high-performance computing infrastructure at OUS and national e-infrastructure services.
• An inclusive, interdisciplinary research environment at the Intervention Centre, OUS.
• Pension, insurance and welfare schemes through the Norwegian public sector.
• Family-friendly surroundings with cultural and outdoor opportunities in Oslo.            
Your application

• Submit a cover letter of at most one page explaining your interest in SYNAPSE and your fit with the position. 
Identify:

• Your computer-networking background, naming relevant coursework, a thesis, substantial projects or publications and explaining your own contribution.
• Your experience implementing machine-learning methods and using network simulation, emulation or testbeds.
• The research area or areas above that best match your background and interests.
Supporting documents 

• A CV.
• Transcripts for your bachelor’s and master’s degrees, with the grading scale or diploma supplement.
• Copies of your diplomas.
• Documented English proficiency.
• Names and contact details of two referees, at least one academic. Referees must not be family members.
• Documents not in English or a Scandinavian language must be accompanied by a certified translation. Applications without transcripts and diplomas will not be assessed.
Submit your application electronically through Webcruiter

Prof. Ilangko Balasingham, Section leader, ilangko.balasingham@ous-research.no

jobs.occupation: Researcher in AI and Computational Method Development for Precision Medicine
jobs.description:
About the position
At the Centre for Precision Psychiatry, Institute of Clinical Medicine, University of Oslo, there is a full-time, 2,5 years position available as a Researcher in artificial intelligence (AI), statistical modelling, and computational method development.

We invite applications from highly motivated candidates with a strong background in mathematics, statistics, computer science, data science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, computational modelling, engineering, physics, bioinformatics, or a related quantitative discipline. The position is part of an international and interdisciplinary research environment at the forefront of AI-driven precision neuroscience and precision medicine. The position is part of a collaborative effort between the University of Oslo, Oslo University Hospital, UC San Diego, the J. Craig Venter Institute (JCVI), and affiliated partners. The successful candidate will contribute to the development, implementation, and application of computational and AI-based methods for integrating multimodal brain imaging, genomics, registry, clinical, and other biomedical data, with the aim of improving understanding, prediction, and risk stratification of dementia, Alzheimer’s disease, and related neuropsychiatric disorders.
 
The position is linked to the “ResiliDem” project and the “Talent Utland” programme, funded by the Research Council of Norway. This is a unique opportunity to work on next-generation AI and statistical modelling approaches for large-scale, longitudinal, and potentially federated datasets, bridging computational innovation, biology, and clinical applications.
More about the position
The Centre for Precision Psychiatry is dedicated to research on severe mental and neuropsychiatric disorders. The Centre runs multidisciplinary studies involving hospital departments in Oslo, research groups at the University of Oslo, and international collaborators. The main goal is to develop tools and knowledge for precision medicine in brain disorders, using advanced statistical methods and AI tools for the analysis of large-scale genetic, neuroimaging, registry, clinical, and molecular data.

The Centre has access to large datasets including biomarkers, clinical and cognitive variables, genotyping and sequencing data, and MRI brain imaging data. In addition, we work closely with national population cohorts such as Tromsø, HUSK, and HUNT, Nordic registry and biobank resources, and large international consortia including PGC, ENIGMA, ADNI, NBDC, UK Biobank and others. We also collaborate with international partners at UC San Diego and the J. Craig Venter Institute, and with leading industry partners such as Nvidia, OpenAI, and Microsoft.

For more information about the Centre, please visit our website: Centre for Precision Psychiatry - Centre for Precision Psychiatry

The researcher hired for this position will work in a multidisciplinary team including clinicians, neuroscientists, geneticists, statisticians, applied mathematicians, AI researchers, and computer scientists. The candidate will contribute to computational method development, statistical modelling, machine learning, and AI-based analysis of large and complex biomedical datasets. The work will include development, implementation, testing, documentation, and application of reproducible analytical pipelines.

The candidate will work with the Centre’s datasets, analytical methodology, and computational tools, including state-of-the-art data storage and research infrastructure hosted at the USIT TSD service, with access to high-performance GPU computing resources for large-scale AI and deep-learning applications: Services for sensitive data (TSD) - University of Oslo

Our research environment is international, friendly, and inspiring, and the position represents a unique opportunity for career development for a motivated candidate with strong quantitative and computational skills.
Main responsibilities
• Develop, implement, and evaluate machine learning, statistical modelling, and AI-based methods for the analysis of complex biomedical and multimodal data.
• Contribute to method development for precision prediction, risk stratification, longitudinal modelling, and integration of genetic, imaging, clinical, registry, and behavioural data.
• Perform data processing, quality control, harmonization, feature engineering, and model validation using large-scale datasets such as UK Biobank, NBDC, All of Us, HUNT, HUSK, and other Norwegian, Nordic, and international resources.
• Develop and maintain reproducible analytical pipelines in collaboration with researchers, postdoctoral fellows, and international partners, including collaborators at UC San Diego.
• Contribute to AI-based and potentially federated/online analytical frameworks for secure analysis across computational environments and research partners.
• Collaborate with clinicians, neuroscientists, geneticists, statisticians, and computer scientists to interpret findings and support applications in early diagnosis, prediction, and patient stratification.
• Contribute to scientific reports, presentations, manuscripts, documentation, and project deliverables. Qualifications
Required skills

• Appointment to the position of Researcher in position code 1108 requires a university education equivalent to a master's level in mathematics, statistics, computer science, physics, bioinformatics, or a related quantitative discipline.
• Appointment to the position of Researcher in position code 1109 requires a university education equivalent to a PhD in one of the fields above or similar.
• Strong programming skills in Python, R, MATLAB, Julia, or similar programming languages, with emphasis on data analysis, statistical modelling, and AI/machine learning.
• Solid background in machine learning, statistical modelling, deep learning, computational modelling, or advanced quantitative data analysis.
• Experience with handling, analysing, or modelling large and complex datasets.
• Experience with reproducible research practices, including documentation, structured analytical workflows, and version control.
• Excellent proficiency in written and spoken English.  
Preferred skills

• Experience with AI/machine-learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Scikit-learn, or related tools, and/or high-performance computing environments.
• Experience with multimodal data integration, longitudinal or prediction modelling, foundation models, federated learning, or other advanced computational/AI approaches.
• Experience with human genetics, omics, brain imaging, registry, clinical, or other biomedical datasets, preferably related to neuroscience, Alzheimer’s disease, or precision medicine.
• A strong scientific publication record in machine learning, computational methods, biomedical data science, neuroscience, or related quantitative fields. Personal characteristics
• Highly organized, self-driven, and goal-oriented, with the ability to work independently, systematically, and with attention to detail.
• Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international research teams.
• Strong motivation and genuine interest in developing and applying AI, statistical modelling, and computational methods in an interdisciplinary research environment, with applications to neuroscience, genetics, and precision medicine.
Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

jobs.occupation: Senior Frontend Developer
jobs.description:
About CURRENT

CURRENT is a Norwegian software company building a cloud-based platform for managing EV charging at scale.

We're looking for an experienced frontend developer who wants to help shape our products, influence technical decisions, and create great user experiences.

You don't need experience with EV charging. We're looking for someone passionate about building great software.

What your role will look like

• 
Develop and maintain Angular applications with plenty of freedom and responsibility.

• 
Work closely with the development and product teams to build and improve our platform.

• 
Contribute to UI/UX design, create intuitive interfaces, and help evolve our design system.

• 
Take part in technical decisions, write clean, maintainable code, and contribute to automated testing.

• 
Collaborate with your teammates through code reviews, knowledge sharing, and solving problems together.

What we're looking for

• 
5+ years of professional experience in frontend development, preferably with Angular.

• 
Good experience with TypeScript, HTML, CSS/SCSS, and responsive web development.

• 
A solid understanding of frontend architecture, reusable components, REST APIs, and clean code.

• 
Familiarity with Git, automated testing, and modern development practices.

• 
An interest in UI/UX and building intuitive, user-friendly applications.

• 
A collaborative, solution-oriented mindset. You enjoy sharing knowledge, helping others, and taking ownership of your work.

• 
Good communication skills in English.

Nice to have

Experience with technologies like Nx, Ionic, Capacitor, RxJS, Angular Material, or WebSockets is a plus. We're also happy if you've worked with design systems, performance optimization, or modern Angular features like Signals.

You don't need to tick every box. We value solid fundamentals, a willingness to learn, and a practical approach to solving problems.

What we offer

You'll have a key role in shaping our products, with the freedom to influence technical decisions, architecture, and user experience. We're a collaborative team that values openness, knowledge sharing, and getting things done together.

You'll work on meaningful technology in a growing industry, with opportunities to learn and develop along the way.

Our hiring process

We'll start with a short screening call, followed by a technical interview with our development team and a second conversation to get to know each other better. After a reference check, we hope to welcome you to CURRENT!

Om arbeidsgiveren:
CURRENT is a Norwegian technology company that delivers software for the professional operation of electric vehicle charging. CURRENT is the largest independent charging operator in Norway and offers cloud-based solutions that give our customers full control over their charging infrastructure. CURRENT’s owner portal and charging app are used by housing cooperatives, commercial properties, real estate companies, and public sector actors, with Norway and Sweden as our core markets. We work closely with electrical installers across Norway and Sweden and develop tools that make the installation, operation, and management of charging facilities simpler.

At CURRENT, you will meet a leading team in the EV charging industry that combines technology, innovation, and sustainability—and is driven by building a company with strong values and a strong sense of community at its heart.

jobs.occupation: Field Service Engineer – Data Center Hardware
jobs.description:
Teconergy is hiring a Field Service Engineer (Junior–Medium) to provide on-site hardware support for enterprise and AI servers. Join our international team to troubleshoot server faults, perform repairs at customer sites and ensure reliable service delivery.

Hva vi ser etter

Who We Are Looking For

We are looking for motivated Junior to Mid-Level Field Service Engineers with strong technical skills, a customer-focused mindset and the ability to work independently at customer sites.

Qualifications and Requirements

• 

Education in IT, electronics or a related field, or equivalent technical training and certification.

• 

Junior level: relevant technical training with some hands-on hardware experience.

• 

Mid-level: 1--3 years of experience in field service, data center operations or IT hardware support.

• 

Good knowledge of rack server hardware, including CPUs, memory, disks, RAID and power supplies.

• 

Familiarity with remote management tools (BMC/IPMI, such as iDRAC and iLO) and hardware diagnostic logs.

• 

Basic Linux commands and networking fundamentals, including cabling, fibre connections and IP addressing.

• 

A structured and accurate approach to working with service tickets, technical documentation and reports.

• 

A valid Class B driving licence and access to a car.

• 

Willingness to work a 24/7 shift rotation or on-call schedule, including nights and weekends, depending on the location.

• 

Ability to pass a background check for data center access.

• 

Willingness and ability to complete vendor/supplier interviews, qualification training and technical assessments.

Language Requirements

• 

Fluency in Norwegian and English is required.

• 

Mandarin Chinese proficiency is a strong advantage, particularly for communication and collaboration within international technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

• 

Experience with GPU servers, blade servers or enterprise storage systems.

• 

Relevant technical certifications such as CompTIA A+ or Server+.

Arbeidsoppgaver

What You'll Do

• 

Receive service tickets and review all relevant details, including serial numbers, customer locations, fault descriptions and required spare parts.

• 

Contact customers promptly (within 15 minutes for 4-hour response tickets and 60 minutes for next-business-day tickets) to arrange service visits.

• 

Collect and verify spare parts from the warehouse before travelling to data centers and customer sites within your assigned region.

• 

Diagnose server hardware faults using BMC logs and diagnostic tools, and replace defective components, including memory, CPUs, disks, power supplies, motherboards and GPUs.

• 

Test repaired equipment, obtain customer confirmation and complete service reports.

• 

Document each service visit accurately within 24 hours, close tickets on time and escalate any potential SLA risks before the deadline.

• 

Manage defective component returns and follow up on Return Merchandise Authorization (RMA) cases.

• 

Escalate complex technical issues to the support team and comply with all data center safety procedures and ESD requirements.

Vi tilbyr

What We Offer

• 

Full training and manufacturer certification on enterprise server and storage products.

• 

A permanent, full-time position (100%) with an international IT service provider.

• 

Hands-on experience with modern data center infrastructure, enterprise servers and AI technologies.

• 

Competitive salary plus shift, on-call and travel allowances.

• 

The opportunity to work with international technology clients and gain valuable field service experience.

• 

An international, multilingual team working in English and Mandarin Chinese.

• 

Clear career development opportunities, with potential progression to senior engineering roles.

jobs.occupation: PhD Candidate in Explainable AI (xAI) for Capsule Endoscopy
jobs.description:
This is NTNU
NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim. This position will be in Gjøvik, Norway.

At NTNU, 9,000 employees and 43,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.

Video: https://youtu.be/Xt-yHCN5QS0

Are you interested in pursuing a doctoral degree in an international research environment? This position offers the opportunity to join the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network CAPTURE, collaborate with academic, healthcare, and industry partners across Europe, and develop expertise within a multidisciplinary research project on wireless endoscopy.

As part of the CAPTURE network, the PhD Candidate will participate in workshops, conferences, transferable skills training, and research secondments with partner organisations. The position provides opportunities for both academic and professional development within an international setting.

The successful candidate will be offered a fixed-term, full-time position as a PhD Candidate for a period of 36 months and will be enrolled in a PhD programme leading to the award of a doctoral degree. The expected start date is 1 August 2027.

Your immediate leader will be the unit leader of Colourlab.
About the project
The CAPTURE project is an EU-funded Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA) Doctoral Network dedicated to advancing wireless capsule endoscopy (WCE) through developments in computer vision and artificial intelligence. The project aims to improve image-based diagnosis, monitoring, and treatment by developing methods that reduce clinicians’ workload, enhance imaging quality, and support more accurate and timely diagnoses.

CAPTURE combines research with a strong focus on doctoral training, preparing a new generation of researchers to work at the interface of technology and medicine. The consortium brings together expertise from academia, industry, and hospitals, ensuring that the research is both scientifically rigorous and clinically relevant.The project focuses on inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), reflecting its growing prevalence in Europe. As many of the methods developed have broader applicability, the project will also consider other gastrointestinal diseases. These goals will be achieved through the recruitment and training of 15 doctoral candidates in an international and intersectoral environment, providing interdisciplinary expertise across the technical, clinical, and applied aspects of WCE. 
Duties of the position
Automated approaches for pathology detection using WCE are generally based on recent AI models. These models often result in black-box decisions. For a clinician to use these systems, the basis for diagnostic decision should be clearly explained.

The PhD candidate will help develop explainable AI (XAI) methods for automated diagnostic decision systems to enhance the explainability and actionability of their predictions for doctors. The candidate will also evaluate the generated explanations with medical doctors to assess their relevance, usefulness, and importance in clinical settings.

Key responsibilities

• Complete the doctoral education until obtaining a doctorate
• Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
• Academic publications and popular science dissemination
• Participate in the Colourlab research group
• Participate in the network’s joint research and training activities, both online and in person across the CAPTURE partner institutions and contribute to CAPTURE project deliverables in accordance with the Description of Action and the project's governance procedures.
• Participate in international activities such as conferences and/or research stays at foreign educational institutions. Particularly, secondments of a few months’ duration are foreseen to Robert Gordon University, UK and Technical University of Darmstadt, Germany.
• Close collaboration with hospitals for assessing methods developed in PhD project 
Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.
Required selection criteria
• You must have experience with computer vision and machine learning. 
• You must have excellent programming skills in Python with exposure to popular deep learning libraries like PyTorch or Tensorflow.
• At the date of recruitment, you must NOT have been awarded a doctoral degree. Researchers who have successfully defended their doctoral thesis but have not yet formally been awarded the degree are also not eligible.
• You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme in computer science, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
• You must have a relevant master's degree in computer science, electrical engineering or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis.
• Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
• You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your master’s degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills in English.
• You must comply with the MSCA mobility rule: you must not have resided or carried out your main activity (work, studies, etc.) in the country of the recruiting organisation for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before recruitment (short stays such as holidays are not taken into account). 
The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.
Preferred selection criteria
Preference may be given to candidates with:

• Experience with computer vision, medical image processing, self-supervised learning or learning in low-data regimes.
• Experience with statistical signal processing and pattern recognition will be counted positive.
• Experience with pretrained representation models, transfer learning and xAI.
• Knowledge of robustness analysis in computer vision applications.
• Knowledge of explainable AI, uncertainty estimation, calibration, out-of-distribution detection, adversarial robustness, or causal analysis.
• Experience with causal inference, counterfactual explanations, or uncertainty quantification in deep learning
• Evidence of scientific writing, publications, a strong master's thesis, research software, or relevant open-source contributions.
• Excellent analytical and communication skills.
• Ability to work in an international and interdisciplinary environment. Personal characteristics
To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

• Show strong motivation for research and a willingness to engage deeply with challenging scientific questions.
• Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them.
• Present and discuss your research with other professionals.
• Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback.
• Work constructively under pressure or in the face of adversity.
• Show curiosity and a strong motivation for the subject.
• Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions.
• Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed.
• Communicate, present, and collaborate effectively, including explaining technical ideas clearly and presenting research results to interdisciplinary audiences and project partners. 
Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.
We offer
 

• An exciting job with an important mission in society
• Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
• Career guidance and follow-up during the PhD period
• Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
• Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
• Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)
• As an employee in Norway, the successful candidate will normally be a member of the Norwegian National Insurance Scheme, which provides access to public healthcare and social security benefits in accordance with applicable legislation and regulations.
As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.
Diversity
Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.
Salary and conditions
In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,- per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. This will cover the MSCA Living Allowance and Mobility Allowance. In addition, a family allowance may be provided in accordance with MSCA regulations.

A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary.

The employment period is 3 years.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Computer Science within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme throughout the period of employment.

The position is conditional on external funding.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The successful applicant must devote full working time to the project and the doctoral training programme.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.
About the application
The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request. Incomplete applications will not be prioritised.

The application must include:

• Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
• CV 
• Copy of master’s thesis. If you have recently submitted your master’s thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed master’s degree must be presented before taking up the position.
• Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages).
• Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page).
• Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work.
• Possibly certificates.
• Names and contact information of at least two relevant referees. 
If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

Evaluation processApplications will be assessed by an expert committee based on the qualifications and documentation submitted by the applicants. The evaluation will consider academic achievements, the quality and relevance of the applicant's educational background, research potential, and suitability for the position. Shortlisted candidates may be invited for an interview. The final appointment will be made in accordance with the applicable regulations for employment at the university. 
General information
A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Prof. Kiran Raja, Ph: +47 611 35 374, email: kiran.raja@ntnu.no. 

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact HR at the department: hr@idi.ntnu.no

Application deadline: 19.11.2026

For practical information about working at NTNU, please visit this webpage.

jobs.occupation: PhD Research Fellow in Structured Vision-Language Models
jobs.description:
About the position
Integreat - the Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning is seeking a motivated PhD candidate to join our interdisciplinary research centre at the University of Oslo, Norway.

You will be part of a dynamic group of early career researchers, supervised by senior experts, collaborating across disciplines to tackle fundamental challenges through innovative methods, theory and critical analysis.

The fellowship period is 3 years.

A fourth year may be considered, and it will involve 25 % of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualifications of the applicant and the current needs of the Department of Informatics

Starting date from January 2027 and upon individual agreement thereafter.

A candidate may be appointed to only one PhD Research Fellowship at the University of Oslo.
About Integreat
See the video for more information about Integreat.
Video: https://www.youtube.com/shorts/-_I52cJHiW4About Integreat 
Integreat - Norwegian Centre for Knowledge-driven Machine Learning is a Centre of Excellence, funded by the Research Council of Norway (2023-33). Integreat has two branches, one in Oslo (University of Oslo, UiO) and one in Tromsø (UiT The Arctic University of Norway).

Machine learning is the mathematical and computational engine of Artificial Intelligence (AI), and therefore it is a fundamental force of technological progress in our increasingly digital, data- and algorithm-driven world. Integreat develops theories, methods, models, and algorithms that integrate general and domain-specific knowledge with data, laying the foundations of next generation machine learning. We do this by combining the mathematical and computational cultures, and the methodologies and theories, of statistics, logic, language technology, ethics and machine learning, in new and unique ways.

Focus of Integreat is to develop groundbreaking methods and theories, and therefore solving fundamental problems in science, technology, health and society. Integreat draws on the research strengths of researchers and students from the departments of Mathematics, Informatics, Philosophy, and the Oslo Centre for Biostatistics and Epidemiology at UiO, the Norwegian Computing Centre (NR) and the ML group at UiT, with members from the departments of Physics and Technology, Mathematics and Statistics, and Computer Science. 
Project description
Vision-language models (VLMs) can name what is in a picture, but they often miss what is happening in it. Shown a park scene, a model may list "a dog", "a Frisbee" and "a park" and still fail to say that the dog is leaping to catch the Frisbee mid-air. The same gap shows up when a model misreads a symbolic painting or gives a vague description of a medical image. More training data does not close this gap, because the models have no explicit representation of how the objects in a scene relate to each other.

This project gives VLMs that representation. You will develop panoptic scene graphs, in which every object and background region in an image becomes a node and the edges encode spatial, semantic and relational context. The graphs are built from superpixels rather than the fixed square patches used in standard vision transformers. Superpixels follow object boundaries, so the nodes of the graph are meaningful from the start. The project builds directly on our recent work on superpixel tokenization for vision transformers (ECCV Workshops 2024, NeurIPS 2025).

The scene graph is then fused with a large language model (LLM), and the two parts inform each other. The LLM guides which objects and relations the vision model should focus on, and the graph grounds the LLM's answers in what is actually in the image, which reduces hallucination. Because a scene graph has the same form as a knowledge graph, it also opens the way to graph-based visual retrieval-augmented generation (graph visual RAG), where a model links what it sees to external knowledge before it answers.

The aim is a new class of VLMs that reason over images instead of only describing them. Such models would be more accurate, more explainable (each answer can be traced to nodes and edges in the graph) and more useful where deep understanding matters. Examples include a robot that follows an instruction such as "place the red mug next to the laptop onto the top shelf", a medical system that reasons about the relations between structures in an X-ray, and a self-driving car that anticipates how pedestrians and vehicles will interact.

As a PhD fellow on the project, you will contribute to:

• develop superpixel-based panoptic segmentation models built on modern transformer architectures
• design methods that predict relations between segmented regions and generate panoptic scene graphs
• fuse scene graphs with LLMs for visual question answering and grounded reasoning, including graph visual RAG
• publish and present your results at leading machine learning and computer vision venues
Project supervisors: Professor Adín Ramírez Rivera at the Department of Informatics, UiO, in collaboration with Benjamin Ricaud and Filippo Maria Bianchi at UiT The Arctic University of Norway.

Working language: English.
What skills are important in this role?
The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Qualification requirements:

• Master’s degree or equivalent in computer science, machine learning, data science, mathematics, statistics, electrical engineering, or a related field. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system.
• Experience in scientific programming.
Desired qualifications:

• Proficiency in scientific programming (e.g., Python)
• Proficiency in deep learning frameworks (e.g., PyTorch)
• Background in machine learning, mathematics, linear algebra, and statistics
• Experience in creating, adapting, or training modern, token-based transformer architectures
• Experience working with image / vision models
• Experience in creating or adapting large language models (LLMs) and interfacing them with other models
• Familiarity with image segmentation 
• Familiarity with Scene Graph Generation 
• Familiarity with LLM fine-tuning and alignment
• Knowledge of graph-based retrieval-augmented generation (Graph RAG)
• Understanding of probabilistic modelling and information-based regularizers
• Strong scientific writing skills
Language requirement:

Grade requirements: 

The norm is as follows:

Personal skills
We are looking for candidates who are curious, motivated to learn, and interested in tackling challenging scientific questions. You should be able to work independently while also contributing actively to collaborative research activities and the broader research community.

Integreat brings together researchers from different disciplines, institutions, and career stages.
