jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Fellows in Educational Measurement
jobs.description:
Job description
Applications are invited for 1-2 full time positions for three- to four-years as Postdoctoral Fellows at the Centre for Research on Equality in Education (CREATE), Faculty of Educational Sciences, University of Oslo, Norway. The positions have a double affiliation with the Centre for Educational Measurement (CEMO).

CREATE is an interdisciplinary Centre of Excellence funded by the Research Council of Norway with the objective to generate novel knowledge about how to reduce inequalities in education. The interdisciplinary center integrates researchers with substantive expertise from education, psychology, sociology, economics, and genetics, and methodological expertise from educational measurement, psychometrics, econometrics, statistics, and biostatistics. The Postdoctoral Fellowships are affiliated with CREATE’s research strand 3 «Addressing key methodological challenges».  

CEMO provides a stimulating research environment by bringing internationally renowned substantive and methodological experts together. Research at CEMO combines basic research and applications of advanced measurement techniques to solve core educational problems. CEMO also contributes to the development of measurement competence through teaching and outreach.
More about the positions
The positions are tied to strand 3 of CREATE, which aims to develop novel methods and statistical software that are tailor-made to the research questions and data of CREATE. 

The successful candidate will conduct advanced methodological and psychometric research. Potential research areas include (a) instructional sensitivity and opportunity to learn in international large-scale assessments in education, (b) estimation and inference methods for weighted generalized structural equation models with mixed continuous and discrete data in longitudinal settings, and (c) advancing research synthesis and meta-analytic methods, for instance, to investigate digital inequalities in education using international large-scale assessment data.

The appointments are full-time positions and made for a period of three years, 10% of which is devoted to required duties, usually in the form of teaching activities. If there is a good match between the candidate’s competence and the teaching needs at CEMO, the positions may be extended to four years, 25% of which is devoted to required duties, usually in the form of teaching activities and supervision. For these positions, the teaching activities will be part of CEMO’s master’s programme in Assessment, Measurement and Evaluation.

The main purpose of the fellowship is to build a research profile and competence that qualifies the postdoctoral fellow to apply for a position as associate professor within their disciplines. The position may also provide other competence with relevance for the postdoctoral fellow's further career.

If the Postdoctoral Fellow does not already have educational qualifications that meet the requirements for an associate professor position, UiO shall facilitate the acquisition of such competence during the employment period.

A career plan shall be developed for the Postdoctoral Fellow, specifying the competencies the Postdoctoral Fellow should acquire. UiO is responsible for following up on the career plan and ensuring that the Postdoctoral Fellow has access to career guidance throughout the postdoctoral term.
Qualification requirements
• Applicants must hold a degree equivalent to a Norwegian doctoral degree in one of the social and behavioral sciences, statistics, or computer science applying and/or developing advanced quantitative methods. The doctoral dissertation must have been submitted for evaluation by the application deadline. Appointment is dependent on the public defense of the doctoral thesis being approved
• Fluent oral and written communication skills in English 
• Demonstrated fit to one of the three research areas (a) to (c) listed above
• Proficiency in programming and data analysis in the statistical software environment R, Python, or other relevant programming languages, as evidenced in relevant courses or publication(s)
Applicants will be evaluated as a function of the fit between their qualifications and the research area they apply for. The following qualifications will count in the assessment of the applicants:

• For research area (a), prior experience with IRT/mixed-effects logistic regression and international large-scale assessments in education
• For research area (b), prior experience with latent variable models and Monte Carlo simulation studies
• For research area (c), prior experience with meta-analysis/research synthesis and international large-scale assessment dataPersonal skills
• Creativity and ability to work independently 
• Self-motivated, eager to learn and ready to tackle and deal with challenges
• Able to collaborate with others

jobs.occupation: Industrial Designer
jobs.description:
Nofence is a Norwegian scale-up that has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionize livestock management, we will need top-notch competence in our Engineering team, and we are now looking for an Industrial Designer.

Your main responsibilities will be:
• 
Generate and visualize design concepts and mechanical solutions for our future livestock hardware products, taking them from early ideas to production-ready models.

• 
Design for manufacturing by cooperation with mechanical and manufacturing engineers.

• 
Develop the design guidelines for industrial design in the company.

• 
Contribute to field research on farms and ranches to observe livestock interactions, working conditions, and operator workflows to inform design concepts.

• 
Design products that prioritize animal welfare, prevent injury, and ensure ergonomic, intuitive handling for farmers and agricultural technicians.

• 
Partner with Product Management and UX design to translate user feedback, field research, and competitive insights into compelling, feasible physical product concepts.

We are looking for someone who has:
• 
Bachelor or Master degree in industrial or product design.

• 
Experience designing electro-mechanical products for volume manufacturing.

• 
Excellent visualization skills on paper and with physical and digital models.

• 
Creative problem-solving skills for complex design solutions.

We are looking for someone who is:
• 
Motivated by working in an autonomous cross-functional team.

• 
Structured with the ability to bridge the gap between user needs and design for manufacturing.

• 
Motivated to facilitate workshops and creative sessions.

• 
Comfortable working in an English-speaking work environment.

• 
Drivers license and ability to travel abroad.

About Nofence
Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilized.

Until now.
Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock.

What we bring to the table
At Nofence, we're not your typical 9-to-5 gig. We're a dynamic scale-up, creating a work atmosphere that's anything but ordinary. It's a place where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth.

We believe in seeing results fast. As an engineer with us, your work won't be lost in the bureaucratic shuffle. You'll witness the immediate impact of your contributions in real-time, influencing the evolution of our cutting-edge virtual fencing solution for livestock.

Join us, where ambition meets reality, and let's keep pushing the boundaries in the world of agri-tech!

About the Application
Please submit your application directly through this portal. In line with applicable data protection regulations and our data protection practices, we are unable to accept or process applications received by email. Applying through the portal also ensures your personal data is handled securely. We review applications on a rolling basis and look forward to hearing from you! 

If you have any questions about Nofence or regarding the application, please reach out to our Engineering Manager Kjetil Grimsæth at below email. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:
Vår beiteteknologi skal bidra til at mer av verdens arealressurser kan utnyttes til bærekraftig matproduksjon.En stor andel beitedyr lever mesteparten av livet innendørs og spiser mye kraftfor. Målsettingen til Nofence er å få beitedyra ut på beite, på en trygg og god måte, slik at de kan ha det godt og selv finne den maten de er skapt for å spise.Vi vil at beitedyr skal få muligheten til å ta i bruk sitt naturlige miljø. Det er god dyrevelferd og det vil frigjøre store arealer som kan brukes til å dyrke menneskemat i stedet for soya i kraftforproduksjon.Vår teknologi gir dyra denne muligheten.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager
jobs.description:
About Six Robotics
At Six Robotics, we build intelligent software that gives Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) the ability to collaborate, adapt on the fly, and execute missions that were previously impossible.

From our base in Oslo, our team of 90+ engineers, researchers, and defence specialists develops our autonomy and swarm platform, used by both government and industry. Working closely with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI) and end users, we move quickly from ideas to field deployment, solving problems where software meets the real world.

The challenges we work on don’t come with existing playbooks. They demand deep technical thinking, close collaboration across disciplines, and the ability to learn quickly as both the technology and the company evolve.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. If you’re excited about building systems that matter and growing alongside talented people that push boundaries every day, you’ll find no better place to deliver real-world impact.

About The Role
At Six Robotics, our product department is built around a clear flow: needs emerge from our customers, are shaped into product features, and are then translated into engineering-ready functionality. As we scale, we are strengthening our Product Team to own this flow end-to-end. This role will build and own the bridge between these domains, ensuring that what we ship is not driven by ad-hoc requests, but by validated needs from the field, strong technical context, and disciplined product decisions.

As a Product Manager at Six Robotics, you will turn complex project needs, field feedback, and long-term strategy into a coherent, executable product direction. This is a hands-on, operational product role at the center of engineering, projects, and real-world UAV operations.

You will help define where our software product, Valkyrie, is going. Defining what gets built, and why, without abstracting away the reality and context the engineering teams need to succeed and understand.

This role is critical in bringing stability, clarity, and long-term focus to how Valkyrie evolves, while still adapting to real-world demands from customers, field operations, and live deployments.

You will work closely with the other Product Managers and report to the Chief of Product, bringing clarity to our Engineering Team Leads, release and project management, acting as the bridge that ensures we build the right capabilities, at the right time, for the right reasons.

What You Will Do
• 
Translate project and customer requirements into actionable product features: prioritize, scope, and refine features so engineering can execute with clarity and confidence.

• 
Shape the product roadmap alongside the Head of Product: contribute to the vision, break it down into a detailed plan, and ensure it drives meaningful, deliverable work.

• 
Bring clarity to engineering to ensure we build the right features: minimize product debt, reduce ad-hoc feature work, and safeguard long-term product quality.

• 
Own operational product execution: track progress, manage priorities, and follow up on releases to keep product development structured and predictable.

• 
Maintain product clarity and coherence: oversee trade-offs, dependencies, and release content to ensure each feature delivers real value internally before reaching engineering.

• 
Validate and refine assumptions in the field: work and test the features with our field teams, to understand real-world performance and feed insights back into product decisions.

What we are looking for
We are looking for someone with exceptional structure and decision-making skills. We believe this person can confidently say no when needed, set direction, and still listen deeply to both the team and the customer. You thrive in ambiguity, bringing discipline and method where things feel uncertain, and you take ownership not just of your own work, but across teams and interfaces. You are comfortable challenging customers constructively, asking why they want something, and translating that into what is actually feasible and valuable for engineering to build. At the same time, you are hands-on, willing to dive into the details when necessary, without ever losing sight of priorities or long-term outcomes.

We believe the right candidate brings
• 
Proven experience working on the development of mission-critical software products, with clear ownership from idea to delivery.

• 
Strong understanding of the full product lifecycle - from requirements and specification to delivery, validation, and iteration.

• 
Strong background in building software products, with the ability to collaborate with engineers while keeping problems concrete and solvable.

• 
Experience in structuring and governing product flow - balancing prioritization, planning, dependencies, and release coordination.

• 
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to translate complex customer needs into clear engineering context, without losing the bigger picture.

• 
A competitive drive and delivery mindset. You care about outcomes, not just process.

• 
Fluency in English (Norwegian not required).

Nice-to-haves:

• 
Experience with UAVs, autonomy systems, robotics, or defence-related technology.

• 
Exposure to hardware-software integrated products or field-deployed systems.

Why you should join
• 
Build at the edge of what’s possible: You’ll work on problems the industry hasn’t solved yet, alongside people who are pushing the boundaries of autonomy, AI, and robotics.

• 
Grow as fast as the company: We believe that chance favours those in motion. The role you’re hired into is just the starting point. As Six Robotics evolves, so will your scope, your responsibilities, and your opportunities.

• 
Work with exceptional people: Surround yourself with people who raise your own standards. You’ll join a team of ambitious engineers and operators who care deeply about the quality of their work. Expectations are high, but so is the willingness to help each other improve.

• 
Ship work that matters. The things you build don't stay in a demo environment. They get deployed, tested, and used where reliability and performance genuinely matter.

• 
Supported by great benefits. Alongside meaningful work, we offer competitive compensation, equity potential, strong pension and insurance plans, gadget budgets, modern equipment, panoramic offices, and the flexibility you need to do your best work.

Our Recruitment Process
We want hiring to be transparent and respectful of your time. We aim to move with momentum while making thoughtful hiring decisions - because every new team member matters.

Our process typically includes:

• 
Initial phone screening (30 min): A conversation about your background, motivation, and the role.

• 
First interview (45 min): Meet the hiring team, learn more about Six Robotics, and discuss your experience.

• 
Second interview (60–90 min): A technical discussion/Case interview, typically including a take-home assignment with a case presentation.

• 
Final interview (45 min): Meet members of our leadership team to align expectations and answer any remaining questions.

Reference checks are conducted before an offer is finalized. We review applications continuously, so don't leave us hanging. Send us your application today!

Our Commitment to Inclusion
At Six Robotics, we are committed to creating a workplace built on respect, integrity, and collaboration. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we believe that diversity within our team strengthens both our work and our culture. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and help us build technology that makes a real impact.

Security Clearance Requirement
All employees at Six Robotics must be eligible for security clearance. Some roles might require a high level of clearance, depending on the nature of the work. If you are hired, we’ll guide you through any required authorization or clearance process as part of your onboarding. Previous authorization or clearance is not required, but all candidates must be eligible to obtain the necessary approvals if required for their role.

jobs.occupation: PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance
jobs.description:
PhD Position in Long-term Climate Governance
Oslo Business School at Oslo Metropolitan University (OsloMet) invites applications for a temporary position as PhD scholar in long-term climate governance. The position is connected to the ERC-funded research project CAMELOT – Capacities for More Effective Long-term Climate Governance and is expected to start in April 2027.

The position is three years full-time but can be extended to four years if teaching assignments are included. The PhD Research Fellow will be based in the academic unit Public Administration and Governance at Oslo Business School and will be enrolled in OsloMet's PhD programme in Social Sciences, specialization Business Administration, Innovation and Governance (BIG).

The successful candidate is expected to complete the doctoral degree during the period of employment.
About CAMELOT
Many of today's most consequential governance challenges, including climate change and Earth system risks, unfold over decades, centuries, or longer. Yet political institutions and decision-making processes often struggle to engage effectively with such long-term futures.

CAMELOT investigates the capacities that enable individuals, groups, and institutions to think about and govern for the long term. The project develops new theory on long-term governance capacities and studies whether and how such capacities can be strengthened through experimental and participatory research. It brings together insights from political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, futures studies, psychology, and related fields.

CAMELOT is a five-year research project funded by a European Research Council (ERC) Consolidator Grant and led by Associate professor Manjana Milkoreit at OsloMet.

CAMELOT project website
About the PhD project
The PhD scholar will develop an independent research project that contributes to CAMELOT's overarching objective of understanding and strengthening capacities for long-term climate governance.

The project should be theoretically informed and empirically grounded and involve original empirical research designed and conducted by the PhD candidate. The research may build on, extend, or enable comparisons with research undertaken elsewhere in CAMELOT, but should not depend on data collection undertaken in other parts of the project.

We welcome innovative proposals addressing questions related to long-term governance capacities. Possible research directions include, but are not limited to:

• investigating how narratives and stories about long-term climate futures influence imagination, understanding, attitudes, decision-making, or other capacities relevant to long-term governance
• examining how engagement with long-term climate futures differs across climate risks, Earth system tipping elements, audiences, social groups, professional communities, or political and cultural contexts
• studying how scenarios, foresight, simulations, serious games, or other futures-oriented interventions affect capacities for anticipatory and long-term governance
• developing and evaluating educational or professional interventions designed to strengthen capacities for engaging with long-term climate futures
• investigating whether and under what conditions changes in long-term governance capacities translate into changes in reasoning, decision-making, or action
Applicants are encouraged to propose original research questions and approaches that extend beyond these examples while demonstrating a clear connection to CAMELOT's overarching research agenda.

A range of methodological approaches may be appropriate, including quantitative, qualitative, experimental, and mixed-methods research. The proposed research must be feasible within the period of employment.

The candidate will conduct their own research while working closely with the CAMELOT team. They will benefit from interaction with CAMELOT's theoretical, experimental, and participatory research and may develop complementary or comparative studies building on concepts, methods, interventions, or findings developed within the project.
Qualification requirements
We are looking for candidates who meet the following requirements:

• master's degree of 120 ECTS or equivalent in political science, public administration, environmental governance, sustainability science, sociology, psychology, futures studies, science and technology studies, human geography, or another field relevant to the position
• grade of B or better on both the master's thesis and the master's degree overall, or an equivalent academic record
• demonstrate knowledge of research methods relevant to the proposed PhD project
• strong analytical and academic writing skills
• excellent written and spoken English
Candidates who are close to completing their master's degree may apply, provided that the degree is completed before the start of the position.

It will be an advantage

It will be considered an advantage to have knowledge of or previous research experience related to one or more of the following areas: climate or environmental governance; public policy; long-term or anticipatory governance; futures and foresight; environmental or political psychology; narratives and communication; Earth system risks and tipping points; or experimental and intervention-based social science.

Experience with empirical data collection and analysis, participation in research projects, academic publishing, or interdisciplinary research will also be considered an advantage.

General criteria for employment as a Research Fellow are stipulated in the Regulations relating to the Universities and University Colleges Act. 

Admission to the doctoral program is a prerequisite. Admission to the doctoral program is based on a comprehensive assessment of the application, including the relevance and quality of the project description. A finalized project plan for the employment period is required completed and acknowledged within 3 months from the date of employment.

See information about admission criteria to the PhD-programme.

It is important for OsloMet to reflect the diverse and multicultural populationof our region, and all qualified candidates are welcome to apply. We make active endeavors to further develop OsloMet as an inclusive workplace and to adapt the workplace if required. If there are periods where you have not been in work or have been studying or in training, you are also welcome to apply.
We offer
The successful candidate will join an interdisciplinary and international research environment working at the intersection of climate governance, public policy, futures research, and the social sciences.

The position offers:

• exciting job tasks at Norway’s third largest university
• opportunities for academic development in a professional research environment
• three-year full-time position with 100% salary; possibility to extend to 4 years with teaching duties
• beneficial pension arrangements with the Norwegian State Pension Fund 
• good employee welfare arrangements
• free Norwegian classes to employees
• working location in downtown Oslo with multiple cultural offers
• close integration into the ERC-funded CAMELOT research team and the Public Administration and Governance research environment at Oslo Business School
• close supervision and intellectual exchange with researchers working on long-term governance, climate governance, experimental social science, futures and anticipation, and science-policy engagement
The position provides an opportunity to develop an independent scholarly profile while being embedded in a larger international research project with strong connections to academic and policy communities.

The salary for the position is in accordance with the Basic Collective Agreement for state employees and OsloMets pay policy for PhD Candidate in code 1017), corresponding to 550 800 NOK per year. From the salary, 2% will be deducted in pension contributions for the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK). (double check salary in the salary plan booklet and pay scales set by OsloMet).
Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=SHi5avzdHIkApplication Process 
If you wish to apply for the position, you must do so through our recruitment system.

Please upload the following documents together by the application deadline: 

• an application letter (maximum two pages) explaining your motivation for applying and how your background, research interests, and experience are relevant to the position 
• a project proposal (maximum five pages, excluding references), following the requirements above
• CV
• certificates and transcripts for bachelor's and master's degrees, including grades; The certificates/diplomas must include ECTS grades (A–F). Foreign diplomas must be translated into English by the degree-conferring institution.
• a copy of the master's thesis and up to two published academic works

jobs.occupation: Join our Account Executive teams!
jobs.description:
At Mercell, we're on a mission to revolutionize public procurement, making it accessible and effortless for everyone involved. Imagine a world where public buyers and visionary suppliers come together seamlessly to make a great deal easier and shape the future. That's what we're all about.

With a dynamic culture built on continuous growth, trust, and collaboration, Mercell offers an environment where your talents can thrive. You will be part of an international environment with ambitious and dedicated colleagues who are passionate about what they do and supported to be themselves.

Together, let's shape the future and create real value for society, one innovative solution at a time.

Join Us

We are growing our Buy-Side Sales teams and looking for ambitious Account Executives to join us in several markets. This is not a single open role, but a talent pool - an ongoing hiring pipeline which we will continuously review and match strong profiles with upcoming opportunities across our teams.

Your Mission

Our Account Executives are at the heart of Mercell’s mission. You’ll be a trusted advisor to public sector customers, guiding them through a value based buying journey and showing how Mercell’s solutions can help them achieve efficiency, compliance, and real impact for society.

You’ll manage the entire sales cycle from prospecting and qualifying leads (both inbound and outbound) to running demos, managing tender responses, negotiating terms, and closing deals.

With each success, you’ll help strengthen Mercell’s presence in your market and expand our growing community of public sector partners.

Core Responsibilities  

• 
Proactively identify, engage, and build relationships with key decision-makers across your market.

• 
Translate the business pains of the organization into a value based selling approach to drive large strategic engagements.

• 
Own the entire sales journey from first contact and discovery to negotiation, closing, onboarding, and upselling.

• 
Confidently demonstrate the value and impact of Mercell’s SaaS platform to organisations of all sizes.

• 
Maintain accurate and up-to-date CRM data in HubSpot, using insights to optimise pipeline and sales performance.

• 
Stay ahead of developments in the local and European public procurement landscape to uncover new growth opportunities.

Required Qualifications  

• 
Strong experience (ideally 3-5 years) managing a full B2B SaaS sales cycle, preferably to the public sector or highly regulated industries with a tender driven sales motion.

• 
Strong experience in outbound sales and pipeline generation with demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.

• 
Ability to engage confidently with senior stakeholders and decision-makers.

• 
Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, and collaborative environment where priorities evolve.

• 
Excellent communication and presentation skills in English.

• 
Fluency in at least one of the following languages: Swedish, Norwegian, Danish, German or Dutch.

Preferred Qualifications  

• 
Familiarity with public procurement, tendering, or compliance-driven buying processes.

• 
Experience working in an international or multi-market sales environment.

• 
Strong consultative selling mindset with a focus on long-term customer value. 

Workplace type: Hybrid, working onsite at the office and from home balancing flexibility with collaboration

Locations: Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Germany, Netherlands

 

What we offer 

As a fast growing technology company, we are committed to taking care of our employees through initiatives such as hybrid work to support work-life balance, health and insurance plans (may differ per country/office), pension plans, paid parental leave, social happenings and competitive salary packages. Please see https://career.mercell.com/posts/our-perks-benefits to get more insights on what to expect of perks, benefits and culture when joining Mercell.

Has this sparked your interest?

Apply now and join our team!

This is a talent pool, there is no fixed application deadline — we will review applications continuously.

By applying, your profile will be considered for upcoming opportunities that match your skills, experience, and interests. We will keep you updated accordingly throughout the process.

-Mercell is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences.

-Mercell handles all personal data in line with GDPR and our Privacy Policy.

-Mercell does not provide relocation support. We are seeking candidates who are already based in, or have existing work authorization for, the country where the role is located.

-Mercell may carry out background checks on applicants to verify information that appears on CVs and other documentation. This background check is carried out by an external party and is not carried out without the consent of the applicant. Current applicants will receive further information about this.

Om arbeidsgiveren:
At Mercell, we’re transforming how businesses manage procurement and public tendering processes. As a leading provider of digital solutions for procurement, we help organizations across Europe streamline, automate, and optimize their sourcing operations. Our cloud-based platform connects buyers and suppliers, driving transparency, efficiency, and compliance in public and private sector procurement.

The Problem We Solve:
Procurement is often plagued by inefficiencies, manual workflows, and a lack of transparency, making it time-consuming and prone to errors. This not only impacts operational performance but can also prevent businesses from making strategic, cost-effective decisions. At Mercell, we are solving these challenges by providing an integrated solution that simplifies the tendering process, ensures compliance with regulatory standards, and empowers businesses with data-driven insights.

Why We Do It: 
We believe that efficient procurement is at the heart of sustainable business growth. By digitizing and optimizing the procurement process, we help organizations save time, reduce costs, and make smarter decisions, all while fostering a more competitive and transparent marketplace. Our goal is to empower organizations to focus on their core business, leaving procurement complexity to us.

At Mercell, we’re driven by innovation and a passion to continuously improve the procurement landscape.

From our base in Oslo, our 70+ experts in defence, software, and AI develop our flagship autonomy and swarm platform used by both government and industry. In close partnership with the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI), we move fast from concept to live deployment, often in the field alongside end users.

We work with advanced hardware and software, a modern tech stack, and missions that demand both technical mastery and operational discipline. Everyone is close to the action, from deep technical problem-solving to field operations. We move fast and value clarity, integrity, and teamwork in everything we do.

At Six Robotics, every person executes with precision, adapts to changing conditions, and strengthens the team. Getting in is hard, and you'll be challenged every day. But if you have the skill, the discipline, and the drive to push your limits, you'll find no better place to deliver real-world impact while collaborating and learning from the best in the field.
About The Role
Our drones operate as a swarm. They need to talk to each other, and to the ground, in conditions that don't forgive sloppy communications: packet loss, moving nodes, limited bandwidth, and a mix of wireless devices. This role deals with how the network is actually used by applications. You'll work on how data actually moves between nodes in the swarm and between the swarm and ground. The mission is to take communication from working in the lab to working in the field, every time, under contested conditions. That's an architecture problem, a code problem, and a debugging problem in equal measure, and you'll be a key contributor on all three alongside the rest of the team.

You'll work closely with engineers across teams, particularly those integrating new hardware like radios and those running simulation efforts. 
What You Will Do
• 
Drive the architecture call on how messages flow across, whether that's through existing mesh routing protocols or a custom propagation approach

• 
Build robust node-to-node and swarm-to-ground communication

• 
Consider QoS, prioritisation, and fallback behaviour across multiple links, especially under packet loss and mobility

• 
Write the C++ that makes it work, close to the Linux networking stack on embedded systems

• 
Expect a bit of time in the field. Conditions outside the lab surface things a desk never will, and you'll be part of working through them

• 
Be a strong voice on platform and radio decisions where the comms architecture is affected, even though new radio integrations are not your day-to-day
What We Are Looking For
We believe you've shipped real systems over real radio links before, and you know what holds up versus what looks fine in a demo. You might have made the call between mesh and message-flow approaches, or something equivalent, and you can explain why you went the way you did.

We believe the right candidate brings:

• 
5+ years as a software engineer, with 3+ of those building communication or distributed-systems software in production, where lossy links and mobility were real constraints

• 
Strong engineering defaults, comfortable C++ and on embedded Linux

• 
Hands-on experience with mesh or message-flow protocols

• 
Familiarity with IP radios and how application logic sits on top of them

• 
Strong communication skills. You can explain technical trade-offs clearly to people who don't share your domain expertise

• 
Fluent in English (Norwegian not required)

• 
A Master's degree or equivalent practical experience in a relevant field

Nice to have:

• 
ROS 2 / DDS with real QoS tuning experience

• 
MAVLink

• 
4G/5G modems on embedded targets

• 
Background from defence tech, robotics, telco/MANET, or military signals environments
Why You Should Join
At Six Robotics, we're not just building software, we're redefining how unmanned systems operate in the real world. If you're driven by meaningful problems, technical depth, and the chance to shape something from the ground up, you'll find your place here.

• 
Work on problems that matter

Our technology helps unlock smarter, safer, and more adaptable UAV operations in defense and industry, solving real challenges with direct, tangible impact.

• 
Lead the shift in a hardware-dominated space

We're bringing modern AI, autonomy, and scalable software into a field that's long relied on rigid, pre-programmed systems, to change how UAVs are designed, deployed, and managed.

• 
Build from zero, shape the future

Join early and help define the core systems, tools, and culture of a company that’s still being built - where your ideas, code, and decisions will have a lasting influence.

• 
Work with purpose, supported by great benefitsYou'll be part of a mission-driven team that values clarity, integrity, and collaboration, offering competitive pay, equity potential, strong insurance and pension plans, and ongoing learning opportunities.Our Recruitment Process

• 
Screening interview with one of our recruiters to get to know you better (30 min)

• 
Meet & Greet with someone from the team to learn more about us (60 min)

• 
Technical home assignment, ability and personality tests, and a technical interview focused on the specifics of the role (90 min)

• 
Final interview with the engineering lead and Head of People (45 min)Our Commitment to InclusionAt Six Robotics, we are committed to creating a workplace built on respect, integrity, and collaboration. We value different perspectives and experiences, and we believe that diversity within our team strengthens both our work and our culture. We encourage all qualified candidates to apply and help us build technology that makes a real impact.Security Clearance RequirementAll employees at Six Robotics are required to undergo a security clearance due to our close collaboration with the Norwegian Armed Forces. While prior clearance is not necessary, the clearance process will be initiated as part of onboarding.

Become part of a diverse team representing over 40 nationalities. At SalMar, we’re more than a company – we’re a community built on innovation, collaboration, and excellence. • Reliable and punctual.
• Strong work ethic.

• Responsible and positive attitude.

What We Offer

• Competitive salary and benefits.
• A supportive and inclusive work environment.
• Comprehensive pension and insurance agreements.
• Opportunities for long-term employment and growth.
• Access to an on-site gym and a cafeteria serving good, nutritious meals.

Join a workplace that values your well-being, growth, and success.

Ready to make an impact in sustainable seafood production?
 Apply now and join SalMar at InnovaMar, Frøya – where your work makes a difference.

We value diversity and inclusion and encourage all qualified candidates to apply, regardless of gender, age, religion, ethnicity, or other individual differences.
